Irshad hota hai ke muqarrabeen-e-khas bahut se pehle ke hain aur kuch pichlon mein se bhi hain, in awwaleen-o-akhireen ki tafseer mein kayi qaul hain, maslan agli ummaton mein se aur is ummat mein se, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isi qaul ko pasand karte hain aur is hadith ko bhi is qaul ki pukhtagi mein pesh karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hum pichle hain aur Qayamat ke din pehle hain aur is qaul ki ta'eed Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki is riwayat se bhi ho sakti hai ke jab yeh aayat utri as-hab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bahut garan guzri. Pas yeh aayat utri (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke kul ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tum ho balkay tihayi tum ho balkay aadhon-aadh tum ho tum aadhi jannat ke maalik hoge aur baqi aadhi tamam ummaton mein taqseem hogi jin mein tum bhi shareek ho. Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Ibn-e-Asakir (R.H) mein hai Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne is aayat ko sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya agli ummaton mein se bahut log sabiqeen mein dakhil honge aur hum mein se kam log? Is ke ek saal ke baad yeh aayat nazil hui ke aglon mein se bhi bahut aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bula kar kaha suno Hazrat Adam (A.S) se le kar mujh tak thullah hai aur sirf meri ummat thullah hai, hum apne (thullah) ko pura karne ke liye un habshiyon ko bhi le lenge jo oont ke charwahe hain magar Allah Ta'ala ke wahid aur la-shareek hone ki shahadat dete hain. Lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein nazar hai, haan bahut si sanadon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman sabit hai ke mujhe umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi ho aakhir tak. Pas Alhamdulillah yeh ek behtareen khushkhabri hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne jis qaul ko pasand farmaya hai us mein zara gaur karne ki zaroorat hai balkay darasal yeh qaul bahut kamzor hai. Kyunke alfaaz-e-Quran se is ummat ka aur tamam ummaton se afzal-o-a'ala hona sabit hai, phir kaise ho sakta hai? Ke muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-samadiyat aur ummaton mein se toh bahut se hue aur is behtareen ummat mein se kam hon, haan yeh taujeeh ho sakti hai ke un tamam ummaton ke muqarrab mil kar sirf is ek ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad se barh jayen, lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke kul ummaton ke muqarrabeen se sirf is ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad zyada hogi. Aage Allah ko ilm hai. Dusra qaul is jumla ki tafseer mein yeh hai ke is ummat ke shuru zamane ke logon mein se muqarrabeen ki tadaad bahut zyada hai aur baad ke logon mein kam. Yehi qaul ra'ij hai. Chunancha Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marvi hai ke aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya sabiqeen toh guzar chuke ae Allah tu hamein as-hab-e-yameen mein kar de. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ummat mein se jo guzar chuke un mein muqarrabeen bahut the.

Imam Ibn-e-Sirin R.H bhi yahi farmate hain, koi shak nahin ke har ummat mein yahi hota chala aaya hai ke shuru mein bahut se muqarrabeen hote hain aur baad walon mein yeh tadaad kam ho jaati hai, toh yeh bhi mumkin hai ke muraad yunhi ho yani har ummat ke agle log sabqat karne wale zyada hote hain ba-nisbat har ummat ke pichle logon ke, chunancha Sahah wagairah ki ahadees se saabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya sab zamanon mein behtar zamana mera zamana hai phir us ke baad wala phir us ka mutassil zamana, al-kh. Haan ek hadees mein yeh bhi aaya meri ummat ki misaal baarish jaisi hai na maloom ke shuru zamane ki baarish behtar ho ya aakhir zamane ki, toh yeh hadees jab ke is ki asnaad ko sehat ka hukm de diya jaaye is amr par mahmool hai ke jis tarah deen ko shuru ke logon ki zaroorat thi jo is ki tableegh apne baad walon ko karein isi tarah aakhir mein bhi ise qaim rakhne walon ki zaroorat hai jo logon ko sunnat-e-Rasool par jamayein is ki riwayatein karein ise logon par zahir karein, lekin fazeelat awwal walon ki hi rahegi. Theek isi tarah jis tarah khet ko shuru baarish ki aur aakhri baarish ki zaroorat hoti hai lekin bada faida ibtidai baarish se hi hota hai is liye ke agar shuru shuru baarish na ho toh daane ugein hi nahin na un ki jadein jamein. Isi liye Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ek jamaat meri ummat mein se hamesha haq par reh kar ghalib rahegi un ke dushman unhein zarar na pahuncha sakenge, un ke mukhalif unhein ruswa aur past na kar sakenge yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho jayegi aur woh is tarah hon. Al-gharz yeh ummat baqi tamam ummaton se afzal-o-ashraf hai aur is mein muqarrabeen-e-Ilahiya ba-nisbat aur ummaton ke bahut hain, aur bahut bade martabe wale kyunke deen ke kaamil hone aur Nabi ke aali martaba hone ke lihaaz se yeh sab behtar hain. Tawaatur ke saath yeh hadees suboot ko pahunch chuki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya is ummat mein se sattar hazaar log baghair hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge aur har hazaar ke saath sattar hazaar aur honge, Tabrani mein hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum mein se ek bahut badi jamaat Qayamat ke roz khadi ki jayegi jo is qadar badi aur ginti mein zaaid hogi ke goya raat aa gayi zameen ke tamam kinaron ko ghera le gi farishte kehne lagenge sab nabiyon ke saath jitne log aaye hain un se bahut hi zyada Muhammad ﷺ ke saath hain.

Munasib maqam yeh hai ke "bahut badi jamaat aglon mein se aur bahut hi badi pichlon mein se" wali ayat ki tafsir ke mauqe par yeh hadith zikr kardi jaye jo Hafiz Abu Bakr Baihaqi (R.H) ne Dala'il-e-Nabuwwat mein warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab subah ki namaz padhte paon mode hue hi sattar martaba yeh padhte dua (SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi astaghfirullaha innallaha kana tawwaba) phir farmate sattar ke badle saat sau hain jis ke ek din ke gunah saat sau se bhi badh jayen woh be-khabar hai phir do martaba isi ko farmate phir logon ki taraf munh kar ke baithte aur chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khwab achha maloom hota tha is liye puchte ke kya tum mein se kisi ne koi khwab dekha hai? Abu Zumal kehte hain ek din isi tarah hasb-e-adat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya to main ne kaha haan ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne ek khwab dekha hai, farmaya Allah khair se milaye shar se bachaye hamare liye behtar banaye aur hamare dushmanon ke liye badtar banaye har qism ki tareefon ka mustahiq woh Allah hai jo tamam jahano ka palne wala hai, apna khwab bayan karo. Main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne dekha ke ek rasta hai kushada, aasaan, narm, saaf aur beshumar log is raste mein chale ja rahe hain yeh rasta jaate jaate ek sarsabz bagh ko nikalta hai ke meri aankhon ne aisa lehlahata hua hara bhara bagh kabhi nahin dekha pani har su rawan hai sabze se pata pada hai anwa-o-aqsam ke darakht khushnuma phale phoole khade hain ab main ne dekha ke pehli jamaat jo aayi aur is bagh ke paas pahunchi to unhon ne apni sawariyan tez kar lin dayen bayen nahin gaye aur tez raftari ke sath yahan se guzar gaye. Phir dusri jamaat aayi jo tadaad mein bahut zyada thi, jab yahan pahunche to baaz logon ne apne janwaron ko charana chugana shuru kiya aur baazon ne kuch le liya aur chal diye phir to bahut zyada log aaye jab un ka guzra in gul-o-gulzar par hua to yeh to phool gaye aur kehne lage yeh sab se achhi jagah hai goya main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh dayen bayen jhuk pade main ne yeh dekha lekin main Aap to chalta hi raha jab door nikal gaya to main ne dekha ke ek mimbar saat seedhiyon ka bicha hua hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ke aala darja par tashreef farma hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dayen janib ek sahib hain gandum-goon rang bhari ungliyon wale daraz qad jab kalam karte hain to sab khamoshi se sunte hain aur log unche ho ho kar tawajjuh se un ki baatein sunte hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki bayen taraf ek shakhs hain bhare jism ke darmiyana qad ke jin ke chehra par bakasrat til hain un ke baal goya pani se tar hain jab woh baat karte hain to un ke ikram ki wajah se sab log jhuk jate hain phir is se aage ek shakhs hain jo akhlaq-o-aadat mein aur chehre naqshe mein bilkul Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mushabahat rakhte hain, Aap log sab un ki taraf poori tawajjuh karte hain aur un ka irada rakhte hain.

Un se aagay ek dubli patli burhiya oontni hai, main ne dekha ke goya aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) usay utha rahe hain, yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho gaya, thodi der mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh halat badal gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Seedhay sachay aur sahih raastay se muraad toh woh Deen hai jisay main le kar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aaya hoon aur jis hidayat par tum ho. Hara bhara sabz baagh jo tum ne dekha hai woh duniya hai aur us ki aish-o-ishrat ka dil lubhanay wala saamaan. Main aur mere ashaab toh us se guzar jayenge, na tum us mein mashghool hoge, na woh hamain chimtay gi, na hamara talluq us se hoga, na us ka talluq hum se, na hum us ki chahat karenge, na woh hamain liptay gi. Phir hamaray baad doosri jamaat aayegi jo hum se tadaad mein bohat zyada hogi, un mein se ba'az toh is duniya mein phans jayenge aur ba'az ba-qadr-e-hajat le lenge aur chal denge aur nijaat pa lenge. Phir un ke baad zabardast jamaat aayegi jo is duniya mein bilkul mustaghraq ho jayegi aur daayen baayen behak jayegi. Aayat (فانا للہ وانا الیہ راجعون - Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un). Ab rahay tum, so tum apni seedhi raah chaltay rahoge yahan tak ke mujh se tumhari mulaqat ho jayegi. Jis mimbar ke aakhri saaton darjay par tum ne mujhe dekha us ki ta'beer yeh hai ke duniya ki umr saat hazaar saal ki hai, main aakhri hazaarwein saal mein hoon. Mere daayen jis gundumi rang moti hatheli walay insaan ko tum ne dekha woh Hazrat Musa (A.S) hain, jab woh kalaam karte hain toh log oonchay ho jatay hain is liye ke unhain Allah Ta'ala se sharaf-e-hum-kalami ho chuka hai. Aur jinhein tum ne mere baayen dekha jo darmiyana qad ke bharay jism ke bohat se tallon walay thay jin ke baal paani se tar nazar aatay thay, woh Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) hain, chunke un ka ikraam Allah Ta'ala ne kiya hai hum sab bhi un ki buzurgi karte hain. Aur jin sheikh ko tum ne bilkul mujh sa dekha woh hamaray baap Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain, hum sab un ka qasd karte hain aur un ki iqtida aur tabedari karte hain. Aur jis oontni ko tum ne dekha ke main usay khadi kar raha hoon, us se muraad Qayamat hai jo meri ummat par qaim hogi, na mere baad koi Nabi aayega, na meri ummat ke baad koi ummat hai. Farmatay hain is ke baad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh poochna chhod diya ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Haan agar koi shakhs apnay aap apna khwab bayan kar de toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ta'beer de diya kartay thay. Un ke baithnay ke takht aur aaram karnay ke palang sonay ke taaron se banay huay honge jin mein jagah jagah moti takay huay honge, dur-o-yaqoot juray huay honge. Yeh fa'eel ma'ani mein maf'ool ke hai is liye oontni ke pait ke neechay walay ko wazeem kehtay hain. Sab ke munh ek doosray ke samnay honge, koi kisi ki taraf peeth diye huay na hoga. Woh ulama un ki khidmat guzari mein mashghool honge jo umr mein waisay hi chhotay rahenge, na baday hon na burhay hon. Na un mein taghayyur-o-tabdeel aaye. Akwaab kehtay hain un koonzon ko jin ki tonti aur pakarnay ki cheez na ho aur abaareeq woh aaftabay jo tonti-daar aur pakray janay ke qabil hon.

Yeh sab sharab ki jaari nahar se chalkte hue honge jo sharab na khatam ho na kam ho kyunke uske chashme beh rahe hain, jaam chalkte hue har waqt apne nazuk hathon mein liye hue yeh gul-andam saqi idhar udhar gasht kar rahe honge. Is sharab se unhein dard-e-sar ho na unki aql zail ho balkay bawajood pooray suroor aur kaif ke aql-o-hawas apni jagah qaim rahenge aur kamil lazzat hasil hogi. Sharab mein chaar sifatein hain nasha, sar dard, qai aur peshab, pas Parwardigar-e-Alam ne jannat ki sharab ka zikr kar ke un charon nuqsanat ki nafi kardi ke woh sharab un nuqsanat se pak hai. Phir qisam qisam ke meway aur tarah tarah ke parindon ke gosht unhein milenge jis meway ko jee chahey aur jis tarah ke gosht ki taraf dil ki raghbat ho majood ho jayega, yeh tamam cheezein liye hue unke saleeqa-e-shiar khuddam har waqt unke ird gird ghoomte rahenge taake jis cheez ki jab kabhi khwahish ho le lein, is ayat mein daleel hai ke aadmi meway chun chun kar apni khwahish ke mutabiq kha sakta hai, Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosli mein hai Hazrat Akrash bin Zuwaib (R.A) farmate hain ke apni qoum ke sadqa ke maal le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap (ﷺ) Muhajireen aur Ansar mein tashreef farma thay mere saath zakat ke bohat se oont thay goya ke woh rait ke darakhton ke charay hue naujawan oont hain aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum kaun ho? Main ne kaha Akrash bin Zuwaib farmaya apna nasab nama door tak bayan kardo main ne Murrah bin Dubaik tak keh sunaya aur saath hi kaha ke zakat Murrah bin Ubaid ki hai pas Huzoor (ﷺ) muskuraye aur farmane lage yeh meri qoum ke oont hain yeh meri qoum ke sadqa ka maal hai phir hukum diya ke sadqay ke oonton ke nishan un par kardo aur unke saath inhein bhi mila do phir mera haath pakar kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) ke ghar tashreef laye aur farmaya kuch khanay ko hai? Jawab mila ke haan chunancha ek baray lagan mein tukray tukray ki hui roti aayi aap (ﷺ) ne aur main ne khana shuru kiya. Main idhar udhar se niwalay lene laga aap (ﷺ) ne apne haath se mera dahina haath thaam liya, aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh to ek qisam ka khana hai ek jagah se khao. Phir ek seeni tar khajooron khushk khajooron ki aayi main ne sirf mere samnay jo thin unhein khana shuru kiya haan Rasool Allah (ﷺ) seeni ke idhar udhar se jahan se jo pasand aati thi le lete thay aur mujh se bhi farmaya ae Akrash is mein har tarah ki khajoorein hain jahan se chaho khao jis qisam ki khajoor chaho le lo, phir pani aaya pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne haath dhoye aur wahi tar haath apne chehray par aur dono bazoo'on aur sar par teen dafa pher liye aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh wuzu hai us cheez se jisay aag ne mutaghayyar kiya ho. (Tirmizi aur Ibn-e-Majah) Imam Tirmizi isay ghareeb batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko khwab pasand tha basa auqat aap (ﷺ) pooch liya karte thay ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Agar koi zikr karta aur phir Huzoor (ﷺ) us khwab se khush hote to usay bohat acha lagta.

Ek martaba ek aurat Aap ﷺ ke paas aayin kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne aaj ek khwab dekha hai ke goya mere paas koi aaya aur mujhe Madina se le chala aur Jannat mein pahuncha diya phir main ne yakayak dhamaka suna jis se Jannat mein halchal mach gayi main ne jo nazar utha kar dekha to falan bin falan aur falan bin falan ko dekha barah shakhson ke naam liye unhein barah shakhson ka ek lashkar bana kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne kayi din huye ek muhim par rawana kiya hua tha farmati hain unhein laya gaya yeh atlas ke kapde pehne huye the un ki ragein josh maar rahi thin hukm hua ke unhein nehar-e-baidaj mein le jao ya baizak kaha, jab un logon ne is nehar mein ghota lagaya to un ke chehre chaudahvin raat ke chand ki tarah chamakne lag gaye phir ek sone ki sini mein gadri khajoorein aayin jo unhon ne apni hasb-e-mansha khayin aur sath hi har tarah ke meway jo charon taraf chune huye the jis meway ko un ka ji chahta tha lete the aur khate the main ne bhi un ke sath shirkat ki aur woh meway khaye, muddat ke baad ek qasid aaya aur kaha falan falan ashkhas jinhein Aap ﷺ ne lashkar mein bheja tha shaheed ho gaye theek barah shakhson ke naam liye aur yeh wohi naam the jinhein is biwi sahiba ne apne khwab mein dekha tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne un nek-bakht sahabi-e ko phir bulwaya aur farmaya apna khwab dobara bayan karo us ne phir bayan kiya aur unhi logon ke naam liye jin ke naam qasid ne liye the. Tabrani mein hai ke Jannati jis meway ko darakht se tode ga wahin is jaisa aur phal lag jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Jannati parind bakhti aur oont ke barabar hain jo Jannat mein charte chugte rehte hain, Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ yeh parind to nihayat hi mazay ke honge, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un ke khane wale un se bhi zyada naaz-o-nemat wale honge. Teen martaba yahi jumla irshad farma kar phir farmaya mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke ae Abu Bakr tum un mein se ho jo un parindon ka gosht khayenge. Hafiz Abu Abdullah Misri ki kitab Sifat-ul-Jannah mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ke samne Tuba ka zikr hua pas Huzoor ﷺ ne Huzoor Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho Tuba kya hai? Aap R.A ne jawab diya Allah aur us ke Rasool ko pura ilm hai Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Jannat ka ek darakht hai jis ki tulani ka ilm siwaye Allah ke aur kisi ko nahin is ki ek ek shakh tale tez sawar sattar sattar saal tak chala jaye ga. Phir bhi is ka saya khatam na hua is ke patte bade chaure chaure hain un par bakhti oontni ke barabar parind aa kar baithte hain, Abu Bakr R.A ne farmaya phir to yeh parind badi hi nematon wale honge Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un se zyada nematon wale un ke khane wale honge aur Insha'Allah tum bhi unhi mein se ho. Hazrat Qatada R.H se bhi yeh pichla hissa marwi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi-ud-Dunya mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Kausar ki babat sawal hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh Jannati nehar hai jo mujhe Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne ata farmayi hai, doodh se zyada safed aur shehad se zyada meetha iska pani hai, iske kinare bakhti oonton ki gardanon jaise parind hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya woh parind toh bade maze mein hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya unka khane wala unse zyada maze mein hai. (Tirmidhi). Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan kehte hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannat mein ek parind hai jiske sattar hazar par hain, Jannati ke dastarkhwan par woh aayega aur uske har par se ek qism niklegi jo doodh se zyada safed aur makkhan se zyada narm aur shehad se zyada meethi, phir dusre par se dusri qism niklegi, isi tarah har par se ek dusre se judagana, phir woh parind ud jayega. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur iske rawi Rasani aur unke ustad dono zaeef hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) se marwi hai ke Jannati parind misl-e-bakhti oonton ke hain jo Jannat ke phal khate hain aur Jannat ki nehron ka pani peete hain, Jannatiyon ka dil jis parind ke khane ko chahega woh uske samne aa jayega, woh jitna chahega jis pehlu ka gosht pasand karega khayega, phir woh parind ud jayega aur jaisa tha waisa hi hoga. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat ke jis parind ko tu chahega woh bhuna-bhunaya tere samne aa jayega.

Hoor ki dusri qira'at re ke zer se bhi hai. Pesh se toh matlab hai ke Jannatiyon ke liye hoorein hongi aur zer se yeh matlab hai ke goya agle a'raab ki mat-huti mein yeh a'raab bhi hai, jaise aayat (Wamsahu bi-ru'usikum wa arjulakum ilal-ka'bain) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 6) mein zabar ki qira'at hai aur jaise ke aayat (Aliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun wa istabraq) (Surah Al-Insan: 21) hain. Aur yeh ma'ani bhi ho sakte hain ke ghilman apne sath hoorein bhi liye hue honge lekin unke mahalaat mein aur khaimon mein na ke aam taur par, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh hoorein aisi hongi jaise tar-o-taza safed saaf moti hon, jaise Surah Saffat mein hai aayat (Ka'annahunna baidun maknoon) (Surah As-Saffat: 49). Surah Ar-Rahman mein bhi yeh wasf ma'a tafseer guzar chuka hai. Yeh unke nek a'maal ka sila aur badla hai yani yeh tohfe unki husn-e-karguzari ka inaam hain. Yeh Jannat mein laghw, behuda, be-ma'ani, khilaf-e-tab' koi kalma bhi na sunenge, haqarat aur burai ka ek lafz bhi kaan mein na padega, jaise aur aayat mein hai (La tasma'u feeha laghiyatan) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 11). Fuzool kalami se unke kaan mehfooz rahenge. Na koi qabeeh kalam kaan mein padega. Haan sirf salamti bhare salam ke kalmaat ek dusron ko kahenge, jaise aur jagah irshad farmaya aayat (Tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun) (Surah Ibrahim: 23). Inka tohfa aapas mein ek dusre ko salam karna hoga. Inki baat-cheet laghwiyat aur gunah se paak hogi.

Muqarrabeen kaun hain? Aur awwaleen kaun? Irshad hota hai ke muqarrabeen-e-khas bahut se pehle ke hain aur kuch pichlon mein se bhi hain, in awwaleen-o-akhireen ki tafseer mein kayi qaul hain, maslan agli ummaton mein se aur is ummat mein se, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isi qaul ko pasand karte hain aur is hadith ko bhi is qaul ki pukhtagi mein pesh karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hum pichle hain aur Qayamat ke din pehle hain aur is qaul ki ta'eed Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki is riwayat se bhi ho sakti hai ke jab yeh aayat utri as-hab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bahut garan guzri. Pas yeh aayat utri (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke kul ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tum ho balkay tihayi tum ho balkay aadhon-aadh tum ho tum aadhi jannat ke maalik hoge aur baqi aadhi tamam ummaton mein taqseem hogi jin mein tum bhi shareek ho. Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Ibn-e-Asakir (R.H) mein hai Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne is aayat ko sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya agli ummaton mein se bahut log sabiqeen mein dakhil honge aur hum mein se kam log? Is ke ek saal ke baad yeh aayat nazil hui ke aglon mein se bhi bahut aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bula kar kaha suno Hazrat Adam (A.S) se le kar mujh tak thullah hai aur sirf meri ummat thullah hai, hum apne (thullah) ko pura karne ke liye un habshiyon ko bhi le lenge jo oont ke charwahe hain magar Allah Ta'ala ke wahid aur la-shareek hone ki shahadat dete hain. Lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein nazar hai, haan bahut si sanadon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman sabit hai ke mujhe umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi ho aakhir tak. Pas Alhamdulillah yeh ek behtareen khushkhabri hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne jis qaul ko pasand farmaya hai us mein zara gaur karne ki zaroorat hai balkay darasal yeh qaul bahut kamzor hai. Kyunke alfaaz-e-Quran se is ummat ka aur tamam ummaton se afzal-o-a'ala hona sabit hai, phir kaise ho sakta hai? Ke muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-samadiyat aur ummaton mein se toh bahut se hue aur is behtareen ummat mein se kam hon, haan yeh taujeeh ho sakti hai ke un tamam ummaton ke muqarrab mil kar sirf is ek ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad se barh jayen, lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke kul ummaton ke muqarrabeen se sirf is ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad zyada hogi. Aage Allah ko ilm hai. Dusra qaul is jumla ki tafseer mein yeh hai ke is ummat ke shuru zamane ke logon mein se muqarrabeen ki tadaad bahut zyada hai aur baad ke logon mein kam. Yehi qaul ra'ij hai. Chunancha Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marvi hai ke aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya sabiqeen toh guzar chuke ae Allah tu hamein as-hab-e-yameen mein kar de. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ummat mein se jo guzar chuke un mein muqarrabeen bahut the.

Imam Ibn-e-Sirin R.H bhi yahi farmate hain, koi shak nahin ke har ummat mein yahi hota chala aaya hai ke shuru mein bahut se muqarrabeen hote hain aur baad walon mein yeh tadaad kam ho jaati hai, toh yeh bhi mumkin hai ke muraad yunhi ho yani har ummat ke agle log sabqat karne wale zyada hote hain ba-nisbat har ummat ke pichle logon ke, chunancha Sahah wagairah ki ahadees se saabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya sab zamanon mein behtar zamana mera zamana hai phir us ke baad wala phir us ka mutassil zamana, al-kh. Haan ek hadees mein yeh bhi aaya meri ummat ki misaal baarish jaisi hai na maloom ke shuru zamane ki baarish behtar ho ya aakhir zamane ki, toh yeh hadees jab ke is ki asnaad ko sehat ka hukm de diya jaaye is amr par mahmool hai ke jis tarah deen ko shuru ke logon ki zaroorat thi jo is ki tableegh apne baad walon ko karein isi tarah aakhir mein bhi ise qaim rakhne walon ki zaroorat hai jo logon ko sunnat-e-Rasool par jamayein is ki riwayatein karein ise logon par zahir karein, lekin fazeelat awwal walon ki hi rahegi. Theek isi tarah jis tarah khet ko shuru baarish ki aur aakhri baarish ki zaroorat hoti hai lekin bada faida ibtidai baarish se hi hota hai is liye ke agar shuru shuru baarish na ho toh daane ugein hi nahin na un ki jadein jamein. Isi liye Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ek jamaat meri ummat mein se hamesha haq par reh kar ghalib rahegi un ke dushman unhein zarar na pahuncha sakenge, un ke mukhalif unhein ruswa aur past na kar sakenge yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho jayegi aur woh is tarah hon. Al-gharz yeh ummat baqi tamam ummaton se afzal-o-ashraf hai aur is mein muqarrabeen-e-Ilahiya ba-nisbat aur ummaton ke bahut hain, aur bahut bade martabe wale kyunke deen ke kaamil hone aur Nabi ke aali martaba hone ke lihaaz se yeh sab behtar hain. Tawaatur ke saath yeh hadees suboot ko pahunch chuki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya is ummat mein se sattar hazaar log baghair hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge aur har hazaar ke saath sattar hazaar aur honge, Tabrani mein hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum mein se ek bahut badi jamaat Qayamat ke roz khadi ki jayegi jo is qadar badi aur ginti mein zaaid hogi ke goya raat aa gayi zameen ke tamam kinaron ko ghera le gi farishte kehne lagenge sab nabiyon ke saath jitne log aaye hain un se bahut hi zyada Muhammad ﷺ ke saath hain.

Munasib maqam yeh hai ke "bahut badi jamaat aglon mein se aur bahut hi badi pichlon mein se" wali ayat ki tafsir ke mauqe par yeh hadith zikr kardi jaye jo Hafiz Abu Bakr Baihaqi (R.H) ne Dala'il-e-Nabuwwat mein warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab subah ki namaz padhte paon mode hue hi sattar martaba yeh padhte dua (SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi astaghfirullaha innallaha kana tawwaba) phir farmate sattar ke badle saat sau hain jis ke ek din ke gunah saat sau se bhi badh jayen woh be-khabar hai phir do martaba isi ko farmate phir logon ki taraf munh kar ke baithte aur chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khwab achha maloom hota tha is liye puchte ke kya tum mein se kisi ne koi khwab dekha hai? Abu Zumal kehte hain ek din isi tarah hasb-e-adat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya to main ne kaha haan ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne ek khwab dekha hai, farmaya Allah khair se milaye shar se bachaye hamare liye behtar banaye aur hamare dushmanon ke liye badtar banaye har qism ki tareefon ka mustahiq woh Allah hai jo tamam jahano ka palne wala hai, apna khwab bayan karo. Main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne dekha ke ek rasta hai kushada, aasaan, narm, saaf aur beshumar log is raste mein chale ja rahe hain yeh rasta jaate jaate ek sarsabz bagh ko nikalta hai ke meri aankhon ne aisa lehlahata hua hara bhara bagh kabhi nahin dekha pani har su rawan hai sabze se pata pada hai anwa-o-aqsam ke darakht khushnuma phale phoole khade hain ab main ne dekha ke pehli jamaat jo aayi aur is bagh ke paas pahunchi to unhon ne apni sawariyan tez kar lin dayen bayen nahin gaye aur tez raftari ke sath yahan se guzar gaye. Phir dusri jamaat aayi jo tadaad mein bahut zyada thi, jab yahan pahunche to baaz logon ne apne janwaron ko charana chugana shuru kiya aur baazon ne kuch le liya aur chal diye phir to bahut zyada log aaye jab un ka guzra in gul-o-gulzar par hua to yeh to phool gaye aur kehne lage yeh sab se achhi jagah hai goya main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh dayen bayen jhuk pade main ne yeh dekha lekin main Aap to chalta hi raha jab door nikal gaya to main ne dekha ke ek mimbar saat seedhiyon ka bicha hua hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ke aala darja par tashreef farma hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dayen janib ek sahib hain gandum-goon rang bhari ungliyon wale daraz qad jab kalam karte hain to sab khamoshi se sunte hain aur log unche ho ho kar tawajjuh se un ki baatein sunte hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki bayen taraf ek shakhs hain bhare jism ke darmiyana qad ke jin ke chehra par bakasrat til hain un ke baal goya pani se tar hain jab woh baat karte hain to un ke ikram ki wajah se sab log jhuk jate hain phir is se aage ek shakhs hain jo akhlaq-o-aadat mein aur chehre naqshe mein bilkul Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mushabahat rakhte hain, Aap log sab un ki taraf poori tawajjuh karte hain aur un ka irada rakhte hain.

Un se aagay ek dubli patli burhiya oontni hai, main ne dekha ke goya aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) usay utha rahe hain, yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho gaya, thodi der mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh halat badal gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Seedhay sachay aur sahih raastay se muraad toh woh Deen hai jisay main le kar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aaya hoon aur jis hidayat par tum ho. Hara bhara sabz baagh jo tum ne dekha hai woh duniya hai aur us ki aish-o-ishrat ka dil lubhanay wala saamaan. Main aur mere ashaab toh us se guzar jayenge, na tum us mein mashghool hoge, na woh hamain chimtay gi, na hamara talluq us se hoga, na us ka talluq hum se, na hum us ki chahat karenge, na woh hamain liptay gi. Phir hamaray baad doosri jamaat aayegi jo hum se tadaad mein bohat zyada hogi, un mein se ba'az toh is duniya mein phans jayenge aur ba'az ba-qadr-e-hajat le lenge aur chal denge aur nijaat pa lenge. Phir un ke baad zabardast jamaat aayegi jo is duniya mein bilkul mustaghraq ho jayegi aur daayen baayen behak jayegi. Aayat (فانا للہ وانا الیہ راجعون - Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un). Ab rahay tum, so tum apni seedhi raah chaltay rahoge yahan tak ke mujh se tumhari mulaqat ho jayegi. Jis mimbar ke aakhri saaton darjay par tum ne mujhe dekha us ki ta'beer yeh hai ke duniya ki umr saat hazaar saal ki hai, main aakhri hazaarwein saal mein hoon. Mere daayen jis gundumi rang moti hatheli walay insaan ko tum ne dekha woh Hazrat Musa (A.S) hain, jab woh kalaam karte hain toh log oonchay ho jatay hain is liye ke unhain Allah Ta'ala se sharaf-e-hum-kalami ho chuka hai. Aur jinhein tum ne mere baayen dekha jo darmiyana qad ke bharay jism ke bohat se tallon walay thay jin ke baal paani se tar nazar aatay thay, woh Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) hain, chunke un ka ikraam Allah Ta'ala ne kiya hai hum sab bhi un ki buzurgi karte hain. Aur jin sheikh ko tum ne bilkul mujh sa dekha woh hamaray baap Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain, hum sab un ka qasd karte hain aur un ki iqtida aur tabedari karte hain. Aur jis oontni ko tum ne dekha ke main usay khadi kar raha hoon, us se muraad Qayamat hai jo meri ummat par qaim hogi, na mere baad koi Nabi aayega, na meri ummat ke baad koi ummat hai. Farmatay hain is ke baad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh poochna chhod diya ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Haan agar koi shakhs apnay aap apna khwab bayan kar de toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ta'beer de diya kartay thay. Un ke baithnay ke takht aur aaram karnay ke palang sonay ke taaron se banay huay honge jin mein jagah jagah moti takay huay honge, dur-o-yaqoot juray huay honge. Yeh fa'eel ma'ani mein maf'ool ke hai is liye oontni ke pait ke neechay walay ko wazeem kehtay hain. Sab ke munh ek doosray ke samnay honge, koi kisi ki taraf peeth diye huay na hoga. Woh ulama un ki khidmat guzari mein mashghool honge jo umr mein waisay hi chhotay rahenge, na baday hon na burhay hon. Na un mein taghayyur-o-tabdeel aaye. Akwaab kehtay hain un koonzon ko jin ki tonti aur pakarnay ki cheez na ho aur abaareeq woh aaftabay jo tonti-daar aur pakray janay ke qabil hon.

Yeh sab sharab ki jaari nahar se chalkte hue honge jo sharab na khatam ho na kam ho kyunke uske chashme beh rahe hain, jaam chalkte hue har waqt apne nazuk hathon mein liye hue yeh gul-andam saqi idhar udhar gasht kar rahe honge. Is sharab se unhein dard-e-sar ho na unki aql zail ho balkay bawajood pooray suroor aur kaif ke aql-o-hawas apni jagah qaim rahenge aur kamil lazzat hasil hogi. Sharab mein chaar sifatein hain nasha, sar dard, qai aur peshab, pas Parwardigar-e-Alam ne jannat ki sharab ka zikr kar ke un charon nuqsanat ki nafi kardi ke woh sharab un nuqsanat se pak hai. Phir qisam qisam ke meway aur tarah tarah ke parindon ke gosht unhein milenge jis meway ko jee chahey aur jis tarah ke gosht ki taraf dil ki raghbat ho majood ho jayega, yeh tamam cheezein liye hue unke saleeqa-e-shiar khuddam har waqt unke ird gird ghoomte rahenge taake jis cheez ki jab kabhi khwahish ho le lein, is ayat mein daleel hai ke aadmi meway chun chun kar apni khwahish ke mutabiq kha sakta hai, Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosli mein hai Hazrat Akrash bin Zuwaib (R.A) farmate hain ke apni qoum ke sadqa ke maal le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap (ﷺ) Muhajireen aur Ansar mein tashreef farma thay mere saath zakat ke bohat se oont thay goya ke woh rait ke darakhton ke charay hue naujawan oont hain aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum kaun ho? Main ne kaha Akrash bin Zuwaib farmaya apna nasab nama door tak bayan kardo main ne Murrah bin Dubaik tak keh sunaya aur saath hi kaha ke zakat Murrah bin Ubaid ki hai pas Huzoor (ﷺ) muskuraye aur farmane lage yeh meri qoum ke oont hain yeh meri qoum ke sadqa ka maal hai phir hukum diya ke sadqay ke oonton ke nishan un par kardo aur unke saath inhein bhi mila do phir mera haath pakar kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) ke ghar tashreef laye aur farmaya kuch khanay ko hai? Jawab mila ke haan chunancha ek baray lagan mein tukray tukray ki hui roti aayi aap (ﷺ) ne aur main ne khana shuru kiya. Main idhar udhar se niwalay lene laga aap (ﷺ) ne apne haath se mera dahina haath thaam liya, aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh to ek qisam ka khana hai ek jagah se khao. Phir ek seeni tar khajooron khushk khajooron ki aayi main ne sirf mere samnay jo thin unhein khana shuru kiya haan Rasool Allah (ﷺ) seeni ke idhar udhar se jahan se jo pasand aati thi le lete thay aur mujh se bhi farmaya ae Akrash is mein har tarah ki khajoorein hain jahan se chaho khao jis qisam ki khajoor chaho le lo, phir pani aaya pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne haath dhoye aur wahi tar haath apne chehray par aur dono bazoo'on aur sar par teen dafa pher liye aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh wuzu hai us cheez se jisay aag ne mutaghayyar kiya ho. (Tirmizi aur Ibn-e-Majah) Imam Tirmizi isay ghareeb batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko khwab pasand tha basa auqat aap (ﷺ) pooch liya karte thay ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Agar koi zikr karta aur phir Huzoor (ﷺ) us khwab se khush hote to usay bohat acha lagta.

Ek martaba ek aurat Aap ﷺ ke paas aayin kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne aaj ek khwab dekha hai ke goya mere paas koi aaya aur mujhe Madina se le chala aur Jannat mein pahuncha diya phir main ne yakayak dhamaka suna jis se Jannat mein halchal mach gayi main ne jo nazar utha kar dekha to falan bin falan aur falan bin falan ko dekha barah shakhson ke naam liye unhein barah shakhson ka ek lashkar bana kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne kayi din huye ek muhim par rawana kiya hua tha farmati hain unhein laya gaya yeh atlas ke kapde pehne huye the un ki ragein josh maar rahi thin hukm hua ke unhein nehar-e-baidaj mein le jao ya baizak kaha, jab un logon ne is nehar mein ghota lagaya to un ke chehre chaudahvin raat ke chand ki tarah chamakne lag gaye phir ek sone ki sini mein gadri khajoorein aayin jo unhon ne apni hasb-e-mansha khayin aur sath hi har tarah ke meway jo charon taraf chune huye the jis meway ko un ka ji chahta tha lete the aur khate the main ne bhi un ke sath shirkat ki aur woh meway khaye, muddat ke baad ek qasid aaya aur kaha falan falan ashkhas jinhein Aap ﷺ ne lashkar mein bheja tha shaheed ho gaye theek barah shakhson ke naam liye aur yeh wohi naam the jinhein is biwi sahiba ne apne khwab mein dekha tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne un nek-bakht sahabi-e ko phir bulwaya aur farmaya apna khwab dobara bayan karo us ne phir bayan kiya aur unhi logon ke naam liye jin ke naam qasid ne liye the. Tabrani mein hai ke Jannati jis meway ko darakht se tode ga wahin is jaisa aur phal lag jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Jannati parind bakhti aur oont ke barabar hain jo Jannat mein charte chugte rehte hain, Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ yeh parind to nihayat hi mazay ke honge, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un ke khane wale un se bhi zyada naaz-o-nemat wale honge. Teen martaba yahi jumla irshad farma kar phir farmaya mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke ae Abu Bakr tum un mein se ho jo un parindon ka gosht khayenge. Hafiz Abu Abdullah Misri ki kitab Sifat-ul-Jannah mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ke samne Tuba ka zikr hua pas Huzoor ﷺ ne Huzoor Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho Tuba kya hai? Aap R.A ne jawab diya Allah aur us ke Rasool ko pura ilm hai Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Jannat ka ek darakht hai jis ki tulani ka ilm siwaye Allah ke aur kisi ko nahin is ki ek ek shakh tale tez sawar sattar sattar saal tak chala jaye ga. Phir bhi is ka saya khatam na hua is ke patte bade chaure chaure hain un par bakhti oontni ke barabar parind aa kar baithte hain, Abu Bakr R.A ne farmaya phir to yeh parind badi hi nematon wale honge Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un se zyada nematon wale un ke khane wale honge aur Insha'Allah tum bhi unhi mein se ho. Hazrat Qatada R.H se bhi yeh pichla hissa marwi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi-ud-Dunya mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Kausar ki babat sawal hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh Jannati nehar hai jo mujhe Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne ata farmayi hai, doodh se zyada safed aur shehad se zyada meetha iska pani hai, iske kinare bakhti oonton ki gardanon jaise parind hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya woh parind toh bade maze mein hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya unka khane wala unse zyada maze mein hai. (Tirmidhi). Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan kehte hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannat mein ek parind hai jiske sattar hazar par hain, Jannati ke dastarkhwan par woh aayega aur uske har par se ek qism niklegi jo doodh se zyada safed aur makkhan se zyada narm aur shehad se zyada meethi, phir dusre par se dusri qism niklegi, isi tarah har par se ek dusre se judagana, phir woh parind ud jayega. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur iske rawi Rasani aur unke ustad dono zaeef hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) se marwi hai ke Jannati parind misl-e-bakhti oonton ke hain jo Jannat ke phal khate hain aur Jannat ki nehron ka pani peete hain, Jannatiyon ka dil jis parind ke khane ko chahega woh uske samne aa jayega, woh jitna chahega jis pehlu ka gosht pasand karega khayega, phir woh parind ud jayega aur jaisa tha waisa hi hoga. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat ke jis parind ko tu chahega woh bhuna-bhunaya tere samne aa jayega.

Hoor ki dusri qira'at re ke zer se bhi hai. Pesh se toh matlab hai ke Jannatiyon ke liye hoorein hongi aur zer se yeh matlab hai ke goya agle a'raab ki mat-huti mein yeh a'raab bhi hai, jaise aayat (Wamsahu bi-ru'usikum wa arjulakum ilal-ka'bain) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 6) mein zabar ki qira'at hai aur jaise ke aayat (Aliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun wa istabraq) (Surah Al-Insan: 21) hain. Aur yeh ma'ani bhi ho sakte hain ke ghilman apne sath hoorein bhi liye hue honge lekin unke mahalaat mein aur khaimon mein na ke aam taur par, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh hoorein aisi hongi jaise tar-o-taza safed saaf moti hon, jaise Surah Saffat mein hai aayat (Ka'annahunna baidun maknoon) (Surah As-Saffat: 49). Surah Ar-Rahman mein bhi yeh wasf ma'a tafseer guzar chuka hai. Yeh unke nek a'maal ka sila aur badla hai yani yeh tohfe unki husn-e-karguzari ka inaam hain. Yeh Jannat mein laghw, behuda, be-ma'ani, khilaf-e-tab' koi kalma bhi na sunenge, haqarat aur burai ka ek lafz bhi kaan mein na padega, jaise aur aayat mein hai (La tasma'u feeha laghiyatan) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 11). Fuzool kalami se unke kaan mehfooz rahenge. Na koi qabeeh kalam kaan mein padega. Haan sirf salamti bhare salam ke kalmaat ek dusron ko kahenge, jaise aur jagah irshad farmaya aayat (Tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun) (Surah Ibrahim: 23). Inka tohfa aapas mein ek dusre ko salam karna hoga. Inki baat-cheet laghwiyat aur gunah se paak hogi.

Muqarrabeen kaun hain? Aur awwaleen kaun? Irshad hota hai ke muqarrabeen-e-khas bahut se pehle ke hain aur kuch pichlon mein se bhi hain, in awwaleen-o-akhireen ki tafseer mein kayi qaul hain, maslan agli ummaton mein se aur is ummat mein se, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isi qaul ko pasand karte hain aur is hadith ko bhi is qaul ki pukhtagi mein pesh karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hum pichle hain aur Qayamat ke din pehle hain aur is qaul ki ta'eed Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki is riwayat se bhi ho sakti hai ke jab yeh aayat utri as-hab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bahut garan guzri. Pas yeh aayat utri (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke kul ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tum ho balkay tihayi tum ho balkay aadhon-aadh tum ho tum aadhi jannat ke maalik hoge aur baqi aadhi tamam ummaton mein taqseem hogi jin mein tum bhi shareek ho. Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Ibn-e-Asakir (R.H) mein hai Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne is aayat ko sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya agli ummaton mein se bahut log sabiqeen mein dakhil honge aur hum mein se kam log? Is ke ek saal ke baad yeh aayat nazil hui ke aglon mein se bhi bahut aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bula kar kaha suno Hazrat Adam (A.S) se le kar mujh tak thullah hai aur sirf meri ummat thullah hai, hum apne (thullah) ko pura karne ke liye un habshiyon ko bhi le lenge jo oont ke charwahe hain magar Allah Ta'ala ke wahid aur la-shareek hone ki shahadat dete hain. Lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein nazar hai, haan bahut si sanadon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman sabit hai ke mujhe umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi ho aakhir tak. Pas Alhamdulillah yeh ek behtareen khushkhabri hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne jis qaul ko pasand farmaya hai us mein zara gaur karne ki zaroorat hai balkay darasal yeh qaul bahut kamzor hai. Kyunke alfaaz-e-Quran se is ummat ka aur tamam ummaton se afzal-o-a'ala hona sabit hai, phir kaise ho sakta hai? Ke muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-samadiyat aur ummaton mein se toh bahut se hue aur is behtareen ummat mein se kam hon, haan yeh taujeeh ho sakti hai ke un tamam ummaton ke muqarrab mil kar sirf is ek ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad se barh jayen, lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke kul ummaton ke muqarrabeen se sirf is ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad zyada hogi. Aage Allah ko ilm hai. Dusra qaul is jumla ki tafseer mein yeh hai ke is ummat ke shuru zamane ke logon mein se muqarrabeen ki tadaad bahut zyada hai aur baad ke logon mein kam. Yehi qaul ra'ij hai. Chunancha Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marvi hai ke aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya sabiqeen toh guzar chuke ae Allah tu hamein as-hab-e-yameen mein kar de. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ummat mein se jo guzar chuke un mein muqarrabeen bahut the.

Imam Ibn-e-Sirin R.H bhi yahi farmate hain, koi shak nahin ke har ummat mein yahi hota chala aaya hai ke shuru mein bahut se muqarrabeen hote hain aur baad walon mein yeh tadaad kam ho jaati hai, toh yeh bhi mumkin hai ke muraad yunhi ho yani har ummat ke agle log sabqat karne wale zyada hote hain ba-nisbat har ummat ke pichle logon ke, chunancha Sahah wagairah ki ahadees se saabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya sab zamanon mein behtar zamana mera zamana hai phir us ke baad wala phir us ka mutassil zamana, al-kh. Haan ek hadees mein yeh bhi aaya meri ummat ki misaal baarish jaisi hai na maloom ke shuru zamane ki baarish behtar ho ya aakhir zamane ki, toh yeh hadees jab ke is ki asnaad ko sehat ka hukm de diya jaaye is amr par mahmool hai ke jis tarah deen ko shuru ke logon ki zaroorat thi jo is ki tableegh apne baad walon ko karein isi tarah aakhir mein bhi ise qaim rakhne walon ki zaroorat hai jo logon ko sunnat-e-Rasool par jamayein is ki riwayatein karein ise logon par zahir karein, lekin fazeelat awwal walon ki hi rahegi. Theek isi tarah jis tarah khet ko shuru baarish ki aur aakhri baarish ki zaroorat hoti hai lekin bada faida ibtidai baarish se hi hota hai is liye ke agar shuru shuru baarish na ho toh daane ugein hi nahin na un ki jadein jamein. Isi liye Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ek jamaat meri ummat mein se hamesha haq par reh kar ghalib rahegi un ke dushman unhein zarar na pahuncha sakenge, un ke mukhalif unhein ruswa aur past na kar sakenge yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho jayegi aur woh is tarah hon. Al-gharz yeh ummat baqi tamam ummaton se afzal-o-ashraf hai aur is mein muqarrabeen-e-Ilahiya ba-nisbat aur ummaton ke bahut hain, aur bahut bade martabe wale kyunke deen ke kaamil hone aur Nabi ke aali martaba hone ke lihaaz se yeh sab behtar hain. Tawaatur ke saath yeh hadees suboot ko pahunch chuki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya is ummat mein se sattar hazaar log baghair hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge aur har hazaar ke saath sattar hazaar aur honge, Tabrani mein hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum mein se ek bahut badi jamaat Qayamat ke roz khadi ki jayegi jo is qadar badi aur ginti mein zaaid hogi ke goya raat aa gayi zameen ke tamam kinaron ko ghera le gi farishte kehne lagenge sab nabiyon ke saath jitne log aaye hain un se bahut hi zyada Muhammad ﷺ ke saath hain.

Munasib maqam yeh hai ke "bahut badi jamaat aglon mein se aur bahut hi badi pichlon mein se" wali ayat ki tafsir ke mauqe par yeh hadith zikr kardi jaye jo Hafiz Abu Bakr Baihaqi (R.H) ne Dala'il-e-Nabuwwat mein warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab subah ki namaz padhte paon mode hue hi sattar martaba yeh padhte dua (SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi astaghfirullaha innallaha kana tawwaba) phir farmate sattar ke badle saat sau hain jis ke ek din ke gunah saat sau se bhi badh jayen woh be-khabar hai phir do martaba isi ko farmate phir logon ki taraf munh kar ke baithte aur chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khwab achha maloom hota tha is liye puchte ke kya tum mein se kisi ne koi khwab dekha hai? Abu Zumal kehte hain ek din isi tarah hasb-e-adat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya to main ne kaha haan ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne ek khwab dekha hai, farmaya Allah khair se milaye shar se bachaye hamare liye behtar banaye aur hamare dushmanon ke liye badtar banaye har qism ki tareefon ka mustahiq woh Allah hai jo tamam jahano ka palne wala hai, apna khwab bayan karo. Main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne dekha ke ek rasta hai kushada, aasaan, narm, saaf aur beshumar log is raste mein chale ja rahe hain yeh rasta jaate jaate ek sarsabz bagh ko nikalta hai ke meri aankhon ne aisa lehlahata hua hara bhara bagh kabhi nahin dekha pani har su rawan hai sabze se pata pada hai anwa-o-aqsam ke darakht khushnuma phale phoole khade hain ab main ne dekha ke pehli jamaat jo aayi aur is bagh ke paas pahunchi to unhon ne apni sawariyan tez kar lin dayen bayen nahin gaye aur tez raftari ke sath yahan se guzar gaye. Phir dusri jamaat aayi jo tadaad mein bahut zyada thi, jab yahan pahunche to baaz logon ne apne janwaron ko charana chugana shuru kiya aur baazon ne kuch le liya aur chal diye phir to bahut zyada log aaye jab un ka guzra in gul-o-gulzar par hua to yeh to phool gaye aur kehne lage yeh sab se achhi jagah hai goya main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh dayen bayen jhuk pade main ne yeh dekha lekin main Aap to chalta hi raha jab door nikal gaya to main ne dekha ke ek mimbar saat seedhiyon ka bicha hua hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ke aala darja par tashreef farma hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dayen janib ek sahib hain gandum-goon rang bhari ungliyon wale daraz qad jab kalam karte hain to sab khamoshi se sunte hain aur log unche ho ho kar tawajjuh se un ki baatein sunte hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki bayen taraf ek shakhs hain bhare jism ke darmiyana qad ke jin ke chehra par bakasrat til hain un ke baal goya pani se tar hain jab woh baat karte hain to un ke ikram ki wajah se sab log jhuk jate hain phir is se aage ek shakhs hain jo akhlaq-o-aadat mein aur chehre naqshe mein bilkul Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mushabahat rakhte hain, Aap log sab un ki taraf poori tawajjuh karte hain aur un ka irada rakhte hain.

Un se aagay ek dubli patli burhiya oontni hai, main ne dekha ke goya aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) usay utha rahe hain, yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho gaya, thodi der mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh halat badal gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Seedhay sachay aur sahih raastay se muraad toh woh Deen hai jisay main le kar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aaya hoon aur jis hidayat par tum ho. Hara bhara sabz baagh jo tum ne dekha hai woh duniya hai aur us ki aish-o-ishrat ka dil lubhanay wala saamaan. Main aur mere ashaab toh us se guzar jayenge, na tum us mein mashghool hoge, na woh hamain chimtay gi, na hamara talluq us se hoga, na us ka talluq hum se, na hum us ki chahat karenge, na woh hamain liptay gi. Phir hamaray baad doosri jamaat aayegi jo hum se tadaad mein bohat zyada hogi, un mein se ba'az toh is duniya mein phans jayenge aur ba'az ba-qadr-e-hajat le lenge aur chal denge aur nijaat pa lenge. Phir un ke baad zabardast jamaat aayegi jo is duniya mein bilkul mustaghraq ho jayegi aur daayen baayen behak jayegi. Aayat (فانا للہ وانا الیہ راجعون - Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un). Ab rahay tum, so tum apni seedhi raah chaltay rahoge yahan tak ke mujh se tumhari mulaqat ho jayegi. Jis mimbar ke aakhri saaton darjay par tum ne mujhe dekha us ki ta'beer yeh hai ke duniya ki umr saat hazaar saal ki hai, main aakhri hazaarwein saal mein hoon. Mere daayen jis gundumi rang moti hatheli walay insaan ko tum ne dekha woh Hazrat Musa (A.S) hain, jab woh kalaam karte hain toh log oonchay ho jatay hain is liye ke unhain Allah Ta'ala se sharaf-e-hum-kalami ho chuka hai. Aur jinhein tum ne mere baayen dekha jo darmiyana qad ke bharay jism ke bohat se tallon walay thay jin ke baal paani se tar nazar aatay thay, woh Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) hain, chunke un ka ikraam Allah Ta'ala ne kiya hai hum sab bhi un ki buzurgi karte hain. Aur jin sheikh ko tum ne bilkul mujh sa dekha woh hamaray baap Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain, hum sab un ka qasd karte hain aur un ki iqtida aur tabedari karte hain. Aur jis oontni ko tum ne dekha ke main usay khadi kar raha hoon, us se muraad Qayamat hai jo meri ummat par qaim hogi, na mere baad koi Nabi aayega, na meri ummat ke baad koi ummat hai. Farmatay hain is ke baad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh poochna chhod diya ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Haan agar koi shakhs apnay aap apna khwab bayan kar de toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ta'beer de diya kartay thay. Un ke baithnay ke takht aur aaram karnay ke palang sonay ke taaron se banay huay honge jin mein jagah jagah moti takay huay honge, dur-o-yaqoot juray huay honge. Yeh fa'eel ma'ani mein maf'ool ke hai is liye oontni ke pait ke neechay walay ko wazeem kehtay hain. Sab ke munh ek doosray ke samnay honge, koi kisi ki taraf peeth diye huay na hoga. Woh ulama un ki khidmat guzari mein mashghool honge jo umr mein waisay hi chhotay rahenge, na baday hon na burhay hon. Na un mein taghayyur-o-tabdeel aaye. Akwaab kehtay hain un koonzon ko jin ki tonti aur pakarnay ki cheez na ho aur abaareeq woh aaftabay jo tonti-daar aur pakray janay ke qabil hon.

Yeh sab sharab ki jaari nahar se chalkte hue honge jo sharab na khatam ho na kam ho kyunke uske chashme beh rahe hain, jaam chalkte hue har waqt apne nazuk hathon mein liye hue yeh gul-andam saqi idhar udhar gasht kar rahe honge. Is sharab se unhein dard-e-sar ho na unki aql zail ho balkay bawajood pooray suroor aur kaif ke aql-o-hawas apni jagah qaim rahenge aur kamil lazzat hasil hogi. Sharab mein chaar sifatein hain nasha, sar dard, qai aur peshab, pas Parwardigar-e-Alam ne jannat ki sharab ka zikr kar ke un charon nuqsanat ki nafi kardi ke woh sharab un nuqsanat se pak hai. Phir qisam qisam ke meway aur tarah tarah ke parindon ke gosht unhein milenge jis meway ko jee chahey aur jis tarah ke gosht ki taraf dil ki raghbat ho majood ho jayega, yeh tamam cheezein liye hue unke saleeqa-e-shiar khuddam har waqt unke ird gird ghoomte rahenge taake jis cheez ki jab kabhi khwahish ho le lein, is ayat mein daleel hai ke aadmi meway chun chun kar apni khwahish ke mutabiq kha sakta hai, Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosli mein hai Hazrat Akrash bin Zuwaib (R.A) farmate hain ke apni qoum ke sadqa ke maal le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap (ﷺ) Muhajireen aur Ansar mein tashreef farma thay mere saath zakat ke bohat se oont thay goya ke woh rait ke darakhton ke charay hue naujawan oont hain aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum kaun ho? Main ne kaha Akrash bin Zuwaib farmaya apna nasab nama door tak bayan kardo main ne Murrah bin Dubaik tak keh sunaya aur saath hi kaha ke zakat Murrah bin Ubaid ki hai pas Huzoor (ﷺ) muskuraye aur farmane lage yeh meri qoum ke oont hain yeh meri qoum ke sadqa ka maal hai phir hukum diya ke sadqay ke oonton ke nishan un par kardo aur unke saath inhein bhi mila do phir mera haath pakar kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) ke ghar tashreef laye aur farmaya kuch khanay ko hai? Jawab mila ke haan chunancha ek baray lagan mein tukray tukray ki hui roti aayi aap (ﷺ) ne aur main ne khana shuru kiya. Main idhar udhar se niwalay lene laga aap (ﷺ) ne apne haath se mera dahina haath thaam liya, aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh to ek qisam ka khana hai ek jagah se khao. Phir ek seeni tar khajooron khushk khajooron ki aayi main ne sirf mere samnay jo thin unhein khana shuru kiya haan Rasool Allah (ﷺ) seeni ke idhar udhar se jahan se jo pasand aati thi le lete thay aur mujh se bhi farmaya ae Akrash is mein har tarah ki khajoorein hain jahan se chaho khao jis qisam ki khajoor chaho le lo, phir pani aaya pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne haath dhoye aur wahi tar haath apne chehray par aur dono bazoo'on aur sar par teen dafa pher liye aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh wuzu hai us cheez se jisay aag ne mutaghayyar kiya ho. (Tirmizi aur Ibn-e-Majah) Imam Tirmizi isay ghareeb batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko khwab pasand tha basa auqat aap (ﷺ) pooch liya karte thay ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Agar koi zikr karta aur phir Huzoor (ﷺ) us khwab se khush hote to usay bohat acha lagta.

Ek martaba ek aurat Aap ﷺ ke paas aayin kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne aaj ek khwab dekha hai ke goya mere paas koi aaya aur mujhe Madina se le chala aur Jannat mein pahuncha diya phir main ne yakayak dhamaka suna jis se Jannat mein halchal mach gayi main ne jo nazar utha kar dekha to falan bin falan aur falan bin falan ko dekha barah shakhson ke naam liye unhein barah shakhson ka ek lashkar bana kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne kayi din huye ek muhim par rawana kiya hua tha farmati hain unhein laya gaya yeh atlas ke kapde pehne huye the un ki ragein josh maar rahi thin hukm hua ke unhein nehar-e-baidaj mein le jao ya baizak kaha, jab un logon ne is nehar mein ghota lagaya to un ke chehre chaudahvin raat ke chand ki tarah chamakne lag gaye phir ek sone ki sini mein gadri khajoorein aayin jo unhon ne apni hasb-e-mansha khayin aur sath hi har tarah ke meway jo charon taraf chune huye the jis meway ko un ka ji chahta tha lete the aur khate the main ne bhi un ke sath shirkat ki aur woh meway khaye, muddat ke baad ek qasid aaya aur kaha falan falan ashkhas jinhein Aap ﷺ ne lashkar mein bheja tha shaheed ho gaye theek barah shakhson ke naam liye aur yeh wohi naam the jinhein is biwi sahiba ne apne khwab mein dekha tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne un nek-bakht sahabi-e ko phir bulwaya aur farmaya apna khwab dobara bayan karo us ne phir bayan kiya aur unhi logon ke naam liye jin ke naam qasid ne liye the. Tabrani mein hai ke Jannati jis meway ko darakht se tode ga wahin is jaisa aur phal lag jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Jannati parind bakhti aur oont ke barabar hain jo Jannat mein charte chugte rehte hain, Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ yeh parind to nihayat hi mazay ke honge, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un ke khane wale un se bhi zyada naaz-o-nemat wale honge. Teen martaba yahi jumla irshad farma kar phir farmaya mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke ae Abu Bakr tum un mein se ho jo un parindon ka gosht khayenge. Hafiz Abu Abdullah Misri ki kitab Sifat-ul-Jannah mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ke samne Tuba ka zikr hua pas Huzoor ﷺ ne Huzoor Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho Tuba kya hai? Aap R.A ne jawab diya Allah aur us ke Rasool ko pura ilm hai Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Jannat ka ek darakht hai jis ki tulani ka ilm siwaye Allah ke aur kisi ko nahin is ki ek ek shakh tale tez sawar sattar sattar saal tak chala jaye ga. Phir bhi is ka saya khatam na hua is ke patte bade chaure chaure hain un par bakhti oontni ke barabar parind aa kar baithte hain, Abu Bakr R.A ne farmaya phir to yeh parind badi hi nematon wale honge Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un se zyada nematon wale un ke khane wale honge aur Insha'Allah tum bhi unhi mein se ho. Hazrat Qatada R.H se bhi yeh pichla hissa marwi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi-ud-Dunya mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Kausar ki babat sawal hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh Jannati nehar hai jo mujhe Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne ata farmayi hai, doodh se zyada safed aur shehad se zyada meetha iska pani hai, iske kinare bakhti oonton ki gardanon jaise parind hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya woh parind toh bade maze mein hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya unka khane wala unse zyada maze mein hai. (Tirmidhi). Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan kehte hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannat mein ek parind hai jiske sattar hazar par hain, Jannati ke dastarkhwan par woh aayega aur uske har par se ek qism niklegi jo doodh se zyada safed aur makkhan se zyada narm aur shehad se zyada meethi, phir dusre par se dusri qism niklegi, isi tarah har par se ek dusre se judagana, phir woh parind ud jayega. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur iske rawi Rasani aur unke ustad dono zaeef hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) se marwi hai ke Jannati parind misl-e-bakhti oonton ke hain jo Jannat ke phal khate hain aur Jannat ki nehron ka pani peete hain, Jannatiyon ka dil jis parind ke khane ko chahega woh uske samne aa jayega, woh jitna chahega jis pehlu ka gosht pasand karega khayega, phir woh parind ud jayega aur jaisa tha waisa hi hoga. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat ke jis parind ko tu chahega woh bhuna-bhunaya tere samne aa jayega.

Hoor ki dusri qira'at re ke zer se bhi hai. Pesh se toh matlab hai ke Jannatiyon ke liye hoorein hongi aur zer se yeh matlab hai ke goya agle a'raab ki mat-huti mein yeh a'raab bhi hai, jaise aayat (Wamsahu bi-ru'usikum wa arjulakum ilal-ka'bain) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 6) mein zabar ki qira'at hai aur jaise ke aayat (Aliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun wa istabraq) (Surah Al-Insan: 21) hain. Aur yeh ma'ani bhi ho sakte hain ke ghilman apne sath hoorein bhi liye hue honge lekin unke mahalaat mein aur khaimon mein na ke aam taur par, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh hoorein aisi hongi jaise tar-o-taza safed saaf moti hon, jaise Surah Saffat mein hai aayat (Ka'annahunna baidun maknoon) (Surah As-Saffat: 49). Surah Ar-Rahman mein bhi yeh wasf ma'a tafseer guzar chuka hai. Yeh unke nek a'maal ka sila aur badla hai yani yeh tohfe unki husn-e-karguzari ka inaam hain. Yeh Jannat mein laghw, behuda, be-ma'ani, khilaf-e-tab' koi kalma bhi na sunenge, haqarat aur burai ka ek lafz bhi kaan mein na padega, jaise aur aayat mein hai (La tasma'u feeha laghiyatan) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 11). Fuzool kalami se unke kaan mehfooz rahenge. Na koi qabeeh kalam kaan mein padega. Haan sirf salamti bhare salam ke kalmaat ek dusron ko kahenge, jaise aur jagah irshad farmaya aayat (Tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun) (Surah Ibrahim: 23). Inka tohfa aapas mein ek dusre ko salam karna hoga. Inki baat-cheet laghwiyat aur gunah se paak hogi.

Muqarrabeen kaun hain? Aur awwaleen kaun? Irshad hota hai ke muqarrabeen-e-khas bahut se pehle ke hain aur kuch pichlon mein se bhi hain, in awwaleen-o-akhireen ki tafseer mein kayi qaul hain, maslan agli ummaton mein se aur is ummat mein se, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isi qaul ko pasand karte hain aur is hadith ko bhi is qaul ki pukhtagi mein pesh karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hum pichle hain aur Qayamat ke din pehle hain aur is qaul ki ta'eed Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki is riwayat se bhi ho sakti hai ke jab yeh aayat utri as-hab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bahut garan guzri. Pas yeh aayat utri (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) toh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke kul ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tum ho balkay tihayi tum ho balkay aadhon-aadh tum ho tum aadhi jannat ke maalik hoge aur baqi aadhi tamam ummaton mein taqseem hogi jin mein tum bhi shareek ho. Yeh hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Ibn-e-Asakir (R.H) mein hai Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne is aayat ko sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya agli ummaton mein se bahut log sabiqeen mein dakhil honge aur hum mein se kam log? Is ke ek saal ke baad yeh aayat nazil hui ke aglon mein se bhi bahut aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bula kar kaha suno Hazrat Adam (A.S) se le kar mujh tak thullah hai aur sirf meri ummat thullah hai, hum apne (thullah) ko pura karne ke liye un habshiyon ko bhi le lenge jo oont ke charwahe hain magar Allah Ta'ala ke wahid aur la-shareek hone ki shahadat dete hain. Lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein nazar hai, haan bahut si sanadon ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman sabit hai ke mujhe umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi ho aakhir tak. Pas Alhamdulillah yeh ek behtareen khushkhabri hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne jis qaul ko pasand farmaya hai us mein zara gaur karne ki zaroorat hai balkay darasal yeh qaul bahut kamzor hai. Kyunke alfaaz-e-Quran se is ummat ka aur tamam ummaton se afzal-o-a'ala hona sabit hai, phir kaise ho sakta hai? Ke muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-samadiyat aur ummaton mein se toh bahut se hue aur is behtareen ummat mein se kam hon, haan yeh taujeeh ho sakti hai ke un tamam ummaton ke muqarrab mil kar sirf is ek ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad se barh jayen, lekin ba-zahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke kul ummaton ke muqarrabeen se sirf is ummat ke muqarrabeen ki tadaad zyada hogi. Aage Allah ko ilm hai. Dusra qaul is jumla ki tafseer mein yeh hai ke is ummat ke shuru zamane ke logon mein se muqarrabeen ki tadaad bahut zyada hai aur baad ke logon mein kam. Yehi qaul ra'ij hai. Chunancha Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marvi hai ke aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya sabiqeen toh guzar chuke ae Allah tu hamein as-hab-e-yameen mein kar de. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ummat mein se jo guzar chuke un mein muqarrabeen bahut the.

Imam Ibn-e-Sirin R.H bhi yahi farmate hain, koi shak nahin ke har ummat mein yahi hota chala aaya hai ke shuru mein bahut se muqarrabeen hote hain aur baad walon mein yeh tadaad kam ho jaati hai, toh yeh bhi mumkin hai ke muraad yunhi ho yani har ummat ke agle log sabqat karne wale zyada hote hain ba-nisbat har ummat ke pichle logon ke, chunancha Sahah wagairah ki ahadees se saabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya sab zamanon mein behtar zamana mera zamana hai phir us ke baad wala phir us ka mutassil zamana, al-kh. Haan ek hadees mein yeh bhi aaya meri ummat ki misaal baarish jaisi hai na maloom ke shuru zamane ki baarish behtar ho ya aakhir zamane ki, toh yeh hadees jab ke is ki asnaad ko sehat ka hukm de diya jaaye is amr par mahmool hai ke jis tarah deen ko shuru ke logon ki zaroorat thi jo is ki tableegh apne baad walon ko karein isi tarah aakhir mein bhi ise qaim rakhne walon ki zaroorat hai jo logon ko sunnat-e-Rasool par jamayein is ki riwayatein karein ise logon par zahir karein, lekin fazeelat awwal walon ki hi rahegi. Theek isi tarah jis tarah khet ko shuru baarish ki aur aakhri baarish ki zaroorat hoti hai lekin bada faida ibtidai baarish se hi hota hai is liye ke agar shuru shuru baarish na ho toh daane ugein hi nahin na un ki jadein jamein. Isi liye Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ek jamaat meri ummat mein se hamesha haq par reh kar ghalib rahegi un ke dushman unhein zarar na pahuncha sakenge, un ke mukhalif unhein ruswa aur past na kar sakenge yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho jayegi aur woh is tarah hon. Al-gharz yeh ummat baqi tamam ummaton se afzal-o-ashraf hai aur is mein muqarrabeen-e-Ilahiya ba-nisbat aur ummaton ke bahut hain, aur bahut bade martabe wale kyunke deen ke kaamil hone aur Nabi ke aali martaba hone ke lihaaz se yeh sab behtar hain. Tawaatur ke saath yeh hadees suboot ko pahunch chuki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya is ummat mein se sattar hazaar log baghair hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge aur har hazaar ke saath sattar hazaar aur honge, Tabrani mein hai us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum mein se ek bahut badi jamaat Qayamat ke roz khadi ki jayegi jo is qadar badi aur ginti mein zaaid hogi ke goya raat aa gayi zameen ke tamam kinaron ko ghera le gi farishte kehne lagenge sab nabiyon ke saath jitne log aaye hain un se bahut hi zyada Muhammad ﷺ ke saath hain.

Munasib maqam yeh hai ke "bahut badi jamaat aglon mein se aur bahut hi badi pichlon mein se" wali ayat ki tafsir ke mauqe par yeh hadith zikr kardi jaye jo Hafiz Abu Bakr Baihaqi (R.H) ne Dala'il-e-Nabuwwat mein warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab subah ki namaz padhte paon mode hue hi sattar martaba yeh padhte dua (SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi astaghfirullaha innallaha kana tawwaba) phir farmate sattar ke badle saat sau hain jis ke ek din ke gunah saat sau se bhi badh jayen woh be-khabar hai phir do martaba isi ko farmate phir logon ki taraf munh kar ke baithte aur chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khwab achha maloom hota tha is liye puchte ke kya tum mein se kisi ne koi khwab dekha hai? Abu Zumal kehte hain ek din isi tarah hasb-e-adat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya to main ne kaha haan ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne ek khwab dekha hai, farmaya Allah khair se milaye shar se bachaye hamare liye behtar banaye aur hamare dushmanon ke liye badtar banaye har qism ki tareefon ka mustahiq woh Allah hai jo tamam jahano ka palne wala hai, apna khwab bayan karo. Main ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne dekha ke ek rasta hai kushada, aasaan, narm, saaf aur beshumar log is raste mein chale ja rahe hain yeh rasta jaate jaate ek sarsabz bagh ko nikalta hai ke meri aankhon ne aisa lehlahata hua hara bhara bagh kabhi nahin dekha pani har su rawan hai sabze se pata pada hai anwa-o-aqsam ke darakht khushnuma phale phoole khade hain ab main ne dekha ke pehli jamaat jo aayi aur is bagh ke paas pahunchi to unhon ne apni sawariyan tez kar lin dayen bayen nahin gaye aur tez raftari ke sath yahan se guzar gaye. Phir dusri jamaat aayi jo tadaad mein bahut zyada thi, jab yahan pahunche to baaz logon ne apne janwaron ko charana chugana shuru kiya aur baazon ne kuch le liya aur chal diye phir to bahut zyada log aaye jab un ka guzra in gul-o-gulzar par hua to yeh to phool gaye aur kehne lage yeh sab se achhi jagah hai goya main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh dayen bayen jhuk pade main ne yeh dekha lekin main Aap to chalta hi raha jab door nikal gaya to main ne dekha ke ek mimbar saat seedhiyon ka bicha hua hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ke aala darja par tashreef farma hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dayen janib ek sahib hain gandum-goon rang bhari ungliyon wale daraz qad jab kalam karte hain to sab khamoshi se sunte hain aur log unche ho ho kar tawajjuh se un ki baatein sunte hain aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki bayen taraf ek shakhs hain bhare jism ke darmiyana qad ke jin ke chehra par bakasrat til hain un ke baal goya pani se tar hain jab woh baat karte hain to un ke ikram ki wajah se sab log jhuk jate hain phir is se aage ek shakhs hain jo akhlaq-o-aadat mein aur chehre naqshe mein bilkul Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mushabahat rakhte hain, Aap log sab un ki taraf poori tawajjuh karte hain aur un ka irada rakhte hain.

Un se aagay ek dubli patli burhiya oontni hai, main ne dekha ke goya aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) usay utha rahe hain, yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho gaya, thodi der mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh halat badal gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Seedhay sachay aur sahih raastay se muraad toh woh Deen hai jisay main le kar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aaya hoon aur jis hidayat par tum ho. Hara bhara sabz baagh jo tum ne dekha hai woh duniya hai aur us ki aish-o-ishrat ka dil lubhanay wala saamaan. Main aur mere ashaab toh us se guzar jayenge, na tum us mein mashghool hoge, na woh hamain chimtay gi, na hamara talluq us se hoga, na us ka talluq hum se, na hum us ki chahat karenge, na woh hamain liptay gi. Phir hamaray baad doosri jamaat aayegi jo hum se tadaad mein bohat zyada hogi, un mein se ba'az toh is duniya mein phans jayenge aur ba'az ba-qadr-e-hajat le lenge aur chal denge aur nijaat pa lenge. Phir un ke baad zabardast jamaat aayegi jo is duniya mein bilkul mustaghraq ho jayegi aur daayen baayen behak jayegi. Aayat (فانا للہ وانا الیہ راجعون - Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un). Ab rahay tum, so tum apni seedhi raah chaltay rahoge yahan tak ke mujh se tumhari mulaqat ho jayegi. Jis mimbar ke aakhri saaton darjay par tum ne mujhe dekha us ki ta'beer yeh hai ke duniya ki umr saat hazaar saal ki hai, main aakhri hazaarwein saal mein hoon. Mere daayen jis gundumi rang moti hatheli walay insaan ko tum ne dekha woh Hazrat Musa (A.S) hain, jab woh kalaam karte hain toh log oonchay ho jatay hain is liye ke unhain Allah Ta'ala se sharaf-e-hum-kalami ho chuka hai. Aur jinhein tum ne mere baayen dekha jo darmiyana qad ke bharay jism ke bohat se tallon walay thay jin ke baal paani se tar nazar aatay thay, woh Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) hain, chunke un ka ikraam Allah Ta'ala ne kiya hai hum sab bhi un ki buzurgi karte hain. Aur jin sheikh ko tum ne bilkul mujh sa dekha woh hamaray baap Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain, hum sab un ka qasd karte hain aur un ki iqtida aur tabedari karte hain. Aur jis oontni ko tum ne dekha ke main usay khadi kar raha hoon, us se muraad Qayamat hai jo meri ummat par qaim hogi, na mere baad koi Nabi aayega, na meri ummat ke baad koi ummat hai. Farmatay hain is ke baad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh poochna chhod diya ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Haan agar koi shakhs apnay aap apna khwab bayan kar de toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ta'beer de diya kartay thay. Un ke baithnay ke takht aur aaram karnay ke palang sonay ke taaron se banay huay honge jin mein jagah jagah moti takay huay honge, dur-o-yaqoot juray huay honge. Yeh fa'eel ma'ani mein maf'ool ke hai is liye oontni ke pait ke neechay walay ko wazeem kehtay hain. Sab ke munh ek doosray ke samnay honge, koi kisi ki taraf peeth diye huay na hoga. Woh ulama un ki khidmat guzari mein mashghool honge jo umr mein waisay hi chhotay rahenge, na baday hon na burhay hon. Na un mein taghayyur-o-tabdeel aaye. Akwaab kehtay hain un koonzon ko jin ki tonti aur pakarnay ki cheez na ho aur abaareeq woh aaftabay jo tonti-daar aur pakray janay ke qabil hon.

Yeh sab sharab ki jaari nahar se chalkte hue honge jo sharab na khatam ho na kam ho kyunke uske chashme beh rahe hain, jaam chalkte hue har waqt apne nazuk hathon mein liye hue yeh gul-andam saqi idhar udhar gasht kar rahe honge. Is sharab se unhein dard-e-sar ho na unki aql zail ho balkay bawajood pooray suroor aur kaif ke aql-o-hawas apni jagah qaim rahenge aur kamil lazzat hasil hogi. Sharab mein chaar sifatein hain nasha, sar dard, qai aur peshab, pas Parwardigar-e-Alam ne jannat ki sharab ka zikr kar ke un charon nuqsanat ki nafi kardi ke woh sharab un nuqsanat se pak hai. Phir qisam qisam ke meway aur tarah tarah ke parindon ke gosht unhein milenge jis meway ko jee chahey aur jis tarah ke gosht ki taraf dil ki raghbat ho majood ho jayega, yeh tamam cheezein liye hue unke saleeqa-e-shiar khuddam har waqt unke ird gird ghoomte rahenge taake jis cheez ki jab kabhi khwahish ho le lein, is ayat mein daleel hai ke aadmi meway chun chun kar apni khwahish ke mutabiq kha sakta hai, Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosli mein hai Hazrat Akrash bin Zuwaib (R.A) farmate hain ke apni qoum ke sadqa ke maal le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap (ﷺ) Muhajireen aur Ansar mein tashreef farma thay mere saath zakat ke bohat se oont thay goya ke woh rait ke darakhton ke charay hue naujawan oont hain aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum kaun ho? Main ne kaha Akrash bin Zuwaib farmaya apna nasab nama door tak bayan kardo main ne Murrah bin Dubaik tak keh sunaya aur saath hi kaha ke zakat Murrah bin Ubaid ki hai pas Huzoor (ﷺ) muskuraye aur farmane lage yeh meri qoum ke oont hain yeh meri qoum ke sadqa ka maal hai phir hukum diya ke sadqay ke oonton ke nishan un par kardo aur unke saath inhein bhi mila do phir mera haath pakar kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) ke ghar tashreef laye aur farmaya kuch khanay ko hai? Jawab mila ke haan chunancha ek baray lagan mein tukray tukray ki hui roti aayi aap (ﷺ) ne aur main ne khana shuru kiya. Main idhar udhar se niwalay lene laga aap (ﷺ) ne apne haath se mera dahina haath thaam liya, aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh to ek qisam ka khana hai ek jagah se khao. Phir ek seeni tar khajooron khushk khajooron ki aayi main ne sirf mere samnay jo thin unhein khana shuru kiya haan Rasool Allah (ﷺ) seeni ke idhar udhar se jahan se jo pasand aati thi le lete thay aur mujh se bhi farmaya ae Akrash is mein har tarah ki khajoorein hain jahan se chaho khao jis qisam ki khajoor chaho le lo, phir pani aaya pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne haath dhoye aur wahi tar haath apne chehray par aur dono bazoo'on aur sar par teen dafa pher liye aur farmaya ae Akrash yeh wuzu hai us cheez se jisay aag ne mutaghayyar kiya ho. (Tirmizi aur Ibn-e-Majah) Imam Tirmizi isay ghareeb batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko khwab pasand tha basa auqat aap (ﷺ) pooch liya karte thay ke kisi ne khwab dekha hai? Agar koi zikr karta aur phir Huzoor (ﷺ) us khwab se khush hote to usay bohat acha lagta.

Ek martaba ek aurat Aap ﷺ ke paas aayin kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne aaj ek khwab dekha hai ke goya mere paas koi aaya aur mujhe Madina se le chala aur Jannat mein pahuncha diya phir main ne yakayak dhamaka suna jis se Jannat mein halchal mach gayi main ne jo nazar utha kar dekha to falan bin falan aur falan bin falan ko dekha barah shakhson ke naam liye unhein barah shakhson ka ek lashkar bana kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne kayi din huye ek muhim par rawana kiya hua tha farmati hain unhein laya gaya yeh atlas ke kapde pehne huye the un ki ragein josh maar rahi thin hukm hua ke unhein nehar-e-baidaj mein le jao ya baizak kaha, jab un logon ne is nehar mein ghota lagaya to un ke chehre chaudahvin raat ke chand ki tarah chamakne lag gaye phir ek sone ki sini mein gadri khajoorein aayin jo unhon ne apni hasb-e-mansha khayin aur sath hi har tarah ke meway jo charon taraf chune huye the jis meway ko un ka ji chahta tha lete the aur khate the main ne bhi un ke sath shirkat ki aur woh meway khaye, muddat ke baad ek qasid aaya aur kaha falan falan ashkhas jinhein Aap ﷺ ne lashkar mein bheja tha shaheed ho gaye theek barah shakhson ke naam liye aur yeh wohi naam the jinhein is biwi sahiba ne apne khwab mein dekha tha. Huzoor ﷺ ne un nek-bakht sahabi-e ko phir bulwaya aur farmaya apna khwab dobara bayan karo us ne phir bayan kiya aur unhi logon ke naam liye jin ke naam qasid ne liye the. Tabrani mein hai ke Jannati jis meway ko darakht se tode ga wahin is jaisa aur phal lag jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Jannati parind bakhti aur oont ke barabar hain jo Jannat mein charte chugte rehte hain, Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ yeh parind to nihayat hi mazay ke honge, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un ke khane wale un se bhi zyada naaz-o-nemat wale honge. Teen martaba yahi jumla irshad farma kar phir farmaya mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke ae Abu Bakr tum un mein se ho jo un parindon ka gosht khayenge. Hafiz Abu Abdullah Misri ki kitab Sifat-ul-Jannah mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ke samne Tuba ka zikr hua pas Huzoor ﷺ ne Huzoor Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho Tuba kya hai? Aap R.A ne jawab diya Allah aur us ke Rasool ko pura ilm hai Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Jannat ka ek darakht hai jis ki tulani ka ilm siwaye Allah ke aur kisi ko nahin is ki ek ek shakh tale tez sawar sattar sattar saal tak chala jaye ga. Phir bhi is ka saya khatam na hua is ke patte bade chaure chaure hain un par bakhti oontni ke barabar parind aa kar baithte hain, Abu Bakr R.A ne farmaya phir to yeh parind badi hi nematon wale honge Aap ﷺ ne farmaya un se zyada nematon wale un ke khane wale honge aur Insha'Allah tum bhi unhi mein se ho. Hazrat Qatada R.H se bhi yeh pichla hissa marwi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi-ud-Dunya mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Kausar ki babat sawal hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh Jannati nehar hai jo mujhe Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne ata farmayi hai, doodh se zyada safed aur shehad se zyada meetha iska pani hai, iske kinare bakhti oonton ki gardanon jaise parind hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya woh parind toh bade maze mein hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya unka khane wala unse zyada maze mein hai. (Tirmidhi). Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan kehte hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannat mein ek parind hai jiske sattar hazar par hain, Jannati ke dastarkhwan par woh aayega aur uske har par se ek qism niklegi jo doodh se zyada safed aur makkhan se zyada narm aur shehad se zyada meethi, phir dusre par se dusri qism niklegi, isi tarah har par se ek dusre se judagana, phir woh parind ud jayega. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur iske rawi Rasani aur unke ustad dono zaeef hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) se marwi hai ke Jannati parind misl-e-bakhti oonton ke hain jo Jannat ke phal khate hain aur Jannat ki nehron ka pani peete hain, Jannatiyon ka dil jis parind ke khane ko chahega woh uske samne aa jayega, woh jitna chahega jis pehlu ka gosht pasand karega khayega, phir woh parind ud jayega aur jaisa tha waisa hi hoga. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat ke jis parind ko tu chahega woh bhuna-bhunaya tere samne aa jayega.

Hoor ki dusri qira'at re ke zer se bhi hai. Pesh se toh matlab hai ke Jannatiyon ke liye hoorein hongi aur zer se yeh matlab hai ke goya agle a'raab ki mat-huti mein yeh a'raab bhi hai, jaise aayat (Wamsahu bi-ru'usikum wa arjulakum ilal-ka'bain) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 6) mein zabar ki qira'at hai aur jaise ke aayat (Aliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun wa istabraq) (Surah Al-Insan: 21) hain. Aur yeh ma'ani bhi ho sakte hain ke ghilman apne sath hoorein bhi liye hue honge lekin unke mahalaat mein aur khaimon mein na ke aam taur par, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh hoorein aisi hongi jaise tar-o-taza safed saaf moti hon, jaise Surah Saffat mein hai aayat (Ka'annahunna baidun maknoon) (Surah As-Saffat: 49).
