Khwab mein main ne ek hoor ko dekha ke us jaisi khubsurat noorani shakal kabhi meri nigah se nahin guzri. Us ne mujh se kaha: Ae Abu Sulaiman! Ek hi hath se dua mangne lage aur yeh khayal nahin ke panch sau (500) saal se Allah Ta'ala mujhe tumhare liye apni khas ne'maton mein parwarish kar raha hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh laam muta'liq Atraban ke ho, ya'ni un ki hum-umar hongi. Jaise ke Bukhari, Muslim waghera ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehli jama'at jo Jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhvin raat jaise roshan honge, un ke baad wali jama'at ke bahut chamakdar sitare jaise roshan honge. Yeh pakhane, peshab, thook, rent se pak honge. Un ki kanghiyan sone ki hongi, un ke paseene mushk ki khushbu wale honge, un ki angithiyan lu'lu ki hongi, un ki biwiyan hoor-e-ain hongi. Un sab ke akhlaq misl ek hi shakhs ke honge, yeh sab apne baap Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki shakal par sath (60) hath ke lambe qad ke honge. Tabrani mein hai: Ahl-e-Jannat be-baal aur be-resh, gore rang wale, khush-khulq aur khubsurat, surmagin ankhon wale, taintis (33) baras ki umar ke, saat (7) hath lambe aur saat (7) hath chaude chakle mazboot badan wale honge. Is ka kuch hissa Tirmidhi mein bhi marwi hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke go kisi umr mein inteqal hua ho dakhul-e-jannat ke waqt taintis (33) saala umr ke honge aur isi umr mein hamesha rahenge, isi tarah jahannami bhi (Tirmidhi). Aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke qad saat haath farishtay ke haath ke aitbaar se honge, qad-e-Adam, husn-e-Yusuf, umr-e-Isa A.S yaani taintis (33) saal aur zabaan Muhammad ﷺ yaani Arabi waale honge, be-baal aur surmagin aankhon waale (Ibn Abi Dunya). Aur riwayat mein hai ke dakhul-e-jannat ke saath hi unhein ek jannati darakht ke paas laya jayega aur wahan unhein kapray pehnaye jayenge, un ke kapray na galen na sarren na purane hon na maile hon, un ki jawani na dhale na jaye na fana ho.

Ashab-e-Yameen guzashta ummaton mein se bhi bahut hain aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne apne sahaba se bayaan farmaya, mere saamne Anbiya ma'a apne tabe-daar ummatiyon ke pesh hue, ba'az Nabi guzarte the aur ba'az Nabi ke saath ek jamaat hoti thi aur ba'az Nabi ke saath sirf teen aadmi hote the aur ba'az ke saath ek bhi tha. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Qatada R.H ne itna bayaan farmaya ke yeh aayat padhi (Alaisa minkum rajulur rashid) (Surah Hud: 78) kya tum mein se ek bhi rushd-o-samajh waala nahin? Yahan tak ke Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S guzre jo Bani Israel ki ek badi jamaat saath liye hue the, main ne poocha Parwardigar yeh kaun hain? Jawab mila yeh tumhare bhai Musa bin Imran hain aur un ke saath un ki tabe-daari karne waali ummat hai. Main ne poocha Ilahi phir meri ummat kahan hai? Farmaya apni dahini jaanib neeche ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to bahut badi jamaat nazar aayi, logon ke bakasrat chehre damak rahe the. Phir mujh se poocha kaho ab to khush ho? Main ne kaha haan Ilahi main khush hoon. Mujh se farmaya ab apni baayin jaanib kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha woh wahan beshumar log the, phir mujh se poocha ab to raazi ho gaye? Main ne kaha haan mere Rab main raazi hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya aur suno un ke saath sattar hazaar aur log hain jo baghair hisaab ke jannat mein dakhil honge. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ukasha R.A khade ho gaye, yeh qabeela Banu Asad se Muhsan ke ladke the, Badr ki ladai mein maujood the, arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke mujhe bhi inhi mein se kare, aap ne dua ki. Phir ek aur shakhs khade hue aur kaha ae Allah ke Rasool mere liye bhi dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya Ukasha tujh par sabqat kar gaye. Phir aap ne farmaya logon tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar tum se ho sake to un sattar hazaar mein se bano jo be-hisaab jannat mein jayenge, warna kam se kam daayin jaanib waalon mein se ho jao ge, yeh bhi na ho sake to kinare waalon mein se ban jao. Main ne aksar logon ko dekha hai ke apne haal mein hi latak jaate hain. Phir farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tadaad sirf tumhari hi hogi. Pas hum ne takbeer kahi, phir farmaya balkay mujhe umeed hai ke tum tamam jannat ki tihayi waale hoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi.

Farmaya aur suno! Tum aadhon aadh ahl-e-jannat ke hoge. Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, us ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) ki tilawat ki. Ab hum mein aapas mein muzakira shuru ho gaya ke yeh sattar hazaar kaun log honge, phir hum ne kaha woh log jo Islam mein paida hue aur shirk kiya hi nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh yeh woh log hain jo daagh nahin lagwate aur jhaar phoonk nahin karwate aur faal nahin lete aur apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Yeh hadith bahut si sanadon se Sahaba ki riwayat se bahut si kitabon mein sehat ke saath marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is aayat mein pehlon pichlon se murad meri ummat ke agle pichle hi hain.

Ashab-e-Yameen aur un par inamaat-e-Ilahi. Sabiqeen ka haal bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala ab Abrar ka haal bayan farmata hai jo Sabiqeen se kam martaba hain. Un ka kya haal hai kya natija hai ise suno, yeh un jannaton mein hain jahan beri ke darakht hain lekin kante daar nahin. Aur phal bakasrat aur behtareen hain. Duniya mein beri ke darakht zyada kanton wale aur kam phalon wale hote hain. Jannat ke yeh darakht zyada phalon wale aur bilkul be-khar honge, phalon ke bojh se darakht ke tane jhuke jate honge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Najjar (R.H) ne ek riwayat warid ki hai ke Sahaba kehte hain ke A'rabiyon ka Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aana aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masail puchna hamein bahut nafa deta tha. Ek martaba ek A'rabi ne aa kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran mein ek aise darakht ka bhi zikr hai jo eza deta, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne pucha woh kaunsa? Us ne kaha beri ka darakht, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir tu ne us ke sath hi lafz makh-sood nahin padha? Us ke kante Allah Ta'ala ne door kar diye hain aur un ke badle phal paida kar diye hain. Har ek beri mein behtar qisam ke zaiqe honge jin ka rang-o-maza mukhtalif hoga, yeh riwayat dusri kitabon mein bhi marwi hai is mein lafz talh hai aur sattar zaiqon ka bayan hai. Talh ek bada darakht hai jo Hijaz ki sarzameen mein hota hai, yeh kante daar darakht hai is mein kante bahut zyada hote hain. Chunancha Ibn-e-Jareer ne is ki shahadat Arabi ke ek sher se bhi di hai. Mandood ke ma'ni teh-ba-teh phal wala, phal se lada hua. In dono ka zikr is liye hua ke Arab in darakhton ki gehri aur meethi chhaon ko pasand karte the, yeh darakht bazahir dunyawi darakht jaisa hoga lekin bajaye kanton ke is mein sheereen phal honge. Johari farmate hain talh bhi kehte hain aur tal'a bhi, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai, to mumkin hai ke yeh bhi beri ki hi sifat ho, yani woh beriyan be-khar aur bakasrat phal-dar hain wallahu a'lam. Aur hazrat ne talh se murad kele ka darakht kaha hai, Ahl-e-Yaman kele ko talh kehte hain aur Ahl-e-Hijaz moz kehte hain. Lambe lambe sayon mein yeh honge. Sahih Bukhari mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jannat ke darakht ke saye tale tez sawar sau saal tak chalta rahega lekin saya khatam na hoga.

Agar tum chaho is aayat ko parho, Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai aur Musnad-e-Ahmad, Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein bhi Musnad ki aur hadith mein shak ke saath hai yani sattar ya sau aur yeh bhi hai ke yeh Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai, Ibn-e-Jarir aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai pas yeh hadith mutawatir aur qatan sahih hai is ki asnaad bohat hain aur is ke rawi siqah hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne jab yeh riwayat bayan ki aur Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke kaanon tak pahunchi to aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne Taurat Hazrat Musa (A.S) par aur Quran Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara ke agar koi shakhs naujawan oontni par sawar ho kar us waqt chalta rahe jab tak woh burhiya ho kar gir jaye to bhi is ki intiha ko nahin pahunch sakta, Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath se boya hai aur khud aap ne is mein apne paas ki rooh phoonki hai is ki shakhein Jannat ki deewaron se bahar nikli hui hain. Abu Haseen kehte hain ke ek mauza mein ek darwaze par hum thay hamare saath Abu Saleh aur Shafeeq Jahni bhi thay aur Abu Saleh ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) wali oopar ki hadith bayan ki aur kaha kya tu Abu Huraira (R.A) ko jhutlata hai? Us ne kaha nahin, unhein to nahin tujhe jhutlata hoon. Pas yeh qariyon par bohat garan guzra. Main kehta hoon is saabit, sahih aur marfoo hadith ko jo jhutlaye woh ghalti par hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Jannat ke har darakht ka tana sone ka hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein ek darakht hai jis ke har taraf sau sau saal ke raaste tak saya phaila hua hai. Jannati log is ke neeche aakar baithte hain aur aapas mein baatein karte hain. Kisi ko dunyawi khel tamashe aur dil behlawe yaad aate hain to usi waqt ek Jannati hawa chalti hai aur us darakht mein se tamam raag ragniyan baaje gaaje aur khel tamashon ki aawazein aane lagti hain, yeh asar ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad qawi hai. Hazrat Amr bin Maimoon (R.H) farmate hain yeh saya sattar hazar saal ki toolani mein hoga. Aap se marfoo hadith mein ek sau saal marwi hai yeh saya ghat-ta hi nahin na sooraj aaye na garmi sataye, fajr ke tuloo hone se peshtar ka samaan har waqt is ke neeche rehta hai. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein hamesha woh waqt rahega jo subh-e-sadiq ke baad se lekar aaftab ke tuloo hone ke darmiyan darmiyan rehta hai saya ke mazmoon ki riwayatein bhi is se pehle guzar chuki hain, jaise aayat (Wa nudkhiluhum zillan zaleela) (4. An-Nisa: 57) aur aayat (Ukuluha da'imun wa zilluha) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 35) aur aayat (Innal muttaqeena fee zilalin wa uyoon) (77. Al-Mursalat: 41) waghera paani hoga behta hua magar nehron ke garhay aur khudi hui zameen na hogi, is ki poori tafseer aayat (Feeha anharun min ma'in ghairi aasin) (47. Muhammad: 15) mein guzar chuki hai. Un ke paas bakasrat tarah tarah ke lazeez meway hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhe na kisi kaan ne sune na kisi insani dil par un ka wahm-o-khayal guzra.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai jab wahan phalon se rozi diye jayenge toh kahenge ke yeh toh hum pehle bhi diye gaye thay kyunke bilkul hum-shakal honge, lekin jab khayenge toh zaiqa aur hi payenge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Sidratul-Muntaha ke zikr mein hai ke uske patte misl hathi ke kanon ke honge aur phal misl hajar ke bade bade matkon ke honge, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki is hadith mein jis mein aap ne suraj ke gehan hone ka aur Huzoor ﷺ ka suraj gehan ki namaz ada karne ka waqia tafseel se bayan kiya hai yeh bhi hai ke baad-e-faraghat aap ke sath ke namaziyon ne aap se poocha Huzoor ﷺ hum ne aap ko is jagah aage badhte aur peeche hat-te dekha kya baat thi? Aap ne farmaya main ne jannat dekhi jannat ke mewon ka khosha lena chaha agar main le leta toh rehti duniya tak woh rehta aur tum khate rehte. Abu Ya'la mein hai Zohar ki farz namaz padhate hue Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ aage badh gaye aur hum bhi phir aap ne goya koi cheez leni chahi, phir peeche hat aaye, namaz se farigh ho kar Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj toh aap ne aisi baat ki jo is se pehle kabhi nahin ki thi, aap ne farmaya mere samne jannat layi gayi aur jo is mein tar-o-tazgi aur sabzi hai main ne is mein se ek angoor ka khosha todna chaha taake la kar tumhein doon pas mere aur us ke darmiyan parda hail kar diya gaya aur agar main isay tumhare paas le aata toh zameen-o-aasman ke darmiyan ki makhlooq isay khati rehti taham is mein zara si bhi kami na aati. Isi ke misl Hazrat Jabir R.A se Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi marwi hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek a'arabi ne aa kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se Hauz-e-Kausar ki babat sawal kiya aur jannat ka bhi zikr kiya poocha ke kya is mein meway bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya haan wahan Tuba nami darakht bhi hai? Phir kuch kaha jo mujhe yaad nahin phir poocha woh darakht hamari zameen ke kis darakht se mushabahat rakhta hai? Aap ne farmaya tere mulk ki zameen mein koi darakht is ka hum-shakal nahin. Kya tu Sham mein gaya hai? Us ne kaha nahin, farmaya Sham mein ek darakht hota hai jise Joza kehte hain ek hi tana hota hai aur upar ka hissa phaila hua hota hai woh albatta is ke mushabeh hai, us ne poocha Jannati khoshe kitne bade hote hain? Farmaya kala kawa mahina bhar tak udta rahe utne bade. Woh kehne laga is darakht ka tana kis qadar mota hai aap ne farmaya agar tu apni oontni ke bachay ko chhod de aur woh chalta rahe yahan tak ke boodha ho kar gir pade tab bhi us ke tanay ka chakkar poora nahin kar sakta. Us ne kaha is mein angoor bhi lagte hain? Aap ne farmaya haan poocha kitne bade? Aap ne jawab diya ke kya kabhi tere baap ne apne rewar mein se koi mota taza bakra zibah kar ke us ki khaal khench kar teri maa ko de kar kaha hai ke is ka dol bana lo? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya bas utne hi bade bade angoor ke danay hote hain.

Us ne kaha phir toh ek hi dana mujh ko aur mere ghar walon ko kafi hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkay sari baradri ko, phir yeh meway bhi hamesha rehne walay hain. Na kabhi khatam hon na kabhi in se roka jaye. Yeh nahin ke jaaray mein hain aur garmiyon mein nahin, ya garmiyon mein hain aur jaaray mein nadarat, balkay yeh meway dawam walay aur hamesha hamesha rehne walay hain, jab talab karein pa lein, Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat har waqt woh majood rahen ge, balkay kisi kaantay aur kisi shaakh ko bhi aar na hogi, na doori hogi, na hasil karne mein takalluf aur takleef hogi. Balkay idhar phal tora idhar us ke qaim maqam doosra phal lag gaya, jaise ke us se pehle hadith mein guzar chuka. In ke farsh buland-o-bala narm aur gadgad-e rahat-o-aaram dene walay hon ge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain in ki unchai itni hogi jitni zameen-o-aasman ki, yani paanch sau saal ki (Tirmidhi). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, baaz ahl-e-ma'ani ne kaha hai ke matlab is hadith-e-sharif ka yeh hai ke farsh ki bulandi darjay ki aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai, yani ek darja doosre darjay se is qadar buland hai. Har do darjon mein paanch sau saal ki raah ka fasla hai, phir yeh bhi khayal rahe ke yeh riwayat sirf Rushd bin Sa'ad se marwi hai aur woh za'eef hain. Yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Jareer, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marwi hai ke in ki unchai assi saal ki hai. Is ke baad zameer layi jis ka marja pehle mazkoor nahin is liye ke qareena majood hai. Bistar ka zikr aaya jis par jannatiyon ki biwiyan hongi, pas in ki taraf zameer pher di. Jaise Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke zikr mein Taurat ka lafz aaya hai aur Shams ka lafz is se pehle nahin, pas qareena kafi hai. Lekin Abu Ubaida kehte hain pehle mazkoor ho chuka, aayat (وَحُوْرٌ عِيْنٌ 22 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 22), pas farmata hai ke hum ne in biwiyon ko nayi paidaish mein paida kiya hai, is ke baad ke woh baakal phoos burhiya thin, hum ne unhein nau-umar kunwariyan kar ke ek khaas paidaish mein paida kiya. Woh apne zafafat-o-malahat, husn-e-soorat-o-jasamat se khush khulqi aur halawat ki wajah se apne khawandon ki bari pyariyan hain. Baaz kehte hain 'Uraba' kehte hain naaz-o-karishma waliyon ko. Hadith mein hai ke yeh woh auratein hain jo duniya mein burhiya thin aur ab jannat mein gayi hain toh unhein nau-umar waghera kar diya hai aur riwayat mein hai ke khwah yeh auratein kunwari thin ya thayyiba thin, Allah Ta'ala in sab ko aisi kar de ga. Ek burhiya aurat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar kehti hai ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe jannat mein dakhil kar de, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Um-e-Fulan! Jannat mein koi burhiya nahin jaye gi." Woh roti hui wapas lotin toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Jao unhein samjha do," matlab yeh hai ke jab woh jannat mein jayen gi burhiya nahin hon gi.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum unhein nayi paidaish mein paida karenge phir bakirah kardenge. Shamail-e-Tirmidhi waghera Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Um-e-Salma R.A farmati hain main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hoor-e-Ain ki khabar mujhe dijiye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh gore rang ki hain, badi badi aankhon wali hain, sakht siyah aur bade bade baalon wali hain jaise gidh ka par. Main ne kaha (Al-Lu'lu-ul-Maknoon 23) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 23) ki babat khabar dijiye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya din ki safai aur jot misl us moti ke hai jo seep se abhi abhi nikla ho jise kisi ka hath bhi na laga ho. Main ne kaha Khairat-e-Hissan ki kya tafseer hai? Farmaya khush khulq khubsurat. Main ne kaha (Ka-annahunna Baidun Maknoon 49) (Surah As-Saffat: 49) se kya murad hai? Farmaya un ki nazakat aur narmi ande ki us jhilli ki manind hogi jo andar hoti hai. Main ne Uruban Atraba ke ma'ani daryaft kiye, farmaya is se murad duniya ki musalman jannati auratein hain jo bilkul budhiya phoos thin, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein naye sire se paida kiya aur kunwariyan aur khawandon ki chahitiyan aur khawandon se ishq rakhne waliyan aur hum-umar banadein. Main ne pucha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya ki auratein afzal hain jaise astar se abra behtar hota hai, main ne kaha is fazilat ki kya wajah hai? Farmaya namazein, roze aur Allah Ta'ala ki ibadatein, Allah ne un ke chehre noor se un ke jism resham se sanwar diye hain, safed resham, sabz resham aur zard sunhare resham aur zard sunhare zevar, bakhurdan moti ke, kanghiyan sone ki. Yeh kehti rahengi: Nahnu-l-Khalidatu fala namootu abada, wa nahnu-n-Na'imatu fala nab'asu abada, wa nahnu-l-Muqimatu fala naz'anu abada, wa nahnu-r-Radiyatu fala naskhatu abada, Tooba liman kunna lahu wa kana lana. Ya'ni hum hamesha rehne wali hain kabhi maren gi nahin, hum naaz aur ne'mat waliyan hain ki kabhi safar mein nahin jayengi, hum apne khawandon se khush rehne waliyan hain ki kabhi roothengi nahin. Khush naseeb hain woh log jin ke liye hum hain aur khush naseeb hain hum ki un ke liye hain. Main ne pucha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba'az aurton ke do do teen teen char char khawand ho jate hain us ke baad use maut aati hai, marne ke baad agar yeh jannat mein gayi aur us ke sab khawand bhi gaye to yeh kise milegi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya use ikhtiyar diya jayega ki jis ke sath chahe rahe, chunancha yeh un mein se use pasand karegi jo us ke sath behtareen bartao karta raha ho, Allah Ta'ala se kahegi Parwardigar! Yeh mujh se bahut achi bodobash rakhta tha isi ke nikah mein mujhe de. Ae Um-e-Salma! Husn-e-Khulq duniya aur akhirat ki bhalaion ko liye hue hai. Soor ki mashhoor mutawwal hadith mein hai ki Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tamam musalmanon ko jannat mein le jane ki sifarish karenge jis par Allah Ta'ala farmayega main ne aap ki shafa'at qabool ki aur aap ko unhein jannat mein pahunchane ki ijazat di. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain phir main unhein jannat mein le jaunga, Allah ki qasam tum jis qadar apne ghar bar aur apni biwion se waqif ho us se bahut zyada ahl-e-jannat apne gharon aur biwion se waqif honge.

Pas ek ek jannati ki behtar behtar biwiyan hongi jo Allah ki banai hui hain aur do do biwiyan aurton mein se hongi ke unhein ba-wajah apni ibadat ke un sab aurton par fazilat hasil hogi. Jannati in mein se ek ke paas jayega, yeh us bala-khane mein hogi jo yaqoot ka bana hua hoga, us palang par hogi jo sone ki taron se bana hua hoga aur jadao jada hua hoga, sattar jore pehne hue honge jo sab bareek aur sabz chamkeele khalis resham ke honge. Yeh biwi is qadar nazuk noorani hogi ke us ki kamar par hath rakh kar seene ki taraf se dekhega to saaf nazar aa jayega, ke kapre, gosht, haddi koi cheez rok na hogi, is qadar us ka jism saaf aur aaina-numa hoga jis tarah marwareed mein surakh kar ke dora daal dein to woh dora bahar se nazar aata hai isi tarah us ki pindli ka goda nazar aayega. Aisa hi noorani badan us jannati ka bhi hoga, al-gharaz yeh us ka aaina hogi, aur woh us ka, yeh us ke sath aish-o-ishrat mein mashghool hoga na yeh thake na woh, na is ka dil bhare na is ka. Jab kabhi nazdeki karega to kunwari payega, na us ka uzu sust ho na use garan guzre, magar khas paani wahan na hoga jis se ghinn aaye. Yeh yunhi mashghool hoga jo kaan mein nida aayegi ke yeh to hamein khoob maloom hai ke na aap ka dil in se bharega na in ka aap se magar aap ki dusri biwiyan bhi hain. Ab yeh yahan se bahar aayega aur ek ek ke paas jayega, jis ke paas jayega use dekh kar be-sakhta us ke munh se nikal jayega ke Rab ki qasam tujh se behtar jannat mein koi cheez nahin, na meri mohabbat kisi se tujh se zyada hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se puchte hain ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya jannat mein jannati log jama bhi karenge? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Haan, qasam us Allah ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, khoob achi tarah behtareen tareeq par, jab alag hoga woh usi waqt phir paak saaf achooti bakira ban jayegi. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain momin ko jannat mein itni itni aurton ke paas jaane ki quwwat ata ki jayegi. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ) kya itni taqat rakhega? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ek sau aadmiyon ke barabar use quwwat milegi. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai ek ek sau kunwariyon ke paas ek ek din mein ho aayega. Hafiz Abdullah Maqdisi (R.H) farmate hain mere nazdeek yeh hadith shart-e-sahih par hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abbas (R.A) 'Uruban' ki tafsir mein farmate hain yeh apne khawandon ki mehbooba hongi, yeh apne khawandon ki aashiq aur khawand un ke aashiq. Ikrama (R.H) se marwi hai ke is ka ma'ni naaz-o-karishma wali hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke ma'ni nazakat wali hai. Tameem bin Hadlam kehte hain 'Uruban' us aurat ko kehte hain jo apne khawand ka dil mutthi mein rakhe. Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) waghaira se marwi hai ke murad khush-kalam hai, apni baton se apne khawandon ka dil mol leti hain, jab kuch bolein yeh maloom hota hai ke phool jharte hain aur noor barasta hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke unhein Arab is liye kaha gaya hai ke un ki bol chaal Arabi zaban mein hogi. Atraban ke ma'ani hain hum-umar, ya'ni taintis (33) baras ki. Aur ma'ani hain ke khawand ki aur un ki tabiyat aur khulq bilkul yaksan hai, jis se woh khush, yeh khush; jo usay na-pasand, usay bhi na-pasand. Yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke aapas mein un mein bair, bughz, sotia-dah, hasad aur rashk na hoga. Yeh sab aapas mein bhi hum-umar hongi taake be-takalluf ek dusri se milein julein, khelein kudein. Tirmidhi ki hadith mein hai ke yeh Jannati hoorein ek rooh-afza bagh mein jama ho kar nihayat pyare gale se gana gayengi ke aisi surili aur rasili awaz makhlooq ne kabhi na suni hogi. Un ka gana wahi hoga jo upar bayan hua. Abu Ya'la mein hai un ke gane mein yeh bhi hoga: (Nahnu khayratun hisan) (Khubina li-azwajin kiram). Hum pak-saf, khush-waza, khubsurat auratein hain jo buzurg aur zi-izzat shauharon ke liye chupa kar rakhi gayi thin. Aur riwayat mein khayrat ke badle jawar ka lafz aaya hai. Phir farmaya yeh Ashab-e-Yameen ke liye paida ki gayi hain aur unhi ke liye mehfooz-o-masoon rakhi gayi thin. Lekin zyada zahir yeh hai ke yeh muta'liq hai ayat (Inna ansha'nahunna insha'a) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 35) ke, ya'ni hum ne unhein un ke liye banaya hai. Hazrat Abu Sulaiman Darani (Rahimahullah) se manqool hai ke main ne ek raat tahajjud ki namaz ke baad dua mangni shuru ki, chunke sakht sardi thi, bade zor ka pala pad raha tha, hath uthaye nahin jate the is liye main ne ek hi hath se dua mangi aur isi halat mein dua mangte mangte mujhe neend aa gayi. Khwab mein main ne ek hoor ko dekha ke us jaisi khubsurat noorani shakal kabhi meri nigah se nahin guzri. Us ne mujh se kaha: Ae Abu Sulaiman! Ek hi hath se dua mangne lage aur yeh khayal nahin ke panch sau (500) saal se Allah Ta'ala mujhe tumhare liye apni khas ne'maton mein parwarish kar raha hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh laam muta'liq Atraban ke ho, ya'ni un ki hum-umar hongi. Jaise ke Bukhari, Muslim waghera ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehli jama'at jo Jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhvin raat jaise roshan honge, un ke baad wali jama'at ke bahut chamakdar sitare jaise roshan honge. Yeh pakhane, peshab, thook, rent se pak honge. Un ki kanghiyan sone ki hongi, un ke paseene mushk ki khushbu wale honge, un ki angithiyan lu'lu ki hongi, un ki biwiyan hoor-e-ain hongi. Un sab ke akhlaq misl ek hi shakhs ke honge, yeh sab apne baap Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki shakal par sath (60) hath ke lambe qad ke honge. Tabrani mein hai: Ahl-e-Jannat be-baal aur be-resh, gore rang wale, khush-khulq aur khubsurat, surmagin ankhon wale, taintis (33) baras ki umar ke, saat (7) hath lambe aur saat (7) hath chaude chakle mazboot badan wale honge. Is ka kuch hissa Tirmidhi mein bhi marwi hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke go kisi umr mein inteqal hua ho dakhul-e-jannat ke waqt taintis (33) saala umr ke honge aur isi umr mein hamesha rahenge, isi tarah jahannami bhi (Tirmidhi). Aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke qad saat haath farishtay ke haath ke aitbaar se honge, qad-e-Adam, husn-e-Yusuf, umr-e-Isa A.S yaani taintis (33) saal aur zabaan Muhammad ﷺ yaani Arabi waale honge, be-baal aur surmagin aankhon waale (Ibn Abi Dunya). Aur riwayat mein hai ke dakhul-e-jannat ke saath hi unhein ek jannati darakht ke paas laya jayega aur wahan unhein kapray pehnaye jayenge, un ke kapray na galen na sarren na purane hon na maile hon, un ki jawani na dhale na jaye na fana ho.

Ashab-e-Yameen guzashta ummaton mein se bhi bahut hain aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne apne sahaba se bayaan farmaya, mere saamne Anbiya ma'a apne tabe-daar ummatiyon ke pesh hue, ba'az Nabi guzarte the aur ba'az Nabi ke saath ek jamaat hoti thi aur ba'az Nabi ke saath sirf teen aadmi hote the aur ba'az ke saath ek bhi tha. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Qatada R.H ne itna bayaan farmaya ke yeh aayat padhi (Alaisa minkum rajulur rashid) (Surah Hud: 78) kya tum mein se ek bhi rushd-o-samajh waala nahin? Yahan tak ke Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S guzre jo Bani Israel ki ek badi jamaat saath liye hue the, main ne poocha Parwardigar yeh kaun hain? Jawab mila yeh tumhare bhai Musa bin Imran hain aur un ke saath un ki tabe-daari karne waali ummat hai. Main ne poocha Ilahi phir meri ummat kahan hai? Farmaya apni dahini jaanib neeche ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to bahut badi jamaat nazar aayi, logon ke bakasrat chehre damak rahe the. Phir mujh se poocha kaho ab to khush ho? Main ne kaha haan Ilahi main khush hoon. Mujh se farmaya ab apni baayin jaanib kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha woh wahan beshumar log the, phir mujh se poocha ab to raazi ho gaye? Main ne kaha haan mere Rab main raazi hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya aur suno un ke saath sattar hazaar aur log hain jo baghair hisaab ke jannat mein dakhil honge. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ukasha R.A khade ho gaye, yeh qabeela Banu Asad se Muhsan ke ladke the, Badr ki ladai mein maujood the, arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke mujhe bhi inhi mein se kare, aap ne dua ki. Phir ek aur shakhs khade hue aur kaha ae Allah ke Rasool mere liye bhi dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya Ukasha tujh par sabqat kar gaye. Phir aap ne farmaya logon tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar tum se ho sake to un sattar hazaar mein se bano jo be-hisaab jannat mein jayenge, warna kam se kam daayin jaanib waalon mein se ho jao ge, yeh bhi na ho sake to kinare waalon mein se ban jao. Main ne aksar logon ko dekha hai ke apne haal mein hi latak jaate hain. Phir farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tadaad sirf tumhari hi hogi. Pas hum ne takbeer kahi, phir farmaya balkay mujhe umeed hai ke tum tamam jannat ki tihayi waale hoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi.

Farmaya aur suno! Tum aadhon aadh ahl-e-jannat ke hoge. Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, us ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) ki tilawat ki. Ab hum mein aapas mein muzakira shuru ho gaya ke yeh sattar hazaar kaun log honge, phir hum ne kaha woh log jo Islam mein paida hue aur shirk kiya hi nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh yeh woh log hain jo daagh nahin lagwate aur jhaar phoonk nahin karwate aur faal nahin lete aur apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Yeh hadith bahut si sanadon se Sahaba ki riwayat se bahut si kitabon mein sehat ke saath marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is aayat mein pehlon pichlon se murad meri ummat ke agle pichle hi hain.

Ashab-e-Yameen aur un par inamaat-e-Ilahi. Sabiqeen ka haal bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala ab Abrar ka haal bayan farmata hai jo Sabiqeen se kam martaba hain. Un ka kya haal hai kya natija hai ise suno, yeh un jannaton mein hain jahan beri ke darakht hain lekin kante daar nahin. Aur phal bakasrat aur behtareen hain. Duniya mein beri ke darakht zyada kanton wale aur kam phalon wale hote hain. Jannat ke yeh darakht zyada phalon wale aur bilkul be-khar honge, phalon ke bojh se darakht ke tane jhuke jate honge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Najjar (R.H) ne ek riwayat warid ki hai ke Sahaba kehte hain ke A'rabiyon ka Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aana aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masail puchna hamein bahut nafa deta tha. Ek martaba ek A'rabi ne aa kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran mein ek aise darakht ka bhi zikr hai jo eza deta, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne pucha woh kaunsa? Us ne kaha beri ka darakht, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir tu ne us ke sath hi lafz makh-sood nahin padha? Us ke kante Allah Ta'ala ne door kar diye hain aur un ke badle phal paida kar diye hain. Har ek beri mein behtar qisam ke zaiqe honge jin ka rang-o-maza mukhtalif hoga, yeh riwayat dusri kitabon mein bhi marwi hai is mein lafz talh hai aur sattar zaiqon ka bayan hai. Talh ek bada darakht hai jo Hijaz ki sarzameen mein hota hai, yeh kante daar darakht hai is mein kante bahut zyada hote hain. Chunancha Ibn-e-Jareer ne is ki shahadat Arabi ke ek sher se bhi di hai. Mandood ke ma'ni teh-ba-teh phal wala, phal se lada hua. In dono ka zikr is liye hua ke Arab in darakhton ki gehri aur meethi chhaon ko pasand karte the, yeh darakht bazahir dunyawi darakht jaisa hoga lekin bajaye kanton ke is mein sheereen phal honge. Johari farmate hain talh bhi kehte hain aur tal'a bhi, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai, to mumkin hai ke yeh bhi beri ki hi sifat ho, yani woh beriyan be-khar aur bakasrat phal-dar hain wallahu a'lam. Aur hazrat ne talh se murad kele ka darakht kaha hai, Ahl-e-Yaman kele ko talh kehte hain aur Ahl-e-Hijaz moz kehte hain. Lambe lambe sayon mein yeh honge. Sahih Bukhari mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jannat ke darakht ke saye tale tez sawar sau saal tak chalta rahega lekin saya khatam na hoga.

Agar tum chaho is aayat ko parho, Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai aur Musnad-e-Ahmad, Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein bhi Musnad ki aur hadith mein shak ke saath hai yani sattar ya sau aur yeh bhi hai ke yeh Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai, Ibn-e-Jarir aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai pas yeh hadith mutawatir aur qatan sahih hai is ki asnaad bohat hain aur is ke rawi siqah hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne jab yeh riwayat bayan ki aur Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke kaanon tak pahunchi to aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne Taurat Hazrat Musa (A.S) par aur Quran Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara ke agar koi shakhs naujawan oontni par sawar ho kar us waqt chalta rahe jab tak woh burhiya ho kar gir jaye to bhi is ki intiha ko nahin pahunch sakta, Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath se boya hai aur khud aap ne is mein apne paas ki rooh phoonki hai is ki shakhein Jannat ki deewaron se bahar nikli hui hain. Abu Haseen kehte hain ke ek mauza mein ek darwaze par hum thay hamare saath Abu Saleh aur Shafeeq Jahni bhi thay aur Abu Saleh ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) wali oopar ki hadith bayan ki aur kaha kya tu Abu Huraira (R.A) ko jhutlata hai? Us ne kaha nahin, unhein to nahin tujhe jhutlata hoon. Pas yeh qariyon par bohat garan guzra. Main kehta hoon is saabit, sahih aur marfoo hadith ko jo jhutlaye woh ghalti par hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Jannat ke har darakht ka tana sone ka hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein ek darakht hai jis ke har taraf sau sau saal ke raaste tak saya phaila hua hai. Jannati log is ke neeche aakar baithte hain aur aapas mein baatein karte hain. Kisi ko dunyawi khel tamashe aur dil behlawe yaad aate hain to usi waqt ek Jannati hawa chalti hai aur us darakht mein se tamam raag ragniyan baaje gaaje aur khel tamashon ki aawazein aane lagti hain, yeh asar ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad qawi hai. Hazrat Amr bin Maimoon (R.H) farmate hain yeh saya sattar hazar saal ki toolani mein hoga. Aap se marfoo hadith mein ek sau saal marwi hai yeh saya ghat-ta hi nahin na sooraj aaye na garmi sataye, fajr ke tuloo hone se peshtar ka samaan har waqt is ke neeche rehta hai. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein hamesha woh waqt rahega jo subh-e-sadiq ke baad se lekar aaftab ke tuloo hone ke darmiyan darmiyan rehta hai saya ke mazmoon ki riwayatein bhi is se pehle guzar chuki hain, jaise aayat (Wa nudkhiluhum zillan zaleela) (4. An-Nisa: 57) aur aayat (Ukuluha da'imun wa zilluha) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 35) aur aayat (Innal muttaqeena fee zilalin wa uyoon) (77. Al-Mursalat: 41) waghera paani hoga behta hua magar nehron ke garhay aur khudi hui zameen na hogi, is ki poori tafseer aayat (Feeha anharun min ma'in ghairi aasin) (47. Muhammad: 15) mein guzar chuki hai. Un ke paas bakasrat tarah tarah ke lazeez meway hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhe na kisi kaan ne sune na kisi insani dil par un ka wahm-o-khayal guzra.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai jab wahan phalon se rozi diye jayenge toh kahenge ke yeh toh hum pehle bhi diye gaye thay kyunke bilkul hum-shakal honge, lekin jab khayenge toh zaiqa aur hi payenge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Sidratul-Muntaha ke zikr mein hai ke uske patte misl hathi ke kanon ke honge aur phal misl hajar ke bade bade matkon ke honge, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki is hadith mein jis mein aap ne suraj ke gehan hone ka aur Huzoor ﷺ ka suraj gehan ki namaz ada karne ka waqia tafseel se bayan kiya hai yeh bhi hai ke baad-e-faraghat aap ke sath ke namaziyon ne aap se poocha Huzoor ﷺ hum ne aap ko is jagah aage badhte aur peeche hat-te dekha kya baat thi? Aap ne farmaya main ne jannat dekhi jannat ke mewon ka khosha lena chaha agar main le leta toh rehti duniya tak woh rehta aur tum khate rehte. Abu Ya'la mein hai Zohar ki farz namaz padhate hue Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ aage badh gaye aur hum bhi phir aap ne goya koi cheez leni chahi, phir peeche hat aaye, namaz se farigh ho kar Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj toh aap ne aisi baat ki jo is se pehle kabhi nahin ki thi, aap ne farmaya mere samne jannat layi gayi aur jo is mein tar-o-tazgi aur sabzi hai main ne is mein se ek angoor ka khosha todna chaha taake la kar tumhein doon pas mere aur us ke darmiyan parda hail kar diya gaya aur agar main isay tumhare paas le aata toh zameen-o-aasman ke darmiyan ki makhlooq isay khati rehti taham is mein zara si bhi kami na aati. Isi ke misl Hazrat Jabir R.A se Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi marwi hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek a'arabi ne aa kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se Hauz-e-Kausar ki babat sawal kiya aur jannat ka bhi zikr kiya poocha ke kya is mein meway bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya haan wahan Tuba nami darakht bhi hai? Phir kuch kaha jo mujhe yaad nahin phir poocha woh darakht hamari zameen ke kis darakht se mushabahat rakhta hai? Aap ne farmaya tere mulk ki zameen mein koi darakht is ka hum-shakal nahin. Kya tu Sham mein gaya hai? Us ne kaha nahin, farmaya Sham mein ek darakht hota hai jise Joza kehte hain ek hi tana hota hai aur upar ka hissa phaila hua hota hai woh albatta is ke mushabeh hai, us ne poocha Jannati khoshe kitne bade hote hain? Farmaya kala kawa mahina bhar tak udta rahe utne bade. Woh kehne laga is darakht ka tana kis qadar mota hai aap ne farmaya agar tu apni oontni ke bachay ko chhod de aur woh chalta rahe yahan tak ke boodha ho kar gir pade tab bhi us ke tanay ka chakkar poora nahin kar sakta. Us ne kaha is mein angoor bhi lagte hain? Aap ne farmaya haan poocha kitne bade? Aap ne jawab diya ke kya kabhi tere baap ne apne rewar mein se koi mota taza bakra zibah kar ke us ki khaal khench kar teri maa ko de kar kaha hai ke is ka dol bana lo? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya bas utne hi bade bade angoor ke danay hote hain.

Us ne kaha phir toh ek hi dana mujh ko aur mere ghar walon ko kafi hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkay sari baradri ko, phir yeh meway bhi hamesha rehne walay hain. Na kabhi khatam hon na kabhi in se roka jaye. Yeh nahin ke jaaray mein hain aur garmiyon mein nahin, ya garmiyon mein hain aur jaaray mein nadarat, balkay yeh meway dawam walay aur hamesha hamesha rehne walay hain, jab talab karein pa lein, Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat har waqt woh majood rahen ge, balkay kisi kaantay aur kisi shaakh ko bhi aar na hogi, na doori hogi, na hasil karne mein takalluf aur takleef hogi. Balkay idhar phal tora idhar us ke qaim maqam doosra phal lag gaya, jaise ke us se pehle hadith mein guzar chuka. In ke farsh buland-o-bala narm aur gadgad-e rahat-o-aaram dene walay hon ge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain in ki unchai itni hogi jitni zameen-o-aasman ki, yani paanch sau saal ki (Tirmidhi). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, baaz ahl-e-ma'ani ne kaha hai ke matlab is hadith-e-sharif ka yeh hai ke farsh ki bulandi darjay ki aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai, yani ek darja doosre darjay se is qadar buland hai. Har do darjon mein paanch sau saal ki raah ka fasla hai, phir yeh bhi khayal rahe ke yeh riwayat sirf Rushd bin Sa'ad se marwi hai aur woh za'eef hain. Yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Jareer, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marwi hai ke in ki unchai assi saal ki hai. Is ke baad zameer layi jis ka marja pehle mazkoor nahin is liye ke qareena majood hai. Bistar ka zikr aaya jis par jannatiyon ki biwiyan hongi, pas in ki taraf zameer pher di. Jaise Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke zikr mein Taurat ka lafz aaya hai aur Shams ka lafz is se pehle nahin, pas qareena kafi hai. Lekin Abu Ubaida kehte hain pehle mazkoor ho chuka, aayat (وَحُوْرٌ عِيْنٌ 22 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 22), pas farmata hai ke hum ne in biwiyon ko nayi paidaish mein paida kiya hai, is ke baad ke woh baakal phoos burhiya thin, hum ne unhein nau-umar kunwariyan kar ke ek khaas paidaish mein paida kiya. Woh apne zafafat-o-malahat, husn-e-soorat-o-jasamat se khush khulqi aur halawat ki wajah se apne khawandon ki bari pyariyan hain. Baaz kehte hain 'Uraba' kehte hain naaz-o-karishma waliyon ko. Hadith mein hai ke yeh woh auratein hain jo duniya mein burhiya thin aur ab jannat mein gayi hain toh unhein nau-umar waghera kar diya hai aur riwayat mein hai ke khwah yeh auratein kunwari thin ya thayyiba thin, Allah Ta'ala in sab ko aisi kar de ga. Ek burhiya aurat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar kehti hai ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe jannat mein dakhil kar de, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Um-e-Fulan! Jannat mein koi burhiya nahin jaye gi." Woh roti hui wapas lotin toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Jao unhein samjha do," matlab yeh hai ke jab woh jannat mein jayen gi burhiya nahin hon gi.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum unhein nayi paidaish mein paida karenge phir bakirah kardenge. Shamail-e-Tirmidhi waghera Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Um-e-Salma R.A farmati hain main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hoor-e-Ain ki khabar mujhe dijiye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh gore rang ki hain, badi badi aankhon wali hain, sakht siyah aur bade bade baalon wali hain jaise gidh ka par. Main ne kaha (Al-Lu'lu-ul-Maknoon 23) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 23) ki babat khabar dijiye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya din ki safai aur jot misl us moti ke hai jo seep se abhi abhi nikla ho jise kisi ka hath bhi na laga ho. Main ne kaha Khairat-e-Hissan ki kya tafseer hai? Farmaya khush khulq khubsurat. Main ne kaha (Ka-annahunna Baidun Maknoon 49) (Surah As-Saffat: 49) se kya murad hai? Farmaya un ki nazakat aur narmi ande ki us jhilli ki manind hogi jo andar hoti hai. Main ne Uruban Atraba ke ma'ani daryaft kiye, farmaya is se murad duniya ki musalman jannati auratein hain jo bilkul budhiya phoos thin, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein naye sire se paida kiya aur kunwariyan aur khawandon ki chahitiyan aur khawandon se ishq rakhne waliyan aur hum-umar banadein. Main ne pucha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya ki auratein afzal hain jaise astar se abra behtar hota hai, main ne kaha is fazilat ki kya wajah hai? Farmaya namazein, roze aur Allah Ta'ala ki ibadatein, Allah ne un ke chehre noor se un ke jism resham se sanwar diye hain, safed resham, sabz resham aur zard sunhare resham aur zard sunhare zevar, bakhurdan moti ke, kanghiyan sone ki. Yeh kehti rahengi: Nahnu-l-Khalidatu fala namootu abada, wa nahnu-n-Na'imatu fala nab'asu abada, wa nahnu-l-Muqimatu fala naz'anu abada, wa nahnu-r-Radiyatu fala naskhatu abada, Tooba liman kunna lahu wa kana lana. Ya'ni hum hamesha rehne wali hain kabhi maren gi nahin, hum naaz aur ne'mat waliyan hain ki kabhi safar mein nahin jayengi, hum apne khawandon se khush rehne waliyan hain ki kabhi roothengi nahin. Khush naseeb hain woh log jin ke liye hum hain aur khush naseeb hain hum ki un ke liye hain. Main ne pucha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba'az aurton ke do do teen teen char char khawand ho jate hain us ke baad use maut aati hai, marne ke baad agar yeh jannat mein gayi aur us ke sab khawand bhi gaye to yeh kise milegi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya use ikhtiyar diya jayega ki jis ke sath chahe rahe, chunancha yeh un mein se use pasand karegi jo us ke sath behtareen bartao karta raha ho, Allah Ta'ala se kahegi Parwardigar! Yeh mujh se bahut achi bodobash rakhta tha isi ke nikah mein mujhe de. Ae Um-e-Salma! Husn-e-Khulq duniya aur akhirat ki bhalaion ko liye hue hai. Soor ki mashhoor mutawwal hadith mein hai ki Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tamam musalmanon ko jannat mein le jane ki sifarish karenge jis par Allah Ta'ala farmayega main ne aap ki shafa'at qabool ki aur aap ko unhein jannat mein pahunchane ki ijazat di. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain phir main unhein jannat mein le jaunga, Allah ki qasam tum jis qadar apne ghar bar aur apni biwion se waqif ho us se bahut zyada ahl-e-jannat apne gharon aur biwion se waqif honge.

Pas ek ek jannati ki behtar behtar biwiyan hongi jo Allah ki banai hui hain aur do do biwiyan aurton mein se hongi ke unhein ba-wajah apni ibadat ke un sab aurton par fazilat hasil hogi. Jannati in mein se ek ke paas jayega, yeh us bala-khane mein hogi jo yaqoot ka bana hua hoga, us palang par hogi jo sone ki taron se bana hua hoga aur jadao jada hua hoga, sattar jore pehne hue honge jo sab bareek aur sabz chamkeele khalis resham ke honge. Yeh biwi is qadar nazuk noorani hogi ke us ki kamar par hath rakh kar seene ki taraf se dekhega to saaf nazar aa jayega, ke kapre, gosht, haddi koi cheez rok na hogi, is qadar us ka jism saaf aur aaina-numa hoga jis tarah marwareed mein surakh kar ke dora daal dein to woh dora bahar se nazar aata hai isi tarah us ki pindli ka goda nazar aayega. Aisa hi noorani badan us jannati ka bhi hoga, al-gharaz yeh us ka aaina hogi, aur woh us ka, yeh us ke sath aish-o-ishrat mein mashghool hoga na yeh thake na woh, na is ka dil bhare na is ka. Jab kabhi nazdeki karega to kunwari payega, na us ka uzu sust ho na use garan guzre, magar khas paani wahan na hoga jis se ghinn aaye. Yeh yunhi mashghool hoga jo kaan mein nida aayegi ke yeh to hamein khoob maloom hai ke na aap ka dil in se bharega na in ka aap se magar aap ki dusri biwiyan bhi hain. Ab yeh yahan se bahar aayega aur ek ek ke paas jayega, jis ke paas jayega use dekh kar be-sakhta us ke munh se nikal jayega ke Rab ki qasam tujh se behtar jannat mein koi cheez nahin, na meri mohabbat kisi se tujh se zyada hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se puchte hain ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya jannat mein jannati log jama bhi karenge? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Haan, qasam us Allah ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, khoob achi tarah behtareen tareeq par, jab alag hoga woh usi waqt phir paak saaf achooti bakira ban jayegi. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain momin ko jannat mein itni itni aurton ke paas jaane ki quwwat ata ki jayegi. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ) kya itni taqat rakhega? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ek sau aadmiyon ke barabar use quwwat milegi. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai ek ek sau kunwariyon ke paas ek ek din mein ho aayega. Hafiz Abdullah Maqdisi (R.H) farmate hain mere nazdeek yeh hadith shart-e-sahih par hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abbas (R.A) 'Uruban' ki tafsir mein farmate hain yeh apne khawandon ki mehbooba hongi, yeh apne khawandon ki aashiq aur khawand un ke aashiq. Ikrama (R.H) se marwi hai ke is ka ma'ni naaz-o-karishma wali hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke ma'ni nazakat wali hai. Tameem bin Hadlam kehte hain 'Uruban' us aurat ko kehte hain jo apne khawand ka dil mutthi mein rakhe. Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) waghaira se marwi hai ke murad khush-kalam hai, apni baton se apne khawandon ka dil mol leti hain, jab kuch bolein yeh maloom hota hai ke phool jharte hain aur noor barasta hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke unhein Arab is liye kaha gaya hai ke un ki bol chaal Arabi zaban mein hogi. Atraban ke ma'ani hain hum-umar, ya'ni taintis (33) baras ki. Aur ma'ani hain ke khawand ki aur un ki tabiyat aur khulq bilkul yaksan hai, jis se woh khush, yeh khush; jo usay na-pasand, usay bhi na-pasand. Yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke aapas mein un mein bair, bughz, sotia-dah, hasad aur rashk na hoga. Yeh sab aapas mein bhi hum-umar hongi taake be-takalluf ek dusri se milein julein, khelein kudein. Tirmidhi ki hadith mein hai ke yeh Jannati hoorein ek rooh-afza bagh mein jama ho kar nihayat pyare gale se gana gayengi ke aisi surili aur rasili awaz makhlooq ne kabhi na suni hogi. Un ka gana wahi hoga jo upar bayan hua. Abu Ya'la mein hai un ke gane mein yeh bhi hoga: (Nahnu khayratun hisan) (Khubina li-azwajin kiram). Hum pak-saf, khush-waza, khubsurat auratein hain jo buzurg aur zi-izzat shauharon ke liye chupa kar rakhi gayi thin. Aur riwayat mein khayrat ke badle jawar ka lafz aaya hai. Phir farmaya yeh Ashab-e-Yameen ke liye paida ki gayi hain aur unhi ke liye mehfooz-o-masoon rakhi gayi thin. Lekin zyada zahir yeh hai ke yeh muta'liq hai ayat (Inna ansha'nahunna insha'a) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 35) ke, ya'ni hum ne unhein un ke liye banaya hai. Hazrat Abu Sulaiman Darani (Rahimahullah) se manqool hai ke main ne ek raat tahajjud ki namaz ke baad dua mangni shuru ki, chunke sakht sardi thi, bade zor ka pala pad raha tha, hath uthaye nahin jate the is liye main ne ek hi hath se dua mangi aur isi halat mein dua mangte mangte mujhe neend aa gayi. Khwab mein main ne ek hoor ko dekha ke us jaisi khubsurat noorani shakal kabhi meri nigah se nahin guzri. Us ne mujh se kaha: Ae Abu Sulaiman! Ek hi hath se dua mangne lage aur yeh khayal nahin ke panch sau (500) saal se Allah Ta'ala mujhe tumhare liye apni khas ne'maton mein parwarish kar raha hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh laam muta'liq Atraban ke ho, ya'ni un ki hum-umar hongi. Jaise ke Bukhari, Muslim waghera ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehli jama'at jo Jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhvin raat jaise roshan honge, un ke baad wali jama'at ke bahut chamakdar sitare jaise roshan honge. Yeh pakhane, peshab, thook, rent se pak honge. Un ki kanghiyan sone ki hongi, un ke paseene mushk ki khushbu wale honge, un ki angithiyan lu'lu ki hongi, un ki biwiyan hoor-e-ain hongi. Un sab ke akhlaq misl ek hi shakhs ke honge, yeh sab apne baap Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki shakal par sath (60) hath ke lambe qad ke honge. Tabrani mein hai: Ahl-e-Jannat be-baal aur be-resh, gore rang wale, khush-khulq aur khubsurat, surmagin ankhon wale, taintis (33) baras ki umar ke, saat (7) hath lambe aur saat (7) hath chaude chakle mazboot badan wale honge. Is ka kuch hissa Tirmidhi mein bhi marwi hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke go kisi umr mein inteqal hua ho dakhul-e-jannat ke waqt taintis (33) saala umr ke honge aur isi umr mein hamesha rahenge, isi tarah jahannami bhi (Tirmidhi). Aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke qad saat haath farishtay ke haath ke aitbaar se honge, qad-e-Adam, husn-e-Yusuf, umr-e-Isa A.S yaani taintis (33) saal aur zabaan Muhammad ﷺ yaani Arabi waale honge, be-baal aur surmagin aankhon waale (Ibn Abi Dunya). Aur riwayat mein hai ke dakhul-e-jannat ke saath hi unhein ek jannati darakht ke paas laya jayega aur wahan unhein kapray pehnaye jayenge, un ke kapray na galen na sarren na purane hon na maile hon, un ki jawani na dhale na jaye na fana ho.

Ashab-e-Yameen guzashta ummaton mein se bhi bahut hain aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne apne sahaba se bayaan farmaya, mere saamne Anbiya ma'a apne tabe-daar ummatiyon ke pesh hue, ba'az Nabi guzarte the aur ba'az Nabi ke saath ek jamaat hoti thi aur ba'az Nabi ke saath sirf teen aadmi hote the aur ba'az ke saath ek bhi tha. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Qatada R.H ne itna bayaan farmaya ke yeh aayat padhi (Alaisa minkum rajulur rashid) (Surah Hud: 78) kya tum mein se ek bhi rushd-o-samajh waala nahin? Yahan tak ke Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S guzre jo Bani Israel ki ek badi jamaat saath liye hue the, main ne poocha Parwardigar yeh kaun hain? Jawab mila yeh tumhare bhai Musa bin Imran hain aur un ke saath un ki tabe-daari karne waali ummat hai. Main ne poocha Ilahi phir meri ummat kahan hai? Farmaya apni dahini jaanib neeche ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to bahut badi jamaat nazar aayi, logon ke bakasrat chehre damak rahe the. Phir mujh se poocha kaho ab to khush ho? Main ne kaha haan Ilahi main khush hoon. Mujh se farmaya ab apni baayin jaanib kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha woh wahan beshumar log the, phir mujh se poocha ab to raazi ho gaye? Main ne kaha haan mere Rab main raazi hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya aur suno un ke saath sattar hazaar aur log hain jo baghair hisaab ke jannat mein dakhil honge. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ukasha R.A khade ho gaye, yeh qabeela Banu Asad se Muhsan ke ladke the, Badr ki ladai mein maujood the, arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke mujhe bhi inhi mein se kare, aap ne dua ki. Phir ek aur shakhs khade hue aur kaha ae Allah ke Rasool mere liye bhi dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya Ukasha tujh par sabqat kar gaye. Phir aap ne farmaya logon tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar tum se ho sake to un sattar hazaar mein se bano jo be-hisaab jannat mein jayenge, warna kam se kam daayin jaanib waalon mein se ho jao ge, yeh bhi na ho sake to kinare waalon mein se ban jao. Main ne aksar logon ko dekha hai ke apne haal mein hi latak jaate hain. Phir farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tadaad sirf tumhari hi hogi. Pas hum ne takbeer kahi, phir farmaya balkay mujhe umeed hai ke tum tamam jannat ki tihayi waale hoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi.

Farmaya aur suno! Tum aadhon aadh ahl-e-jannat ke hoge. Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, us ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) ki tilawat ki. Ab hum mein aapas mein muzakira shuru ho gaya ke yeh sattar hazaar kaun log honge, phir hum ne kaha woh log jo Islam mein paida hue aur shirk kiya hi nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh yeh woh log hain jo daagh nahin lagwate aur jhaar phoonk nahin karwate aur faal nahin lete aur apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Yeh hadith bahut si sanadon se Sahaba ki riwayat se bahut si kitabon mein sehat ke saath marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is aayat mein pehlon pichlon se murad meri ummat ke agle pichle hi hain.

Ashab-e-Yameen aur un par inamaat-e-Ilahi. Sabiqeen ka haal bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala ab Abrar ka haal bayan farmata hai jo Sabiqeen se kam martaba hain. Un ka kya haal hai kya natija hai ise suno, yeh un jannaton mein hain jahan beri ke darakht hain lekin kante daar nahin. Aur phal bakasrat aur behtareen hain. Duniya mein beri ke darakht zyada kanton wale aur kam phalon wale hote hain. Jannat ke yeh darakht zyada phalon wale aur bilkul be-khar honge, phalon ke bojh se darakht ke tane jhuke jate honge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Najjar (R.H) ne ek riwayat warid ki hai ke Sahaba kehte hain ke A'rabiyon ka Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aana aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masail puchna hamein bahut nafa deta tha. Ek martaba ek A'rabi ne aa kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran mein ek aise darakht ka bhi zikr hai jo eza deta, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne pucha woh kaunsa? Us ne kaha beri ka darakht, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir tu ne us ke sath hi lafz makh-sood nahin padha? Us ke kante Allah Ta'ala ne door kar diye hain aur un ke badle phal paida kar diye hain. Har ek beri mein behtar qisam ke zaiqe honge jin ka rang-o-maza mukhtalif hoga, yeh riwayat dusri kitabon mein bhi marwi hai is mein lafz talh hai aur sattar zaiqon ka bayan hai. Talh ek bada darakht hai jo Hijaz ki sarzameen mein hota hai, yeh kante daar darakht hai is mein kante bahut zyada hote hain. Chunancha Ibn-e-Jareer ne is ki shahadat Arabi ke ek sher se bhi di hai. Mandood ke ma'ni teh-ba-teh phal wala, phal se lada hua. In dono ka zikr is liye hua ke Arab in darakhton ki gehri aur meethi chhaon ko pasand karte the, yeh darakht bazahir dunyawi darakht jaisa hoga lekin bajaye kanton ke is mein sheereen phal honge. Johari farmate hain talh bhi kehte hain aur tal'a bhi, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai, to mumkin hai ke yeh bhi beri ki hi sifat ho, yani woh beriyan be-khar aur bakasrat phal-dar hain wallahu a'lam. Aur hazrat ne talh se murad kele ka darakht kaha hai, Ahl-e-Yaman kele ko talh kehte hain aur Ahl-e-Hijaz moz kehte hain. Lambe lambe sayon mein yeh honge. Sahih Bukhari mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jannat ke darakht ke saye tale tez sawar sau saal tak chalta rahega lekin saya khatam na hoga.

Agar tum chaho is aayat ko parho, Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai aur Musnad-e-Ahmad, Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein bhi Musnad ki aur hadith mein shak ke saath hai yani sattar ya sau aur yeh bhi hai ke yeh Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai, Ibn-e-Jarir aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai pas yeh hadith mutawatir aur qatan sahih hai is ki asnaad bohat hain aur is ke rawi siqah hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne jab yeh riwayat bayan ki aur Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke kaanon tak pahunchi to aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne Taurat Hazrat Musa (A.S) par aur Quran Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara ke agar koi shakhs naujawan oontni par sawar ho kar us waqt chalta rahe jab tak woh burhiya ho kar gir jaye to bhi is ki intiha ko nahin pahunch sakta, Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath se boya hai aur khud aap ne is mein apne paas ki rooh phoonki hai is ki shakhein Jannat ki deewaron se bahar nikli hui hain. Abu Haseen kehte hain ke ek mauza mein ek darwaze par hum thay hamare saath Abu Saleh aur Shafeeq Jahni bhi thay aur Abu Saleh ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) wali oopar ki hadith bayan ki aur kaha kya tu Abu Huraira (R.A) ko jhutlata hai? Us ne kaha nahin, unhein to nahin tujhe jhutlata hoon. Pas yeh qariyon par bohat garan guzra. Main kehta hoon is saabit, sahih aur marfoo hadith ko jo jhutlaye woh ghalti par hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Jannat ke har darakht ka tana sone ka hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein ek darakht hai jis ke har taraf sau sau saal ke raaste tak saya phaila hua hai. Jannati log is ke neeche aakar baithte hain aur aapas mein baatein karte hain. Kisi ko dunyawi khel tamashe aur dil behlawe yaad aate hain to usi waqt ek Jannati hawa chalti hai aur us darakht mein se tamam raag ragniyan baaje gaaje aur khel tamashon ki aawazein aane lagti hain, yeh asar ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad qawi hai. Hazrat Amr bin Maimoon (R.H) farmate hain yeh saya sattar hazar saal ki toolani mein hoga. Aap se marfoo hadith mein ek sau saal marwi hai yeh saya ghat-ta hi nahin na sooraj aaye na garmi sataye, fajr ke tuloo hone se peshtar ka samaan har waqt is ke neeche rehta hai. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein hamesha woh waqt rahega jo subh-e-sadiq ke baad se lekar aaftab ke tuloo hone ke darmiyan darmiyan rehta hai saya ke mazmoon ki riwayatein bhi is se pehle guzar chuki hain, jaise aayat (Wa nudkhiluhum zillan zaleela) (4. An-Nisa: 57) aur aayat (Ukuluha da'imun wa zilluha) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 35) aur aayat (Innal muttaqeena fee zilalin wa uyoon) (77. Al-Mursalat: 41) waghera paani hoga behta hua magar nehron ke garhay aur khudi hui zameen na hogi, is ki poori tafseer aayat (Feeha anharun min ma'in ghairi aasin) (47. Muhammad: 15) mein guzar chuki hai. Un ke paas bakasrat tarah tarah ke lazeez meway hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhe na kisi kaan ne sune na kisi insani dil par un ka wahm-o-khayal guzra.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai jab wahan phalon se rozi diye jayenge toh kahenge ke yeh toh hum pehle bhi diye gaye thay kyunke bilkul hum-shakal honge, lekin jab khayenge toh zaiqa aur hi payenge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Sidratul-Muntaha ke zikr mein hai ke uske patte misl hathi ke kanon ke honge aur phal misl hajar ke bade bade matkon ke honge, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki is hadith mein jis mein aap ne suraj ke gehan hone ka aur Huzoor ﷺ ka suraj gehan ki namaz ada karne ka waqia tafseel se bayan kiya hai yeh bhi hai ke baad-e-faraghat aap ke sath ke namaziyon ne aap se poocha Huzoor ﷺ hum ne aap ko is jagah aage badhte aur peeche hat-te dekha kya baat thi? Aap ne farmaya main ne jannat dekhi jannat ke mewon ka khosha lena chaha agar main le leta toh rehti duniya tak woh rehta aur tum khate rehte. Abu Ya'la mein hai Zohar ki farz namaz padhate hue Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ aage badh gaye aur hum bhi phir aap ne goya koi cheez leni chahi, phir peeche hat aaye, namaz se farigh ho kar Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne poocha ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj toh aap ne aisi baat ki jo is se pehle kabhi nahin ki thi, aap ne farmaya mere samne jannat layi gayi aur jo is mein tar-o-tazgi aur sabzi hai main ne is mein se ek angoor ka khosha todna chaha taake la kar tumhein doon pas mere aur us ke darmiyan parda hail kar diya gaya aur agar main isay tumhare paas le aata toh zameen-o-aasman ke darmiyan ki makhlooq isay khati rehti taham is mein zara si bhi kami na aati. Isi ke misl Hazrat Jabir R.A se Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi marwi hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek a'arabi ne aa kar Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se Hauz-e-Kausar ki babat sawal kiya aur jannat ka bhi zikr kiya poocha ke kya is mein meway bhi hain? Aap ne farmaya haan wahan Tuba nami darakht bhi hai? Phir kuch kaha jo mujhe yaad nahin phir poocha woh darakht hamari zameen ke kis darakht se mushabahat rakhta hai? Aap ne farmaya tere mulk ki zameen mein koi darakht is ka hum-shakal nahin. Kya tu Sham mein gaya hai? Us ne kaha nahin, farmaya Sham mein ek darakht hota hai jise Joza kehte hain ek hi tana hota hai aur upar ka hissa phaila hua hota hai woh albatta is ke mushabeh hai, us ne poocha Jannati khoshe kitne bade hote hain? Farmaya kala kawa mahina bhar tak udta rahe utne bade. Woh kehne laga is darakht ka tana kis qadar mota hai aap ne farmaya agar tu apni oontni ke bachay ko chhod de aur woh chalta rahe yahan tak ke boodha ho kar gir pade tab bhi us ke tanay ka chakkar poora nahin kar sakta. Us ne kaha is mein angoor bhi lagte hain? Aap ne farmaya haan poocha kitne bade? Aap ne jawab diya ke kya kabhi tere baap ne apne rewar mein se koi mota taza bakra zibah kar ke us ki khaal khench kar teri maa ko de kar kaha hai ke is ka dol bana lo? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya bas utne hi bade bade angoor ke danay hote hain.

Us ne kaha phir toh ek hi dana mujh ko aur mere ghar walon ko kafi hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkay sari baradri ko, phir yeh meway bhi hamesha rehne walay hain. Na kabhi khatam hon na kabhi in se roka jaye. Yeh nahin ke jaaray mein hain aur garmiyon mein nahin, ya garmiyon mein hain aur jaaray mein nadarat, balkay yeh meway dawam walay aur hamesha hamesha rehne walay hain, jab talab karein pa lein, Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat har waqt woh majood rahen ge, balkay kisi kaantay aur kisi shaakh ko bhi aar na hogi, na doori hogi, na hasil karne mein takalluf aur takleef hogi. Balkay idhar phal tora idhar us ke qaim maqam doosra phal lag gaya, jaise ke us se pehle hadith mein guzar chuka. In ke farsh buland-o-bala narm aur gadgad-e rahat-o-aaram dene walay hon ge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain in ki unchai itni hogi jitni zameen-o-aasman ki, yani paanch sau saal ki (Tirmidhi). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, baaz ahl-e-ma'ani ne kaha hai ke matlab is hadith-e-sharif ka yeh hai ke farsh ki bulandi darjay ki aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai, yani ek darja doosre darjay se is qadar buland hai. Har do darjon mein paanch sau saal ki raah ka fasla hai, phir yeh bhi khayal rahe ke yeh riwayat sirf Rushd bin Sa'ad se marwi hai aur woh za'eef hain. Yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Jareer, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marwi hai ke in ki unchai assi saal ki hai. Is ke baad zameer layi jis ka marja pehle mazkoor nahin is liye ke qareena majood hai. Bistar ka zikr aaya jis par jannatiyon ki biwiyan hongi, pas in ki taraf zameer pher di. Jaise Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke zikr mein Taurat ka lafz aaya hai aur Shams ka lafz is se pehle nahin, pas qareena kafi hai. Lekin Abu Ubaida kehte hain pehle mazkoor ho chuka, aayat (وَحُوْرٌ عِيْنٌ 22 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 22), pas farmata hai ke hum ne in biwiyon ko nayi paidaish mein paida kiya hai, is ke baad ke woh baakal phoos burhiya thin, hum ne unhein nau-umar kunwariyan kar ke ek khaas paidaish mein paida kiya. Woh apne zafafat-o-malahat, husn-e-soorat-o-jasamat se khush khulqi aur halawat ki wajah se apne khawandon ki bari pyariyan hain. Baaz kehte hain 'Uraba' kehte hain naaz-o-karishma waliyon ko. Hadith mein hai ke yeh woh auratein hain jo duniya mein burhiya thin aur ab jannat mein gayi hain toh unhein nau-umar waghera kar diya hai aur riwayat mein hai ke khwah yeh auratein kunwari thin ya thayyiba thin, Allah Ta'ala in sab ko aisi kar de ga. Ek burhiya aurat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar kehti hai ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe jannat mein dakhil kar de, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Um-e-Fulan! Jannat mein koi burhiya nahin jaye gi." Woh roti hui wapas lotin toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Jao unhein samjha do," matlab yeh hai ke jab woh jannat mein jayen gi burhiya nahin hon gi.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai hum unhein nayi paidaish mein paida karenge phir bakirah kardenge. Shamail-e-Tirmidhi waghera Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Um-e-Salma R.A farmati hain main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hoor-e-Ain ki khabar mujhe dijiye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh gore rang ki hain, badi badi aankhon wali hain, sakht siyah aur bade bade baalon wali hain jaise gidh ka par. Main ne kaha (Al-Lu'lu-ul-Maknoon 23) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 23) ki babat khabar dijiye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya din ki safai aur jot misl us moti ke hai jo seep se abhi abhi nikla ho jise kisi ka hath bhi na laga ho. Main ne kaha Khairat-e-Hissan ki kya tafseer hai? Farmaya khush khulq khubsurat. Main ne kaha (Ka-annahunna Baidun Maknoon 49) (Surah As-Saffat: 49) se kya murad hai? Farmaya un ki nazakat aur narmi ande ki us jhilli ki manind hogi jo andar hoti hai. Main ne Uruban Atraba ke ma'ani daryaft kiye, farmaya is se murad duniya ki musalman jannati auratein hain jo bilkul budhiya phoos thin, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein naye sire se paida kiya aur kunwariyan aur khawandon ki chahitiyan aur khawandon se ishq rakhne waliyan aur hum-umar banadein. Main ne pucha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya ki auratein afzal hain jaise astar se abra behtar hota hai, main ne kaha is fazilat ki kya wajah hai? Farmaya namazein, roze aur Allah Ta'ala ki ibadatein, Allah ne un ke chehre noor se un ke jism resham se sanwar diye hain, safed resham, sabz resham aur zard sunhare resham aur zard sunhare zevar, bakhurdan moti ke, kanghiyan sone ki. Yeh kehti rahengi: Nahnu-l-Khalidatu fala namootu abada, wa nahnu-n-Na'imatu fala nab'asu abada, wa nahnu-l-Muqimatu fala naz'anu abada, wa nahnu-r-Radiyatu fala naskhatu abada, Tooba liman kunna lahu wa kana lana. Ya'ni hum hamesha rehne wali hain kabhi maren gi nahin, hum naaz aur ne'mat waliyan hain ki kabhi safar mein nahin jayengi, hum apne khawandon se khush rehne waliyan hain ki kabhi roothengi nahin. Khush naseeb hain woh log jin ke liye hum hain aur khush naseeb hain hum ki un ke liye hain. Main ne pucha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba'az aurton ke do do teen teen char char khawand ho jate hain us ke baad use maut aati hai, marne ke baad agar yeh jannat mein gayi aur us ke sab khawand bhi gaye to yeh kise milegi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya use ikhtiyar diya jayega ki jis ke sath chahe rahe, chunancha yeh un mein se use pasand karegi jo us ke sath behtareen bartao karta raha ho, Allah Ta'ala se kahegi Parwardigar! Yeh mujh se bahut achi bodobash rakhta tha isi ke nikah mein mujhe de. Ae Um-e-Salma! Husn-e-Khulq duniya aur akhirat ki bhalaion ko liye hue hai. Soor ki mashhoor mutawwal hadith mein hai ki Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tamam musalmanon ko jannat mein le jane ki sifarish karenge jis par Allah Ta'ala farmayega main ne aap ki shafa'at qabool ki aur aap ko unhein jannat mein pahunchane ki ijazat di. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain phir main unhein jannat mein le jaunga, Allah ki qasam tum jis qadar apne ghar bar aur apni biwion se waqif ho us se bahut zyada ahl-e-jannat apne gharon aur biwion se waqif honge.

Pas ek ek jannati ki behtar behtar biwiyan hongi jo Allah ki banai hui hain aur do do biwiyan aurton mein se hongi ke unhein ba-wajah apni ibadat ke un sab aurton par fazilat hasil hogi. Jannati in mein se ek ke paas jayega, yeh us bala-khane mein hogi jo yaqoot ka bana hua hoga, us palang par hogi jo sone ki taron se bana hua hoga aur jadao jada hua hoga, sattar jore pehne hue honge jo sab bareek aur sabz chamkeele khalis resham ke honge. Yeh biwi is qadar nazuk noorani hogi ke us ki kamar par hath rakh kar seene ki taraf se dekhega to saaf nazar aa jayega, ke kapre, gosht, haddi koi cheez rok na hogi, is qadar us ka jism saaf aur aaina-numa hoga jis tarah marwareed mein surakh kar ke dora daal dein to woh dora bahar se nazar aata hai isi tarah us ki pindli ka goda nazar aayega. Aisa hi noorani badan us jannati ka bhi hoga, al-gharaz yeh us ka aaina hogi, aur woh us ka, yeh us ke sath aish-o-ishrat mein mashghool hoga na yeh thake na woh, na is ka dil bhare na is ka. Jab kabhi nazdeki karega to kunwari payega, na us ka uzu sust ho na use garan guzre, magar khas paani wahan na hoga jis se ghinn aaye. Yeh yunhi mashghool hoga jo kaan mein nida aayegi ke yeh to hamein khoob maloom hai ke na aap ka dil in se bharega na in ka aap se magar aap ki dusri biwiyan bhi hain. Ab yeh yahan se bahar aayega aur ek ek ke paas jayega, jis ke paas jayega use dekh kar be-sakhta us ke munh se nikal jayega ke Rab ki qasam tujh se behtar jannat mein koi cheez nahin, na meri mohabbat kisi se tujh se zyada hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se puchte hain ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kya jannat mein jannati log jama bhi karenge? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Haan, qasam us Allah ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, khoob achi tarah behtareen tareeq par, jab alag hoga woh usi waqt phir paak saaf achooti bakira ban jayegi. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain momin ko jannat mein itni itni aurton ke paas jaane ki quwwat ata ki jayegi. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ) kya itni taqat rakhega? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ek sau aadmiyon ke barabar use quwwat milegi. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai ek ek sau kunwariyon ke paas ek ek din mein ho aayega. Hafiz Abdullah Maqdisi (R.H) farmate hain mere nazdeek yeh hadith shart-e-sahih par hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abbas (R.A) 'Uruban' ki tafsir mein farmate hain yeh apne khawandon ki mehbooba hongi, yeh apne khawandon ki aashiq aur khawand un ke aashiq. Ikrama (R.H) se marwi hai ke is ka ma'ni naaz-o-karishma wali hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke ma'ni nazakat wali hai. Tameem bin Hadlam kehte hain 'Uruban' us aurat ko kehte hain jo apne khawand ka dil mutthi mein rakhe. Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) waghaira se marwi hai ke murad khush-kalam hai, apni baton se apne khawandon ka dil mol leti hain, jab kuch bolein yeh maloom hota hai ke phool jharte hain aur noor barasta hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke unhein Arab is liye kaha gaya hai ke un ki bol chaal Arabi zaban mein hogi. Atraban ke ma'ani hain hum-umar, ya'ni taintis (33) baras ki. Aur ma'ani hain ke khawand ki aur un ki tabiyat aur khulq bilkul yaksan hai, jis se woh khush, yeh khush; jo usay na-pasand, usay bhi na-pasand. Yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke aapas mein un mein bair, bughz, sotia-dah, hasad aur rashk na hoga. Yeh sab aapas mein bhi hum-umar hongi taake be-takalluf ek dusri se milein julein, khelein kudein. Tirmidhi ki hadith mein hai ke yeh Jannati hoorein ek rooh-afza bagh mein jama ho kar nihayat pyare gale se gana gayengi ke aisi surili aur rasili awaz makhlooq ne kabhi na suni hogi. Un ka gana wahi hoga jo upar bayan hua. Abu Ya'la mein hai un ke gane mein yeh bhi hoga: (Nahnu khayratun hisan) (Khubina li-azwajin kiram). Hum pak-saf, khush-waza, khubsurat auratein hain jo buzurg aur zi-izzat shauharon ke liye chupa kar rakhi gayi thin. Aur riwayat mein khayrat ke badle jawar ka lafz aaya hai. Phir farmaya yeh Ashab-e-Yameen ke liye paida ki gayi hain aur unhi ke liye mehfooz-o-masoon rakhi gayi thin. Lekin zyada zahir yeh hai ke yeh muta'liq hai ayat (Inna ansha'nahunna insha'a) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 35) ke, ya'ni hum ne unhein un ke liye banaya hai. Hazrat Abu Sulaiman Darani (Rahimahullah) se manqool hai ke main ne ek raat tahajjud ki namaz ke baad dua mangni shuru ki, chunke sakht sardi thi, bade zor ka pala pad raha tha, hath uthaye nahin jate the is liye main ne ek hi hath se dua mangi aur isi halat mein dua mangte mangte mujhe neend aa gayi. Khwab mein main ne ek hoor ko dekha ke us jaisi khubsurat noorani shakal kabhi meri nigah se nahin guzri. Us ne mujh se kaha: Ae Abu Sulaiman! Ek hi hath se dua mangne lage aur yeh khayal nahin ke panch sau (500) saal se Allah Ta'ala mujhe tumhare liye apni khas ne'maton mein parwarish kar raha hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh laam muta'liq Atraban ke ho, ya'ni un ki hum-umar hongi. Jaise ke Bukhari, Muslim waghera ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehli jama'at jo Jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhvin raat jaise roshan honge, un ke baad wali jama'at ke bahut chamakdar sitare jaise roshan honge. Yeh pakhane, peshab, thook, rent se pak honge. Un ki kanghiyan sone ki hongi, un ke paseene mushk ki khushbu wale honge, un ki angithiyan lu'lu ki hongi, un ki biwiyan hoor-e-ain hongi. Un sab ke akhlaq misl ek hi shakhs ke honge, yeh sab apne baap Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ki shakal par sath (60) hath ke lambe qad ke honge. Tabrani mein hai: Ahl-e-Jannat be-baal aur be-resh, gore rang wale, khush-khulq aur khubsurat, surmagin ankhon wale, taintis (33) baras ki umar ke, saat (7) hath lambe aur saat (7) hath chaude chakle mazboot badan wale honge. Is ka kuch hissa Tirmidhi mein bhi marwi hai.

Aur hadith mein hai ke go kisi umr mein inteqal hua ho dakhul-e-jannat ke waqt taintis (33) saala umr ke honge aur isi umr mein hamesha rahenge, isi tarah jahannami bhi (Tirmidhi). Aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke qad saat haath farishtay ke haath ke aitbaar se honge, qad-e-Adam, husn-e-Yusuf, umr-e-Isa A.S yaani taintis (33) saal aur zabaan Muhammad ﷺ yaani Arabi waale honge, be-baal aur surmagin aankhon waale (Ibn Abi Dunya). Aur riwayat mein hai ke dakhul-e-jannat ke saath hi unhein ek jannati darakht ke paas laya jayega aur wahan unhein kapray pehnaye jayenge, un ke kapray na galen na sarren na purane hon na maile hon, un ki jawani na dhale na jaye na fana ho.

Ashab-e-Yameen guzashta ummaton mein se bhi bahut hain aur pichlon mein se bhi bahut hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne apne sahaba se bayaan farmaya, mere saamne Anbiya ma'a apne tabe-daar ummatiyon ke pesh hue, ba'az Nabi guzarte the aur ba'az Nabi ke saath ek jamaat hoti thi aur ba'az Nabi ke saath sirf teen aadmi hote the aur ba'az ke saath ek bhi tha. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Qatada R.H ne itna bayaan farmaya ke yeh aayat padhi (Alaisa minkum rajulur rashid) (Surah Hud: 78) kya tum mein se ek bhi rushd-o-samajh waala nahin? Yahan tak ke Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S guzre jo Bani Israel ki ek badi jamaat saath liye hue the, main ne poocha Parwardigar yeh kaun hain? Jawab mila yeh tumhare bhai Musa bin Imran hain aur un ke saath un ki tabe-daari karne waali ummat hai. Main ne poocha Ilahi phir meri ummat kahan hai? Farmaya apni dahini jaanib neeche ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to bahut badi jamaat nazar aayi, logon ke bakasrat chehre damak rahe the. Phir mujh se poocha kaho ab to khush ho? Main ne kaha haan Ilahi main khush hoon. Mujh se farmaya ab apni baayin jaanib kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha woh wahan beshumar log the, phir mujh se poocha ab to raazi ho gaye? Main ne kaha haan mere Rab main raazi hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya aur suno un ke saath sattar hazaar aur log hain jo baghair hisaab ke jannat mein dakhil honge. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ukasha R.A khade ho gaye, yeh qabeela Banu Asad se Muhsan ke ladke the, Badr ki ladai mein maujood the, arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke mujhe bhi inhi mein se kare, aap ne dua ki. Phir ek aur shakhs khade hue aur kaha ae Allah ke Rasool mere liye bhi dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya Ukasha tujh par sabqat kar gaye. Phir aap ne farmaya logon tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar tum se ho sake to un sattar hazaar mein se bano jo be-hisaab jannat mein jayenge, warna kam se kam daayin jaanib waalon mein se ho jao ge, yeh bhi na ho sake to kinare waalon mein se ban jao. Main ne aksar logon ko dekha hai ke apne haal mein hi latak jaate hain. Phir farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi tadaad sirf tumhari hi hogi. Pas hum ne takbeer kahi, phir farmaya balkay mujhe umeed hai ke tum tamam jannat ki tihayi waale hoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi.

Farmaya aur suno! Tum aadhon aadh ahl-e-jannat ke hoge. Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, us ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat (ثُـلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ 13 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 13) ki tilawat ki. Ab hum mein aapas mein muzakira shuru ho gaya ke yeh sattar hazaar kaun log honge, phir hum ne kaha woh log jo Islam mein paida hue aur shirk kiya hi nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh yeh woh log hain jo daagh nahin lagwate aur jhaar phoonk nahin karwate aur faal nahin lete aur apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Yeh hadith bahut si sanadon se Sahaba ki riwayat se bahut si kitabon mein sehat ke saath marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is aayat mein pehlon pichlon se murad meri ummat ke agle pichle hi hain.

Ashab-e-Yameen aur un par inamaat-e-Ilahi. Sabiqeen ka haal bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala ab Abrar ka haal bayan farmata hai jo Sabiqeen se kam martaba hain. Un ka kya haal hai kya natija hai ise suno, yeh un jannaton mein hain jahan beri ke darakht hain lekin kante daar nahin. Aur phal bakasrat aur behtareen hain. Duniya mein beri ke darakht zyada kanton wale aur kam phalon wale hote hain. Jannat ke yeh darakht zyada phalon wale aur bilkul be-khar honge, phalon ke bojh se darakht ke tane jhuke jate honge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Najjar (R.H) ne ek riwayat warid ki hai ke Sahaba kehte hain ke A'rabiyon ka Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aana aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masail puchna hamein bahut nafa deta tha. Ek martaba ek A'rabi ne aa kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran mein ek aise darakht ka bhi zikr hai jo eza deta, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne pucha woh kaunsa? Us ne kaha beri ka darakht, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir tu ne us ke sath hi lafz makh-sood nahin padha? Us ke kante Allah Ta'ala ne door kar diye hain aur un ke badle phal paida kar diye hain. Har ek beri mein behtar qisam ke zaiqe honge jin ka rang-o-maza mukhtalif hoga, yeh riwayat dusri kitabon mein bhi marwi hai is mein lafz talh hai aur sattar zaiqon ka bayan hai. Talh ek bada darakht hai jo Hijaz ki sarzameen mein hota hai, yeh kante daar darakht hai is mein kante bahut zyada hote hain. Chunancha Ibn-e-Jareer ne is ki shahadat Arabi ke ek sher se bhi di hai. Mandood ke ma'ni teh-ba-teh phal wala, phal se lada hua. In dono ka zikr is liye hua ke Arab in darakhton ki gehri aur meethi chhaon ko pasand karte the, yeh darakht bazahir dunyawi darakht jaisa hoga lekin bajaye kanton ke is mein sheereen phal honge. Johari farmate hain talh bhi kehte hain aur tal'a bhi, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai, to mumkin hai ke yeh bhi beri ki hi sifat ho, yani woh beriyan be-khar aur bakasrat phal-dar hain wallahu a'lam. Aur hazrat ne talh se murad kele ka darakht kaha hai, Ahl-e-Yaman kele ko talh kehte hain aur Ahl-e-Hijaz moz kehte hain. Lambe lambe sayon mein yeh honge. Sahih Bukhari mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jannat ke darakht ke saye tale tez sawar sau saal tak chalta rahega lekin saya khatam na hoga.

Agar tum chaho is aayat ko parho, Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai aur Musnad-e-Ahmad, Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein bhi Musnad ki aur hadith mein shak ke saath hai yani sattar ya sau aur yeh bhi hai ke yeh Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai, Ibn-e-Jarir aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai pas yeh hadith mutawatir aur qatan sahih hai is ki asnaad bohat hain aur is ke rawi siqah hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne jab yeh riwayat bayan ki aur Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ke kaanon tak pahunchi to aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne Taurat Hazrat Musa (A.S) par aur Quran Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara ke agar koi shakhs naujawan oontni par sawar ho kar us waqt chalta rahe jab tak woh burhiya ho kar gir jaye to bhi is ki intiha ko nahin pahunch sakta, Allah Ta'ala ne ise apne haath se boya hai aur khud aap ne is mein apne paas ki rooh phoonki hai is ki shakhein Jannat ki deewaron se bahar nikli hui hain. Abu Haseen kehte hain ke ek mauza mein ek darwaze par hum thay hamare saath Abu Saleh aur Shafeeq Jahni bhi thay aur Abu Saleh ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) wali oopar ki hadith bayan ki aur kaha kya tu Abu Huraira (R.A) ko jhutlata hai? Us ne kaha nahin, unhein to nahin tujhe jhutlata hoon. Pas yeh qariyon par bohat garan guzra. Main kehta hoon is saabit, sahih aur marfoo hadith ko jo jhutlaye woh ghalti par hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Jannat ke har darakht ka tana sone ka hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jannat mein ek darakht hai jis ke har taraf sau sau saal ke raaste tak saya phaila hua hai. Jannati log is ke neeche aakar baithte hain aur aapas mein baatein karte hain.
