Aag aur pani ka khaliq kaun? Irshad-e-Bari Ta'ala hai ke tum jo khetiyan bote ho zameen khod kar beej daalte ho phir un beejon ko ugana bhi kya tumhare bas mein hai? Nahin nahin balkay unhein ugana unhein phal phool dena hamara kaam hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya zira'at na kaha karo balkay harsat kaha karo yani yun kaho main ne boya yun na kaho ke main ne ugaya. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne yeh hadith suna kar phir isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Imam Hajar Mudri in ayaton ke aisay sawal ke mauqon ko jab parhte to kehte (Bal anta ya Rabbi) hum ne nahin balkay ae hamaray Rab tu ne hi. Phir farmata hai ke paida karne ke baad bhi hamari meherbani hai ke hum usay barhayen aur pakayen warna hamein qudrat hai ke sukha dein aur mazboot na hone dein barbad kar dein aur be-nishan duniya bana dein. Aur tum haath malte aur baatein banate hi reh jao. Ke haye hum par aafat aa gayi haye hamari to asal bhi mari gayi bara nuqsan ho gaya nafa ek taraf punji bhi gharat ho gayi gham-o-ranj se na jaane kya kya bhant bhant ki boliyan bolne lag jao. Kabhi kaho kaash ke ab ki martaba bote hi nahin kaash ke yun karte wun karte, yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh matlab ho ke us waqt tum apne gunahon par nadim ho jao (Tafakkuh) ka lafz apne mein dono ma'ani rakhta hai nafa ke aur gham ke. Muzan badal ko kehte hain. Phir apni pani jaisi aala ne'amat ka zikr karta hai ke dekho iska barsana bhi mere qabzay mein hai koi hai jo is badal se utar laye? Aur jab utar aaya phir bhi us mein mithas, karwahat paida karne par mujhe qudrat hai. Yeh meetha pani baithe bithaye main tumhein doon jis se tum nahao dho'o kapray saaf karo khetiyon aur baghon ko sairab karo janwaron ko pilao phir kya tumhein yahi chahiye ke mera shukr bhi ada na karo. Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pani pee kar farmaya karte dua (Alhamdulillahillazi saqana azban furatan biramatihi wa lam yaj'alhu milhan ujajan bizunubina). Yani Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne hamein meetha aur umda pani apni rahmat se laya aur hamaray gunahon ke ba'is usay khari aur karwa na bana diya. Arab mein do darakht hote hain Markh aur Afar un ki sabz shakhein jab ek dusri se ragri jayen to aag nikalti hai is ne'amat ko yaad dila kar farmata hai ke yeh aag jis se tum pakate rehte ho aur saikron fayde hasil kar rahe ho batao ke asal yani darakht us ke paida karne wale tum ho ya main? Is aag ko hum ne tazkira banaya hai yani usay dekh kar Jahannam ki aag ko yaad karo aur us se bachne ki raah lo. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) ki ek mursal hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhari yeh duniya ki aag dozakh ki aag ka satrawan hissa hai logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahi bohat kuch hai aap ne farmaya haan phir yeh satrawan hissa bhi do martaba pani se bujhaya gaya hai, ab yeh is qabil hua ke tum is se nafa utha sako aur us ke qareeb ja sako. Yeh mursal hadith Musnad mein marwi hai aur bilkul sahi hai. Muqween murad musafir hain, ba'az ne kaha hai jungle mein rehne sehne wale log murad hain. Ba'az ne kaha hai har bhooka murad hai.

Garaz darasal har woh shakhs murad hai jise aag ki zaroorat ho aur woh is se faida hasil karne ka mohtaj ho, har ameer faqeer shehri dehati musafir muqeem ko is ki haajat hoti hai, pakane ke liye apne sath le jasake aur zaroorat ke waqt apna kaam nikal sake. Abu Dawood waghera mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya teen cheezon mein tamam musalmanon ka barabar ka hissa hai aag, ghaas aur paani. Ibn Majah mein hai yeh teeno cheezein rokne ka kisi ko haq nahin. Ek riwayat mein in ki qeemat ka zikr bhi hai. Lekin is ki sanad zaeef hai wallahu aalam. Phir farmata hai tum sab ko chahiye ke is bahut badi qudraton ke maalik Allah ki har waqt pakeezgi bayan karte raho jis ne aag jaisi jala dene wali cheez ko tumhare liye nafa dene wali banadiya. Jis ne paani ko khaari aur kadwa na kardiya ke tum pyaas ke maare takleef uthao balkay ise meetha saaf shaffaf aur mazedaar banaya, duniya mein Rabb ki in nematon se faide uthao aur is ka shukr baja lao toh phir aakhirat mein bhi faide hi faide hain duniya mein yeh aag us ne tumhare faide ke liye banayi hai aur sath hi is liye ke aakhirat ki aag ka bhi andaza tum karsako aur is se bachne ke liye Allah ke farmanbardar ban jao.

Quran ka Maqam: Hazrat Zahhak (R.A) farmate hain Allah ki yeh qasmein kalam ko shuru karne ke liye hua karti hain. Lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai. Jamhoor farmate hain yeh qasmein hain aur in mein un cheezon ki azmat ka izhar bhi hai, baaz mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yahan par 'la' zaid hai aur ayat (Innahu la-Quranun) ilakh jawab-e-qasam hai aur log kehte hain 'la' ko zaid batane ki koi wajah nahin, kalam-e-Arab ke dastoor ke mutabiq woh qasam ke shuru mein aata hai, jabke jis cheez par qasam khai jaye woh manfi ho, jaise Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke is qaul mein hai (La wallahi ma massat yadu Rasulillahi ﷺ yada imraatin qattu) yani Allah ki qasam Huzoor ﷺ ne apna hath kisi aurat ke hath se lagaya nahin yani bai'at mein auraton se musafaha nahin kiya. Isi tarah yahan bhi 'la' qasam ke shuru mein mutabiq-e-qaida hai na ke zaid. To kalam ka maqsood yeh hai ke tumhare jo khayalat Quran-e-Kareem ki nisbat hain yeh jadoo hai ya kahanat hai ghalat hain. Balkeh yeh pak kitab Kalam-e-Allah hai. Baaz Arab kehte hain ke 'la' se unke kalam ka inkar hai phir asal amr ka isbat alfaz mein hai. Ayat (Fala uqsimu bi-mawaqi'in-nujoom) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 75) se murad Quran ka batadreej utarna hai, Lauh-e-Mahfooz se to Lailatul Qadr mein ek sath aasman-e-awwal par utar aaya phir hasb-e-zaroorat thoda thoda waqt-ba-waqt utarta raha yahan tak ke koi barson mein poora utar aaya. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain is se murad sitaron ke tulu aur zahir hone ki aasman ki jaghein hain. Mawaqi se murad manazil hain. Hasan (R.H) farmate hain Qayamat ke din unka muntashir ho jana hai. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain is se murad woh sitare hain jin ki nisbat mushrikeen aqeeda rakhte the ke falan falan tare ki wajah se hum par barish barsi. Phir bayan hota hai ke yeh bahut badi qasam hai is liye ke jis amr par yeh qasam khai ja rahi hai woh bahut bada amr hai yani yeh Quran badi azmat wali kitab hai, mu'azzam o mehfooz aur mazboot kitab mein hai. Jise sirf pak hath hi lagte hain yani farishton ke yahan, yeh aur baat hai ke duniya mein ise sab ke hath lagte hain. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at mein (Ma yamussuhu) hai. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) kehte hain yahan pak se murad saaf farmaya ayat (Wa ma tanazzalat bihi-sh-shayateen) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 210) yani ise na to shaitan le kar utre hain na un ke yeh laiq na un ki yeh majal balkeh woh to is ke sunne se bhi alag hain. Yehi qaul is ayat ki tafseer mein dil ko zyada lagta hai. Aur aqwal bhi is ke mutabiq ho sakte hain. Farra ne kaha hai is ka zaiqa aur is ka lutf sirf ba-iman logon ko hi mayassar aata hai. Baaz kehte hain murad janabat aur hadas se pak hona hai go yeh khabar hai lekin murad is se insha hai. Aur Quran se murad yahan par mus'haf hai.

Matlab yeh hai ke Musalman napaki ki halat mein Quran ko hath na lagaye. Ek hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quran sath le kar harbi kafiron ke mulk mein jaane se mana farmaya hai ke aisa na ho ke ise dushman kuch nuqsan pahunchaye (Muslim). Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo farman Hazrat Amr bin Hazm (R.A) ko likh kar diya tha us mein yeh bhi tha ke Quran ko na chhue magar pak (Muwatta Malik). Maraseel-e-Abu Dawood mein hai, Zuhri farmate hain main ne khud is kitab ko dekha hai aur is mein yeh jumla padha hai, go is riwayat ki bahut si sanadein hain lekin har ek qabil-e-ghaur hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir irshad hai ke yeh Quran sher-o-sukhan, jadoo aur fan nahin balkay Allah ka kalam hai aur usi ki janib se utra hai, yeh sarasar haq hai balkay sirf yahi haq hai, is ke siwa is ke khilaf jo hai batil aur yaksar mardood hai. Phir tum aisi pak baat kyun inkar karte ho? Kyun is se hatna aur yaksu hojana chahte ho? Kya is ka shukr yahi hai ke tum ise jhutlao? Qabeela-e-Azd ke kalam mein rizq-o-shukr ke ma'ni mein aata hai. Musnad ki ek hadith mein bhi rizq ka ma'ni shukr kiya hai. Yani tum kehte ho ke falan sitaray ki wajah se hamain pani mila aur falan sitaray se falan cheez. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har barish ke mauqay par ba'az log kufriya kalmaat bak dete hain ke barish ka ba'is falan sitara hai. Muwatta mein hai hum Hudaibiya ke maidan mein thay, raat ko barish hui, subh ki namaz ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya, jaante bhi ho aaj shab tumhare Rabb ne kya farmaya? Logon ne kaha Allah ko aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko maloom. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno, yeh farmaya ke aaj mere bandon mein se bahut se mere sath kafir ho gaye aur bahut se imandar ban gaye. Jis ne kaha ke hum par Allah ke fazl-o-karam se pani barsa woh meri zaat par iman rakhne wala aur sitaron se kufr karne wala hua. Aur jis ne kaha falan falan sitaray se barish barsi us ne mere sath kufr kiya aur us sitaray par iman laya. Muslim ki hadith mein umoom hai ke aasman se jo barkat nazil hoti hai woh ba'az ke iman ka aur ba'az ke kufr ka ba'is ban jati hai. Haan yeh khayal rahe ke ek martaba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se poocha tha ke Surayya sitara kitna baqi hai? Phir kaha tha ke is ilm walon ka khayal hai ke yeh apne saqit hojane ke hafta bhar baad ufaq par namudar hota hai, chunancha yahi hua bhi ke is sawal jawab aur istisqa ko saat roz guzre thay jo pani barsa. Yeh waqia mahmool hai aadat aur tajurba par, na yeh ke is sitaray mein hai aur is sitaray ko hi asar ka maujid jaante hon. Is qisam ka aqeeda to kufr hai, haan tajurba se koi cheez maloom kar lena ya koi baat keh dena dusri cheez hai. Is baray ki bahut si hadeesain aayat (مَا يَفْتَحِ اللّٰهُ للنَّاسِ مِنْ رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۚ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ ۙ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهٗ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ ۭ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ) (35. Fatir: 2) ki tafseer mein guzar chuki hain.

Ek shakhs ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh kehte hue sun liya ke falan sitare ke asar se barish hui toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tu jhoota hai, yeh toh Allah ki barsayi hui hai, yeh Rizq-e-Ilahi hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai logon ko na jaane kya ho gaya hai agar saat saal qahat-sali rahe aur phir Allah apne fazl-o-karam se barish barsaye toh bhi yeh jhat se zaban se nikalne lagenge ke falan tare ne barsaya. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain apni rozi takzeeb ko hi na bana lo yani yun na kaho ke falan farakhi ka sabab falan cheez hai balkay yun kaho ke sab kuch Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai. Pas yeh bhi matlab hai aur yeh bhi ke Quran mein unka hissa kuch nahin balkay unka hissa yahi hai ke yeh ise jhoota kehte rahen aur isi matlab ki tayeed is se pehle ki ayat se bhi hoti hai.

Jamhoor farmate hain yeh qasmein hain aur in mein un cheezon ki azmat ka izhar bhi hai, baaz mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yahan par 'la' zaid hai aur ayat (Innahu la-Quranun) ilakh jawab-e-qasam hai aur log kehte hain 'la' ko zaid batane ki koi wajah nahin, kalam-e-Arab ke dastoor ke mutabiq woh qasam ke shuru mein aata hai, jabke jis cheez par qasam khai jaye woh manfi ho, jaise Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke is qaul mein hai (La wallahi ma massat yadu Rasulillahi ﷺ yada imraatin qattu) yani Allah ki qasam Huzoor ﷺ ne apna hath kisi aurat ke hath se lagaya nahin yani bai'at mein auraton se musafaha nahin kiya. Isi tarah yahan bhi 'la' qasam ke shuru mein mutabiq-e-qaida hai na ke zaid. To kalam ka maqsood yeh hai ke tumhare jo khayalat Quran-e-Kareem ki nisbat hain yeh jadoo hai ya kahanat hai ghalat hain. Balkeh yeh pak kitab Kalam-e-Allah hai. Baaz Arab kehte hain ke 'la' se unke kalam ka inkar hai phir asal amr ka isbat alfaz mein hai. Ayat (Fala uqsimu bi-mawaqi'in-nujoom) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 75) se murad Quran ka batadreej utarna hai, Lauh-e-Mahfooz se to Lailatul Qadr mein ek sath aasman-e-awwal par utar aaya phir hasb-e-zaroorat thoda thoda waqt-ba-waqt utarta raha yahan tak ke koi barson mein poora utar aaya. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain is se murad sitaron ke tulu aur zahir hone ki aasman ki jaghein hain. Mawaqi se murad manazil hain. Hasan (R.H) farmate hain Qayamat ke din unka muntashir ho jana hai. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain is se murad woh sitare hain jin ki nisbat mushrikeen aqeeda rakhte the ke falan falan tare ki wajah se hum par barish barsi. Phir bayan hota hai ke yeh bahut badi qasam hai is liye ke jis amr par yeh qasam khai ja rahi hai woh bahut bada amr hai yani yeh Quran badi azmat wali kitab hai, mu'azzam o mehfooz aur mazboot kitab mein hai. Jise sirf pak hath hi lagte hain yani farishton ke yahan, yeh aur baat hai ke duniya mein ise sab ke hath lagte hain. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at mein (Ma yamussuhu) hai. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) kehte hain yahan pak se murad saaf farmaya ayat (Wa ma tanazzalat bihi-sh-shayateen) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 210) yani ise na to shaitan le kar utre hain na un ke yeh laiq na un ki yeh majal balkeh woh to is ke sunne se bhi alag hain. Yehi qaul is ayat ki tafseer mein dil ko zyada lagta hai. Aur aqwal bhi is ke mutabiq ho sakte hain. Farra ne kaha hai is ka zaiqa aur is ka lutf sirf ba-iman logon ko hi mayassar aata hai. Baaz kehte hain murad janabat aur hadas se pak hona hai go yeh khabar hai lekin murad is se insha hai. Aur Quran se murad yahan par mus'haf hai.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har barish ke mauqay par ba'az log kufriya kalmaat bak dete hain ke barish ka ba'is falan sitara hai. Muwatta mein hai hum Hudaibiya ke maidan mein thay, raat ko barish hui, subh ki namaz ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya, jaante bhi ho aaj shab tumhare Rabb ne kya farmaya? Logon ne kaha Allah ko aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko maloom. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno, yeh farmaya ke aaj mere bandon mein se bahut se mere sath kafir ho gaye aur bahut se imandar ban gaye. Jis ne kaha ke hum par Allah ke fazl-o-karam se pani barsa woh meri zaat par iman rakhne wala aur sitaron se kufr karne wala hua. Aur jis ne kaha falan falan sitaray se barish barsi us ne mere sath kufr kiya aur us sitaray par iman laya. Muslim ki hadith mein umoom hai ke aasman se jo barkat nazil hoti hai woh ba'az ke iman ka aur ba'az ke kufr ka ba'is ban jati hai. Haan yeh khayal rahe ke ek martaba Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se poocha tha ke Surayya sitara kitna baqi hai? Phir kaha tha ke is ilm walon ka khayal hai ke yeh apne saqit hojane ke hafta bhar baad ufaq par namudar hota hai, chunancha yahi hua bhi ke is sawal jawab aur istisqa ko saat roz guzre thay jo pani barsa. Yeh waqia mahmool hai aadat aur tajurba par, na yeh ke is sitaray mein hai aur is sitaray ko hi asar ka maujid jaante hon. Is qisam ka aqeeda to kufr hai, haan tajurba se koi cheez maloom kar lena ya koi baat keh dena dusri cheez hai. Is baray ki bahut si hadeesain aayat (مَا يَفْتَحِ اللّٰهُ للنَّاسِ مِنْ رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۚ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ ۙ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهٗ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ ۭ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ) (35. Fatir: 2) ki tafseer mein guzar chuki hain.

Ek marfoo hadith mein hai logon ko na jaane kya ho gaya hai agar saat saal qahat-sali rahe aur phir Allah apne fazl-o-karam se barish barsaye toh bhi yeh jhat se zaban se nikalne lagenge ke falan tare ne barsaya. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain apni rozi takzeeb ko hi na bana lo yani yun na kaho ke falan farakhi ka sabab falan cheez hai balkay yun kaho ke sab kuch Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai. Pas yeh bhi matlab hai aur yeh bhi ke Quran mein unka hissa kuch nahin balkay unka hissa yahi hai ke yeh ise jhoota kehte rahen aur isi matlab ki tayeed is se pehle ki ayat se bhi hoti hai.

Quran ka Maqam: Hazrat Zahhak (R.A) farmate hain Allah ki yeh qasmein kalam ko shuru karne ke liye hua karti hain. Lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai. Jamhoor farmate hain yeh qasmein hain aur in mein un cheezon ki azmat ka izhar bhi hai, baaz mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yahan par 'la' zaid hai aur ayat (Innahu la-Quranun) ilakh jawab-e-qasam hai aur log kehte hain 'la' ko zaid batane ki koi wajah nahin, kalam-e-Arab ke dastoor ke mutabiq woh qasam ke shuru mein aata hai, jabke jis cheez par qasam khai jaye woh manfi ho, jaise Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke is qaul mein hai (La wallahi ma massat yadu Rasulillahi ﷺ yada imraatin qattu) yani Allah ki qasam Huzoor ﷺ ne apna hath kisi aurat ke hath se lagaya nahin yani bai'at mein auraton se musafaha nahin kiya. Isi tarah yahan bhi 'la' qasam ke shuru mein mutabiq-e-qaida hai na ke zaid. To kalam ka maqsood yeh hai ke tumhare jo khayalat Quran-e-Kareem ki nisbat hain yeh jadoo hai ya kahanat hai ghalat hain. Balkeh yeh pak kitab Kalam-e-Allah hai. Baaz Arab kehte hain ke 'la' se unke kalam ka inkar hai phir asal amr ka isbat alfaz mein hai. Ayat (Fala uqsimu bi-mawaqi'in-nujoom) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 75) se murad Quran ka batadreej utarna hai, Lauh-e-Mahfooz se to Lailatul Qadr mein ek sath aasman-e-awwal par utar aaya phir hasb-e-zaroorat thoda thoda waqt-ba-waqt utarta raha yahan tak ke koi barson mein poora utar aaya. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain is se murad sitaron ke tulu aur zahir hone ki aasman ki jaghein hain. Mawaqi se murad manazil hain. Hasan (R.H) farmate hain Qayamat ke din unka muntashir ho jana hai. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain is se murad woh sitare hain jin ki nisbat mushrikeen aqeeda rakhte the ke falan falan tare ki wajah se hum par barish barsi. Jise sirf pak hath hi lagte hain yani farishton ke yahan, yeh aur baat hai ke duniya mein ise sab ke hath lagte hain. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at mein (Ma yamussuhu) hai. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) kehte hain yahan pak se murad saaf farmaya ayat (Wa ma tanazzalat bihi-sh-shayateen) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 210) yani ise na to shaitan le kar utre hain na un ke yeh laiq na un ki yeh majal balkeh woh to is ke sunne se bhi alag hain. Yehi qaul is ayat ki tafseer mein dil ko zyada lagta hai. Aur aqwal bhi is ke mutabiq ho sakte hain. Farra ne kaha hai is ka zaiqa aur is ka lutf sirf ba-iman logon ko hi mayassar aata hai. Baaz kehte hain murad janabat aur hadas se pak hona hai go yeh khabar hai lekin murad is se insha hai. Aur Quran se murad yahan par mus'haf hai.

Aalam-e-Naz'a ki bebasi: Isi mazmoon ki ayatein Surah Qiyamah mein bhi hain. Farmata hai ke ek shakhs apne aakhri waqt mein hai, naz'a ka aalam hai, rooh parwaz kar rahi hai, tum sab paas baithe dekh rahe ho, koi kuch nahin kar sakta. Hamare farishtay jinhein tum dekh nahin sakte, tum se bhi zyada qareeb us marne wale se hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهٖ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً) (Surah Al-An'am: 61), Allah apne bandon par ghalib hai, woh tum par apne paas se muhafiz bhejta hai, jab tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt aa jata hai to hamare bheje hue usay theek taur par faut kar lete hain, phir woh sab ke sab Allah Ta'ala Maula-e-Haq ki taraf bazgasht karaye jayenge, jo hakim hai aur jald hisab le lene wala hai. Yahan farmata hai agar sach-much tum log kisi ke zer-e-farman nahin ho, agar yeh haq hai ke tum dobara jeene aur maidan-e-Qayamat mein hazir hone ke qail nahin ho aur is mein tum haq par ho, agar tumhein hashr-o-nashr ka yaqeen nahin, agar tum azab nahin kiye jaoge waghera, to hum kehte hain is rooh ko jaane hi kyun dete ho? Agar tumhare bas mein hai to halq tak pahunchi hui rooh ko wapas us ki asli jagah pahuncha do. Pas yaad rakho jaise is rooh ko is jism mein dalne par hum qadir thay aur is ko bhi tum ne ba-chashm-e-khud dekh liya, yaqeen mano isi tarah hum dobara isi rooh ko is jism mein daal kar nayi zindagi dene par bhi qadir hain. Tumhara apni paidaish mein dakhal nahin to marne mein, phir dobara jee uthne mein tumhara dakhal kahan se ho gaya? Phir kyun tum kehte phirte ho ke hum mar kar zinda nahin honge.

Ahwal-e-Maut: Yahan woh ahwal bayan ho rahe hain jo maut ke waqt, sakarat ke waqt, duniya ki aakhri sa'at mein insanon ke hote hain ke ya toh woh aala darja ka Allah ka muqarrab hai ya us se kam darja ka hai jin ke dahne hath mein nama-e-a'mal diya jaye ga. Ya bilkul badnaseeb hai jo Allah se jahil raha aur rah-e-haq se ghafil raha. Farmata hai ke jo muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-Ilahi hain, jo ahkam ke aamil thay, nafarmaniyon ke tarik thay unhein toh farishtay tarah tarah ki khushkhabriyan sunate hain. Jaise ke pehle Bara ki hadith guzri ke rahmat ke farishtay us se kehte hain ae pak ruh, pak jism wali ruh! Chal rahat-o-aaram ki taraf, chal kabhi na naraz hone wale Rahman ki taraf. Ruh se murad rahat hai aur raihan se murad aaram hai. Gharz duniya ke masaib se rahat mil jati hai, abadi suroor aur sachi khushi Allah ke ghulam ko isi waqt hasil hoti hai, woh ek farakhi aur wus'at dekhta hai, us ke samne rizq aur rahmat hoti hai, woh Jannat-e-Adan ki taraf lapakta hai. Hazrat Abu Aliyah farmate hain Jannat ki ek hari bhari shakh aati hai aur us waqt muqarrab-e-Allah ki ruh qabz ki jati hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab farmate hain marne se pehle hi har marne wale ko maloom ho jata hai ke woh Jannati hai ya Jahannami hai (Ya Allah! Hamare us waqt mein toh hamari madad kar, hamein iman se utha aur apni razamandi ki khushkhabri suna kar sukoon-o-rahat ke sath yahan se le ja, Ameen). Go sakarat ke waqt ki ahadith hum Surah Ibrahim ki ayat (يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ 27؀) (14. Ibrahim: 27) ki tafsir mein warid kar chuke hain lekin chunke yeh un ka behtareen mauqa hai is liye yahan ek tukra bayan karte hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut (A.S) se farmata hai mere falan bande ke paas ja aur use mere darbar mein le aa, main ne use ranj, rahat-o-aaram, takleef, khushi, na-khushi, gharz har aazmaish mein aazma liya aur apni marzi ke mutabiq paya, bas ab main use abadi rahat dena chahta hoon, ja use mere khas darbar mein pesh kar. Malak-ul-Maut panch sau rahmat ke farishtay aur Jannat ke kafan aur Jannati khushbu'ein sath le kar us ke paas aate hain, go raihan ek hi hota hai lekin siray par bees qismein hoti hain, har ek ki judagana mehak hoti hai, safed resham sath hota hai jis mein mushk ki laptein aati hain, al-kh. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qirat faruh, ra ke pesh se thi. Lekin tamam qariyon ki qirat ra ke zabar se hai yani farwah. Musnad mein hai Hazrat Umme Hani ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (A.S) se pucha kya marne ke baad hum aapas mein ek dusre se milenge? Aur ek dusre ko dekhenge? Aap ne farmaya ruh ek parinda ho jaye gi jo darakhton ke meway chuge gi yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho, us waqt apne apne jism mein chali jaye gi, is hadith mein har momin ke liye bahut bari basharat hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi is ki shahid ek hadith hai jis ki asnad bahut behtar hai aur matn bhi bahut qawi hai aur sahih riwayat mein hai shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain, sari jannat mein jahan chahein khati peeti rehti hain aur arsh tale latki hui qandeelon mein aa baithti hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Abdur Rahman bin Abu Ya'la ek janaze mein gadhe par sawar ja rahe thay aap ki umr us waqt burhape ki thi sar aur darhi ke baal safaid thay isi asna mein aap ne yeh hadith bayan farmayi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo Allah ki mulaqat ko pasand karta hai Allah bhi us se milna chahta hai aur jo Allah se milne ko bura janta hai Allah bhi us ki mulaqat se karahat karta hai sahaba yeh sun kar sar jhukaye rone lage. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya rote kyun ho? Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ bhala maut kaun chahta hai? Farmaya suno suno matlab sakrat ke waqt se hai us waqt nek muqarrab bande ko toh rahat-o-inaam aur aaram deh jannat ki khushkhabri sunayi jati hai jis par woh tarap uthta hai aur chahta hai ke jahan tak mumkin ho jald Allah se mile taake un nematon se maal-o-maal ho jaye pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ki tamanna karta hai aur agar bad banda hai toh use maut ke waqt garmi pani aur jahannam ki mehmani ki khabar di jati hai jis se yeh bezar na hon pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko napasand karta hai. Phir farmata hai agar woh sa'adat mandon se hai toh maut ke farishte use salam kehte hain tujh par salamti ho tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai, Allah ke azab se tu salamti payega aur khud farishte bhi use salam karte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Innal-lazeena qaloo Rabbunallahu summas-taqamu fala khaufun alaihim wala hum yahzanoon) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 13) yani sache pakke tauheed walon ke paas un ke inteqal ke waqt rahmat ke farishte aate hain aur unhein basharat dete hain ke kuch dar khauf nahin kuch ranj-o-gham na kar jannat tere liye hasb-e-wa'da taiyar hai, duniya aur aakhirat mein hum teri himayat ke liye maujood hain jo tumhara jee chahe tumhare liye maujood hai jo tamanna tum karoge puri ho kar rahegi, Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah ke tum zi-izzat mehman ho. Bukhari mein hai yani tere liye musallam hai ke tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke salam yahan dua ke ma'ni mein ho, Wallahu A'lam aur agar marne wala haq ki takzeeb karne wala aur hidayat se khoya hua hai toh us ki ziyafat us garm hameem se hogi jo aantein aur khaal tak jholsa de phir charon taraf se jahannam ki aag gher le gi jis mein jalta bhunta rahega. Phir farmaya yeh yaqeeni baatein hain jin ke haq hone mein koi shuba nahin. Pas apne bare Rabb ke naam ki tasbeeh karta rahe. Musnad mein hai is ayat ke utarne par aap ne farmaya ise ruku mein rakho aur ayat (Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'la) utarne par farmaya ise sajde mein rakho.

Aap farmate hain jis ne hadith (Subhan Allahil Azeem-e-wa bihamdihi) kaha us ke liye jannat mein ek darakht lagaya jata hai (Tirmidhi). Sahih Bukhari Sharif ke khatm par yeh hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya do kalme hain jo zaban par halke hain, mizan mein bojh hain, Allah ko bahut pyare hain. Dua (Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi, Subhan Allahil Azeem). Alhamdulillah Surah Waqiah ki tafsir khatm hui, Allah qabool farmaye (aur hamare kul waqiat ka anjam bhala kare).

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qirat faruh, ra ke pesh se thi. Lekin tamam qariyon ki qirat ra ke zabar se hai yani farwah. Musnad mein hai Hazrat Umme Hani ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (A.S) se pucha kya marne ke baad hum aapas mein ek dusre se milenge? Aur ek dusre ko dekhenge? Aap ne farmaya ruh ek parinda ho jaye gi jo darakhton ke meway chuge gi yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho, us waqt apne apne jism mein chali jaye gi, is hadith mein har momin ke liye bahut bari basharat hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi is ki shahid ek hadith hai jis ki asnad bahut behtar hai aur matn bhi bahut qawi hai aur sahih riwayat mein hai shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain, sari jannat mein jahan chahein khati peeti rehti hain aur arsh tale latki hui qandeelon mein aa baithti hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Abdur Rahman bin Abu Ya'la ek janaze mein gadhe par sawar ja rahe thay aap ki umr us waqt burhape ki thi sar aur darhi ke baal safaid thay isi asna mein aap ne yeh hadith bayan farmayi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo Allah ki mulaqat ko pasand karta hai Allah bhi us se milna chahta hai aur jo Allah se milne ko bura janta hai Allah bhi us ki mulaqat se karahat karta hai sahaba yeh sun kar sar jhukaye rone lage. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya rote kyun ho? Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ bhala maut kaun chahta hai? Farmaya suno suno matlab sakrat ke waqt se hai us waqt nek muqarrab bande ko toh rahat-o-inaam aur aaram deh jannat ki khushkhabri sunayi jati hai jis par woh tarap uthta hai aur chahta hai ke jahan tak mumkin ho jald Allah se mile taake un nematon se maal-o-maal ho jaye pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ki tamanna karta hai aur agar bad banda hai toh use maut ke waqt garmi pani aur jahannam ki mehmani ki khabar di jati hai jis se yeh bezar na hon pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko napasand karta hai. Phir farmata hai agar woh sa'adat mandon se hai toh maut ke farishte use salam kehte hain tujh par salamti ho tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai, Allah ke azab se tu salamti payega aur khud farishte bhi use salam karte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Innal-lazeena qaloo Rabbunallahu summas-taqamu fala khaufun alaihim wala hum yahzanoon) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 13) yani sache pakke tauheed walon ke paas un ke inteqal ke waqt rahmat ke farishte aate hain aur unhein basharat dete hain ke kuch dar khauf nahin kuch ranj-o-gham na kar jannat tere liye hasb-e-wa'da taiyar hai, duniya aur aakhirat mein hum teri himayat ke liye maujood hain jo tumhara jee chahe tumhare liye maujood hai jo tamanna tum karoge puri ho kar rahegi, Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah ke tum zi-izzat mehman ho. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke salam yahan dua ke ma'ni mein ho, Wallahu A'lam aur agar marne wala haq ki takzeeb karne wala aur hidayat se khoya hua hai toh us ki ziyafat us garm hameem se hogi jo aantein aur khaal tak jholsa de phir charon taraf se jahannam ki aag gher le gi jis mein jalta bhunta rahega. Phir farmaya yeh yaqeeni baatein hain jin ke haq hone mein koi shuba nahin. Pas apne bare Rabb ke naam ki tasbeeh karta rahe. Musnad mein hai is ayat ke utarne par aap ne farmaya ise ruku mein rakho aur ayat (Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'la) utarne par farmaya ise sajde mein rakho.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qirat faruh, ra ke pesh se thi. Lekin tamam qariyon ki qirat ra ke zabar se hai yani farwah. Musnad mein hai Hazrat Umme Hani ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (A.S) se pucha kya marne ke baad hum aapas mein ek dusre se milenge? Aur ek dusre ko dekhenge? Aap ne farmaya ruh ek parinda ho jaye gi jo darakhton ke meway chuge gi yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho, us waqt apne apne jism mein chali jaye gi, is hadith mein har momin ke liye bahut bari basharat hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi is ki shahid ek hadith hai jis ki asnad bahut behtar hai aur matn bhi bahut qawi hai aur sahih riwayat mein hai shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain, sari jannat mein jahan chahein khati peeti rehti hain aur arsh tale latki hui qandeelon mein aa baithti hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Abdur Rahman bin Abu Ya'la ek janaze mein gadhe par sawar ja rahe thay aap ki umr us waqt burhape ki thi sar aur darhi ke baal safaid thay isi asna mein aap ne yeh hadith bayan farmayi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo Allah ki mulaqat ko pasand karta hai Allah bhi us se milna chahta hai aur jo Allah se milne ko bura janta hai Allah bhi us ki mulaqat se karahat karta hai sahaba yeh sun kar sar jhukaye rone lage. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya rote kyun ho? Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ bhala maut kaun chahta hai? Farmaya suno suno matlab sakrat ke waqt se hai us waqt nek muqarrab bande ko toh rahat-o-inaam aur aaram deh jannat ki khushkhabri sunayi jati hai jis par woh tarap uthta hai aur chahta hai ke jahan tak mumkin ho jald Allah se mile taake un nematon se maal-o-maal ho jaye pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ki tamanna karta hai aur agar bad banda hai toh use maut ke waqt garmi pani aur jahannam ki mehmani ki khabar di jati hai jis se yeh bezar na hon pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko napasand karta hai. Phir farmata hai agar woh sa'adat mandon se hai toh maut ke farishte use salam kehte hain tujh par salamti ho tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai, Allah ke azab se tu salamti payega aur khud farishte bhi use salam karte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Innal-lazeena qaloo Rabbunallahu summas-taqamu fala khaufun alaihim wala hum yahzanoon) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 13) yani sache pakke tauheed walon ke paas un ke inteqal ke waqt rahmat ke farishte aate hain aur unhein basharat dete hain ke kuch dar khauf nahin kuch ranj-o-gham na kar jannat tere liye hasb-e-wa'da taiyar hai, duniya aur aakhirat mein hum teri himayat ke liye maujood hain jo tumhara jee chahe tumhare liye maujood hai jo tamanna tum karoge puri ho kar rahegi, Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah ke tum zi-izzat mehman ho. Bukhari mein hai yani tere liye musallam hai ke tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke salam yahan dua ke ma'ni mein ho, Wallahu A'lam aur agar marne wala haq ki takzeeb karne wala aur hidayat se khoya hua hai toh us ki ziyafat us garm hameem se hogi jo aantein aur khaal tak jholsa de phir charon taraf se jahannam ki aag gher le gi jis mein jalta bhunta rahega. Phir farmaya yeh yaqeeni baatein hain jin ke haq hone mein koi shuba nahin. Pas apne bare Rabb ke naam ki tasbeeh karta rahe. Musnad mein hai is ayat ke utarne par aap ne farmaya ise ruku mein rakho aur ayat (Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'la) utarne par farmaya ise sajde mein rakho.

Malak-ul-Maut panch sau rahmat ke farishtay aur Jannat ke kafan aur Jannati khushbu'ein sath le kar us ke paas aate hain, go raihan ek hi hota hai lekin siray par bees qismein hoti hain, har ek ki judagana mehak hoti hai, safed resham sath hota hai jis mein mushk ki laptein aati hain, al-kh. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qirat faruh, ra ke pesh se thi. Lekin tamam qariyon ki qirat ra ke zabar se hai yani farwah. Musnad mein hai Hazrat Umme Hani ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (A.S) se pucha kya marne ke baad hum aapas mein ek dusre se milenge? Aur ek dusre ko dekhenge? Aap ne farmaya ruh ek parinda ho jaye gi jo darakhton ke meway chuge gi yahan tak ke Qayamat qaim ho, us waqt apne apne jism mein chali jaye gi, is hadith mein har momin ke liye bahut bari basharat hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi is ki shahid ek hadith hai jis ki asnad bahut behtar hai aur matn bhi bahut qawi hai aur sahih riwayat mein hai shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain, sari jannat mein jahan chahein khati peeti rehti hain aur arsh tale latki hui qandeelon mein aa baithti hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Abdur Rahman bin Abu Ya'la ek janaze mein gadhe par sawar ja rahe thay aap ki umr us waqt burhape ki thi sar aur darhi ke baal safaid thay isi asna mein aap ne yeh hadith bayan farmayi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jo Allah ki mulaqat ko pasand karta hai Allah bhi us se milna chahta hai aur jo Allah se milne ko bura janta hai Allah bhi us ki mulaqat se karahat karta hai sahaba yeh sun kar sar jhukaye rone lage. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya rote kyun ho? Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ bhala maut kaun chahta hai? Farmaya suno suno matlab sakrat ke waqt se hai us waqt nek muqarrab bande ko toh rahat-o-inaam aur aaram deh jannat ki khushkhabri sunayi jati hai jis par woh tarap uthta hai aur chahta hai ke jahan tak mumkin ho jald Allah se mile taake un nematon se maal-o-maal ho jaye pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ki tamanna karta hai aur agar bad banda hai toh use maut ke waqt garmi pani aur jahannam ki mehmani ki khabar di jati hai jis se yeh bezar na hon pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko napasand karta hai. Phir farmata hai agar woh sa'adat mandon se hai toh maut ke farishte use salam kehte hain tujh par salamti ho tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai, Allah ke azab se tu salamti payega aur khud farishte bhi use salam karte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Innal-lazeena qaloo Rabbunallahu summas-taqamu fala khaufun alaihim wala hum yahzanoon) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 13) yani sache pakke tauheed walon ke paas un ke inteqal ke waqt rahmat ke farishte aate hain aur unhein basharat dete hain ke kuch dar khauf nahin kuch ranj-o-gham na kar jannat tere liye hasb-e-wa'da taiyar hai, duniya aur aakhirat mein hum teri himayat ke liye maujood hain jo tumhara jee chahe tumhare liye maujood hai jo tamanna tum karoge puri ho kar rahegi, Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah ke tum zi-izzat mehman ho. Bukhari mein hai yani tere liye musallam hai ke tu as-hab-e-yameen mein se hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke salam yahan dua ke ma'ni mein ho, Wallahu A'lam aur agar marne wala haq ki takzeeb karne wala aur hidayat se khoya hua hai toh us ki ziyafat us garm hameem se hogi jo aantein aur khaal tak jholsa de phir charon taraf se jahannam ki aag gher le gi jis mein jalta bhunta rahega. Phir farmaya yeh yaqeeni baatein hain jin ke haq hone mein koi shuba nahin. Pas apne bare Rabb ke naam ki tasbeeh karta rahe. Musnad mein hai is ayat ke utarne par aap ne farmaya ise ruku mein rakho aur ayat (Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'la) utarne par farmaya ise sajde mein rakho.

Aap farmate hain jis ne hadith (Subhan Allahil Azeem-e-wa bihamdihi) kaha us ke liye jannat mein ek darakht lagaya jata hai (Tirmidhi). Sahih Bukhari Sharif ke khatm par yeh hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya do kalme hain jo zaban par halke hain, mizan mein bojh hain, Allah ko bahut pyare hain. Dua (Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi, Subhan Allahil Azeem). Alhamdulillah Surah Waqiah ki tafsir khatm hui, Allah qabool farmaye (aur hamare kul waqiat ka anjam bhala kare).
